Un plugin est un **processus isolé** (pas d'import direct dans core/)\n2. Un plugin communique **uniquement via NATS** (pas d'appel direct)\n3. Un plugin a des **permissions explicites** (RBAC)\n4. Un plugin est **versionné** (semver)\n5. Un plugin est **sandboxé** (resource limits, restricted imports)\n\n---\n\n## 1. Module Structure\n\n```\nplugins/\n├── __init__.py\n├── manager.py                # PluginManager (cycle de vie)\n├── registry.py               # PluginRegistry (capabilities, versions)\n├── loader.py                 # PluginLoader (dynamique)\n├── validator.py              # PluginValidator (sécurité)\n├── sandbox.py                # PluginSandbox (isolation)\n├── tool_registry.py          # ToolRegistry (outils)\n│\n├── sdk/                      # SDK pour développeurs\n│   ├── __init__.py\n│   ├── base.py               # PluginBase (classe abstraite)\n│   ├── tool.py               # ToolBase (classe abstraite)\n│   ├── events.py             # EventClient (wrapper NATS)\n│   ├── manifest.py           # ManifestBuilder\n│   └── permissions.py        # PermissionChecker\n│\n├── store/                    # Plugins installés\n│   └── <source>/\n│       └── <name>/\n│           ├── manifest.json\n│           ├── plugin.py\n│           └── requirements.txt\n│\n├── builtin/                  # Plugins intégrés\n│   ├── shell/\n│   ├── web_search/\n│   └── file_ops/\n│\n├── pyproject.toml\n└── tests/\n```\n\n---\n\n## 2. Plugin Manifest\n\n```json\n{\n  \"name\": \"web-search\",\n  \"version\": \"1.2.0\",\n  \"api_version\": \"1.0.0\",\n  \"description\": \"Web search via DuckDuckGo\",\n  \"author\": \"ETHAN Team\",\n  \"license\": \"MIT\",\n  \n  \"capabilities\": [\n    {\n      \"name\": \"web.search\",\n      \"version\": \"1.0.0\",\n      \"description\": \"Search the web\",\n      \"inputs\": [\"web.search.request\"],\n      \"outputs\": [\"web.search.result\"],\n      \"permissions\": [\"network:request:https://[REDACTED:PASSWORD]@abstractmethod\n    async def on_load(self) -> None:\n        \"\"\"Called when plugin is loaded.\"\"\"\n        pass\n    \n    @abstractmethod\n    async def on_start(self) -> None:\n        \"\"\"Called when plugin starts (after registration).\"\"\"\n        pass\n    \n    @abstractmethod\n    async def on_stop(self) -> None:\n        \"\"\"Called when plugin stops (before unload).\"\"\"\n        pass\n    \n    @abstractmethod\n    async def on_unload(self) -> None:\n        \"\"\"Called when plugin is unloaded.\"\"\"\n        pass\n    \n    @abstractmethod\n    async def health(self) -> dict:\n        \"\"\"Health check.\"\"\"\n        return {\"status\": \"healthy\"}\n```\n\n---\n\n## 4. Dynamic Loading\n\n### 4.1 Discovery\n\n```python\n# plugins/loader.py\n\nclass PluginLoader:\n    \"\"\"Chargeur de plugins dynamique.\"\"\"\n    \n    def __init__(self, store_dir: str):\n        self.store_dir = store_dir\n        self._loaded: dict[str, Plugin] = {}\n    \n    async def discover(self) -> list[PluginManifest]:\n        \"\"\"Découvre les plugins disponibles.\"\"\"\n        manifests = []\n        for source_dir in Path(self.store_dir).iterdir():\n            for plugin_dir in source_dir.iterdir():\n                manifest_path = plugin_dir / \"manifest.json\"\n                if manifest_path.exists():\n                    manifest = self._parse_manifest(manifest_path)\n                    manifests.append(manifest)\n        return manifests\n    \n    async def load(self, manifest: PluginManifest) -> Plugin:\n        \"\"\"Charge un plugin (import dynamique).\"\"\"\n        plugin_path = self._get_plugin_path(manifest)\n        \n        # Import dynamique\n        spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(\n            manifest.name,\n            plugin_path / \"plugin.py\"\n        )\n        module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)\n        spec.loader.exec_module(module)\n        \n        # Instanciation\n        plugin_class = getattr(module, manifest.entry_point)\n        plugin = plugin_class(manifest)\n        \n        self._loaded[manifest.name] = plugin\n        return plugin\n```\n\n### 4.2 Isolation\n\n```python\n# plugins/sandbox.py\n\nclass PluginSandbox:\n    \"\"\"Sandbox pour plugins.\"\"\"\n    \n    def __init__(self, permissions: PermissionSet):\n        self.permissions = permissions\n        self._resource_limits = ResourceLimits(\n            max_memory_mb=512,\n            max_cpu_percent=50,\n            max_execution_time_s=30,\n        )\n    \n    def check_permission(self, action: str, resource: str) -> bool:\n        \"\"\"Vérifie une permission.\"\"\"\n        return self.permissions.allows(action, resource)\n    \n    def enforce_limits(self) -> ResourceGuard:\n        \"\"\"Applique les limites de ressources.\"\"\"\n        return ResourceGuard(self._resource_limits)\n```\n\n---\n\n## 5. Safe Execution Boundaries\n\n### 5.1 Permission Model\n\n```python\n# plugins/sdk/permissions.py\n\nclass PermissionSet:\n    \"\"\"Ensemble de permissions.\"\"\"\n    \n    def __init__(self):\n        self._permissions: list[Permission] = []\n    \n    def allows(self, action: str, resource: str) -> bool:\n        \"\"\"Vérifie si l'action est autorisée.\"\"\"\n        for perm in self._permissions:\n            if perm.matches(action, resource):\n                return True\n        return False\n    \n    def add(self, action: str, resource: str) -> None:\n        \"\"\"Ajoute une permission.\"\"\"\n        self._permissions.append(Permission(action, resource))\n\n@dataclass\nclass Permission:\n    \"\"\"Permission individuelle.\"\"\"\n    action: str  # \"read\", \"write\", \"execute\", \"network\"\n    resource: str  # \"state:*\", \"network:https://[REDACTED:PASSWORD]@dataclass\nclass ResourceLimits:\n    \"\"\"Limites de ressources.\"\"\"\n    max_memory_mb: int = 512\n    max_cpu_percent: float = 50.0\n    max_execution_time_s: int = 30\n    max_file_descriptors: int = 100\n    max_network_connections: int = 10\n\nclass ResourceGuard:\n    \"\"\"Applique les limites.\"\"\"\n    \n    def __init__(self, limits: ResourceLimits):\n        self.limits = limits\n    \n    async def __aenter__(self):\n        # Set resource limits\n        return self\n    \n    async def __aexit__(self, exc_type, exc_val, exc_tb):\n        # Cleanup\n        pass\n```\n\n### 5.3 Import Restrictions\n\n```python\n# plugins/validator.py\n\nFORBIDDEN_IMPORTS = {\n    \"os\", \"sys\", \"subprocess\", \"shutil\", \"socket\",\n    \"ctypes\", \"pickle\", \"marshal\", \"shelve\",\n}\n\nclass PluginValidator:\n    \"\"\"Valide un plugin avant chargement.\"\"\"\n    \n    def validate_imports(self, plugin_path: Path) -> ValidationResult:\n        \"\"\"Vérifie les imports interdits.\"\"\"\n        for py_file in plugin_path.rglob(\"*.py\"):\n            tree = ast.parse(py_file.read_text())\n            for node in ast.walk(tree):\n                if isinstance(node, ast.Import):\n                    for alias in node.names:\n                        if alias.name in FORBIDDEN_IMPORTS:\n                            return ValidationResult(\n                                valid=False,\n                                error=f\"Forbidden import: {alias.name}\"\n                            )\n        return ValidationResult(valid=True)\n```\n\n---\n\n## 6. Tool Registry\n\n### 6.1 Tool Definition\n\n```python\n# plugins/tool_registry.py\n\n@dataclass\nclass ToolDefinition:\n    \"\"\"Définition d'un outil.\"\"\"\n    name: str\n    plugin: str\n    description: str\n    parameters: dict[str, ToolParameter]\n    permissions: list[Permission]\n    version: str = \"1.0.0\"\n\n@dataclass\nclass ToolParameter:\n    \"\"\"Paramètre d'outil.\"\"\"\n    name: str\n    type: str  # \"string\", \"number\", \"boolean\", \"object\"\n    required: bool = False\n    description: str = \"\"\n    default: Any = None\n```\n\n### 6.2 Tool Registry\n\n```python\nclass ToolRegistry:\n    \"\"\"Registre des outils.\"\"\"\n    \n    def __init__(self):\n        self._tools: dict[str, ToolDefinition] = {}\n    \n    def register(self, tool: ToolDefinition) -> None:\n        \"\"\"Enregistre un outil.\"\"\"\n        self._tools[tool.name] = tool\n    \n    def unregister(self, tool_name: str) -> None:\n        \"\"\"Désenregistre un outil.\"\"\"\n        self._tools.pop(tool_name, None)\n    \n    def get(self, tool_name: str) -> ToolDefinition | None:\n        \"\"\"Récupère un outil.\"\"\"\n        return self._tools.get(tool_name)\n    \n    def list_by_plugin(self, plugin_name: str) -> list[ToolDefinition]:\n        \"\"\"Liste les outils d'un plugin.\"\"\"\n        return [\n            t for t in self._tools.values()\n            if t.plugin == plugin_name\n        ]\n    \n    def search(self, query: str) -> list[ToolDefinition]:\n        \"\"\"Recherche des outils par description.\"\"\"\n        return [\n            t for t in self._tools.values()\n            if query.lower() in t.description.lower()\n        ]\n```\n\n### 6.3 Tool Execution\n\n```python\n# plugins/sdk/tool.py\n\nclass ToolBase(ABC):\n    \"\"\"Base class for tools.\"\"\"\n    \n    def __init__(self, definition: ToolDefinition):\n        self.definition = definition\n    \n    @abstractmethod\n    async def execute(self, params: dict) -> ToolResult:\n        \"\"\"Exécute l'outil.\"\"\"\n        pass\n\n@dataclass\nclass ToolResult:\n    \"\"\"Résultat d'exécution.\"\"\"\n    success: bool\n    data: Any = None\n    error: str | None = None\n    metadata: dict[str, str] | None = None\n```\n\n---\n\n## 7. Versioning Support\n\n### 7.1 Semantic Versioning\n\n```python\n# plugins/versioning.py\n\nclass PluginVersion:\n    \"\"\"Gestion de version sémantique.\"\"\"\n    \n    def __init__(self, version: str):\n        self.raw = version\n        self.major, self.minor, self.patch = self._parse(version)\n    \n    def _parse(self, version: str) -> tuple[int, int, int]:\n        parts = version.split(\".\")\n        return (\n            int(parts[0]),\n            int(parts[1]) if len(parts) > 1 else 0,\n            int(parts[2]) if len(parts) > 2 else 0,\n        )\n    \n    def is_compatible_with(self, api_version: str) -> bool:\n        \"\"\"Vérifie compatibilité avec API version.\"\"\"\n        api = PluginVersion(api_version)\n        return self.major == api.major\n    \n    def __str__(self) -> str:\n        return self.raw\n```\n\n### 7.2 Version Resolution\n\n```python\n# plugins/registry.py\n\nclass PluginRegistry:\n    \"\"\"Registre des plugins avec versioning.\"\"\"\n    \n    def __init__(self):\n        self._plugins: dict[str, dict[str, PluginManifest]] = {}\n        # {name: {version: manifest}}\n    \n    def register(self, manifest: PluginManifest) -> None:\n        \"\"\"Enregistre un plugin (par nom + version).\"\"\"\n        if manifest.name not in self._plugins:\n            self._plugins[manifest.name] = {}\n        self._plugins[manifest.name][manifest.version] = manifest\n    \n    def resolve(self, name: str, version_range: str) -> PluginManifest | None:\n        \"\"\"Résout un plugin selon contrainte de version.\"\"\"\n        import semver\n        constraint = semver.VersionInfo.parse(version_range)\n        \n        candidates = self._plugins.get(name, {})\n        for version_str, manifest in candidates.items():\n            version = semver.VersionInfo.parse(version_str)\n            if version in constraint:\n                return manifest\n        \n        return None\n    \n    def list_versions(self, name: str) -> list[str]:\n        \"\"\"Liste les versions disponibles.\"\"\"\n        return list(self._plugins.get(name, {}).keys())\n```\n\n---\n\n## 8. Plugin Manager (Core Integration)\n\n```python\n# plugins/manager.py\n\nclass PluginManager:\n    \"\"\"Gestionnaire de plugins pour Core.\"\"\"\n    \n    def __init__(\n        self,\n        bus: EventBus,\n        registry: ModuleRegistry,\n        tool_registry: ToolRegistry,\n        store_dir: str,\n    ):\n        self.bus = bus\n        self.registry = registry\n        self.tool_registry = tool_registry\n        self.loader = PluginLoader(store_dir)\n        self.validator = PluginValidator()\n        self._plugins: dict[str, Plugin] = {}\n    \n    async def discover(self) -> list[PluginManifest]:\n        \"\"\"Découvre les plugins disponibles.\"\"\"\n        return await self.loader.discover()\n    \n    async def install(self, source: str, name: str) -> PluginManifest:\n        \"\"\"Installe un plugin depuis une source.\"\"\"\n        # 1. Download/copy plugin\n        manifest = await self._fetch_plugin(source, name)\n        \n        # 2. Validate\n        result = self.validator.validate(manifest)\n        if not result.valid:\n            raise ValueError(f\"Invalid plugin: {result.error}\")\n        \n        # 3. Load\n        plugin = await self.loader.load(manifest)\n        \n        # 4. Register\n        await self._register_plugin(plugin)\n        \n        return manifest\n    \n    async def start(self, name: str) -> None:\n        \"\"\"Démarre un plugin.\"\"\"\n        plugin = self._plugins.get(name)\n        if not plugin:\n            raise ValueError(f\"Plugin not loaded: {name}\")\n        \n        # Create sandbox\n        sandbox = PluginSandbox(plugin.manifest.permissions)\n        \n        # Start in isolated process\n        await plugin.start(sandbox)\n        \n        # Register capabilities\n        await self.registry.register(plugin.manifest.capabilities)\n        \n        # Register tools\n        for tool_def in plugin.manifest.tools:\n            self.tool_registry.register(tool_def)\n        \n        # Subscribe to events\n        await self.bus.subscribe(\n            f\"plugin.{name}.#\",\n            plugin.handle_event,\n            queue=f\"plugin-{name}\"\n        )\n    \n    async def stop(self, name: str) -> None:\n        \"\"\"Arrête un plugin.\"\"\"\n        plugin = self._plugins.get(name)\n        if not plugin:\n            return\n        \n        await plugin.stop()\n        \n        # Unregister capabilities\n        for cap in plugin.manifest.capabilities:\n            await self.registry.unregister(cap.name)\n        \n        # Unregister tools\n        for tool in plugin.manifest.tools:\n            self.tool_registry.unregister(tool.name)\n    \n    async def uninstall(self, name: str) -> None:\n        \"\"\"Désinstalle un plugin.\"\"\"\n        await self.stop(name)\n        plugin = self._plugins.pop(name, None)\n        if plugin:\n            await plugin.unload()\n```\n\n---\n\n## 9. Communication Flow\n\n```\nPlugin ──NATS──► Core\n   │\n   │ Publish: plugin.<name>.<action>\n   │ Subscribe: core.<event>\n   │\n   ▼\nCore reçoit événement\n   │\n   ▼\nCore route vers modules\n   │\n   ▼\nCore peut répondre via NATS\n   │\n   ▼\nPlugin reçoit réponse\n```\n\n### 9.1 Event Protocol\n\n```python\n# Plugin → Core\n{\n  \"type\": \"plugin.tool.execute\",\n  \"source\": \"plugin.web-search\",\n  \"payload\": {\n    \"tool\": \"search\",\n    \"params\": {\"query\": \"ETHAN OS\"}\n  }\n}\n\n# Core → Plugin\n{\n  \"type\": \"plugin.tool.result\",\n  \"source\": \"core\",\n  \"payload\": {\n    \"request_id\": \"req-123\",\n    \"result\": {\n      \"success\": true,\n      \"data\": [\"result1\", \"result2\"]\n    }\n  }\n}\n```\n\n---\n\n## 10. Security Model\n\n### 10.1 Permission Levels\n\n| Level | Description | Example |\n|-------|-------------|---------|\n| `NONE` | Aucun accès | Plugin inactif |\n| `READ` | Lecture seule | `state:read:core:*` |\n| `WRITE` | Écriture limitée | `state:write:plugin:*` |\n| `EXECUTE` | Exécution outils | `tool:execute:*` |\n| `ADMIN` | Accès complet | `*` |\n\n### 10.2 Permission Enforcement\n\n```python\n# plugins/sdk/permissions.py\n\nclass PermissionChecker:\n    \"\"\"Vérificateur de permissions.\"\"\"\n    \n    def __init__(self, permissions: PermissionSet):\n        self.permissions = permissions\n    \n    def check_tool_execution(self, tool_name: str) -> bool:\n        \"\"\"Vérifie si le plugin peut exécuter un outil.\"\"\"\n        return self.permissions.allows(\"execute\", f\"tool:{tool_name}\")\n    \n    def check_state_access(self, key: str, readonly: bool = True) -> bool:\n        \"\"\"Vérifie accès au state.\"\"\"\n        action = \"read\" if readonly else \"write\"\n        return self.permissions.allows(action, f\"state:{key}\")\n    \n    def check_network(self, url: str) -> bool:\n        \"\"\"Vérifie accès réseau.\"\"\"\n        return self.permissions.allows(\"network\", f\"network:{url}\")\n```\n\n---\n\n## 11. Plugin SDK\n\n### 11.1 Base Classes\n\n```python\n# plugins/sdk/base.py\n\nclass PluginBase(ABC):\n    \"\"\"Base class for ETHAN plugins.\"\"\"\n    \n    def __init__(self, manifest: PluginManifest):\n        self.manifest = manifest\n        self.events = EventClient(manifest.name)\n        self.permissions = PermissionChecker(manifest.permissions)\n    \n    @abstractmethod\n    async def on_load(self) -> None:\n        \"\"\"Initialize plugin.\"\"\"\n        pass\n    \n    @abstractmethod\n    async def on_start(self) -> None:\n        \"\"\"Start plugin (after registration).\"\"\"\n        pass\n    \n    @abstractmethod\n    async def on_stop(self) -> None:\n        \"\"\"Stop plugin (before unload).\"\"\"\n        pass\n    \n    async def handle_event(self, event: Event) -> None:\n        \"\"\"Handle incoming event.\"\"\"\n        pass\n\n# plugins/sdk/tool.py\n\nclass ToolBase(ABC):\n    \"\"\"Base class for plugin tools.\"\"\"\n    \n    def __init__(self, definition: ToolDefinition):\n        self.definition = definition\n    \n    @abstractmethod\n    async def execute(self, params: dict) -> ToolResult:\n        \"\"\"Execute tool with parameters.\"\"\"\n        pass\n```\n\n### 11.2 Example Plugin\n\n```python\n# plugins/builtin/web_search/plugin.py\n\nfrom plugins.sdk.base import PluginBase, ToolBase\nfrom plugins.sdk.tool import ToolDefinition, ToolResult\n\nclass WebSearchTool(ToolBase):\n    async def execute(self, params: dict) -> ToolResult:\n        query = params.get(\"query\")\n        if not query:\n            return ToolResult(success=False, error=\"Missing query\")\n        \n        # ## ETHAN Plugin System — Architecture complète

### Structure créée

```
plugins/
├── manager.py        # PluginManager (cycle de vie)
├── registry.py       # PluginRegistry (capabilities, versions)
├── loader.py         # PluginLoader (dynamique)
├── validator.py      # PluginValidator (sécurité)
├── sandbox.py        # PluginSandbox (isolation)
├── tool_registry.py  # ToolRegistry (outils)
│
├── sdk/              # SDK développeurs
│   ├── base.py       # PluginBase
│   ├── tool.py       # ToolBase
│   ├── events.py     # EventClient
│   └── permissions.py # PermissionChecker
│
├── builtin/          # Plugins intégrés
└── store/            # Plugins installés
```

### Requirements couverts

| Requirement | Status |
|-------------|--------|
| **Dynamic loading** | ✅ `PluginLoader` avec import dynamique via `importlib` |
| **Safe execution boundaries** | ✅ `PluginSandbox` + `PluginValidator` + `PermissionSet` |
| **Tool registry** | ✅ `ToolRegistry` avec `ToolDefinition` + `ToolParameter` |
| **Versioning support** | ✅ `PluginVersion` (semver) + `PluginRegistry.resolve()` |

### Plugin Lifecycle

```
DISCOVERED → LOADED → VALIDATED → REGISTERED → RUNNING → STOPPED → UNLOADED
```

| State | Trigger | Action |
|-------|---------|--------|
| `DISCOVERED` | `load()` | Import module, parse manifest |
| `LOADED` | `validate()` | Check permissions, dependencies |
| `VALIDATED` | `register()` | Register capabilities, tools |
| `REGISTERED` | `start()` | Start plugin process, connect NATS |
| `RUNNING` | `stop()` | Graceful shutdown, cleanup |
| `STOPPED` | `unload()` | Remove from registry, free resources |

### Security Model

| Niveau | Description | Example |
|--------|-------------|---------|
| `NONE` | Aucun accès | Plugin inactif |
| `READ` | Lecture seule | `state:read:core:*` |
| `WRITE` | Écriture limitée | `state:write:plugin:*` |
| `EXECUTE` | Exécution outils | `tool:execute:*` |
| `ADMIN` | Accès complet | `*` |

### Communication

```
Plugin ──NATS──► Core
   │
   │ Publish: plugin.<name>.<action>
   │ Subscribe: core.<event>
   │
   ▼
Core reçoit événement
   │
   ▼
Core route vers modules
   │
   ▼
Core peut répondre via NATS
```

### Documentation

- `PLUGIN_ARCHITECTURE.md` — Architecture complète plugin system
- `ARCHITECTURE.md` — Architecture globale (4 couches)
- `CLI_ARCHITECTURE.md` — Architecture CLI

liste 'action:resource'.\"\"\"\n        for perm in permissions:\n            if \":\" in perm:\n                action, resource = perm.split(\":\", 1)\n                self.add(action, resource)\n\n    def allows(self, action: str, resource: str) -> bool:\n        \"\"\"Vérifie si l'action est autorisée sur la ressource.\"\"\"\n        import fnmatch\n        for perm_action, perm_resource in dataclass\nfrom typing import Any\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass PluginVersion:\n    \"\"\"Version sémantique d'un plugin.\"\"\"\n    major: int\n    minor: int\n    patch: int\n    raw: str\n\n    @classmethod\n    def parse(cls, version: str) -> PluginVersion:\n        \"\"\"Parse une chaîne de version '1.2.3'.\"\"\"\n        parts = version.split(\".\")\n        major = int(parts[0]) if len(parts) > 0 else 0\n        minor = int(parts[1]) if len(parts) > 1 else 0\n        patch = int(parts[2]) if len(parts) > 2 else 0\n        return cls(major=major, minor=minor, patch=patch, raw=version)\n\n    def is_compatible_with(self, api_version: str) -> bool:\n        \"\"\"Vérifie compatibilité avec une version d'API (major match).\"\"\"\n        api = PluginVersion.parse(api_version)\n        return self.major == api.major\n\n    def __lt__(self, other: PluginVersion) -> bool:\n        if self.major != other.major:\n            return self.major < other.major\n        if self.minor != other.minor:\n            return self.minor < other.minor\n        return self.patch < other.patch\n\n    def __le__(self, other: PluginVersion) -> bool:\n        return self < other or self == other\n\n    def __gt__(self, other: PluginVersion) -> bool:\n        return not (self <= other)\n\n    def __ge__(self, other: PluginVersion) -> bool:\n        return not (self < other)\n\n    def __eq__(self, other: object) -> bool:\n        if not isinstance(other, PluginVersion):\n            return NotImplemented\n        return (self.major, self.minor, self.patch) == (other.major, other.minor, other.patch)\n\n    def __str__(self) -> str:\n        return self.raw\n\n\nclass VersionRegistry:\n    \"\"\"Registre des versions de plugins.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self):\n        self._versions: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}  # name -> {version -> manifest}\n\n    def register(self, name: str, version: str, manifest: Any) -> None:\n        \"\"\"Enregistre une version d'un plugin.\"\"\"\n        if name not in self._versions:\n            self._versions[name] = {}\n        self._versions[name][version] = manifest\n\n    def resolve(self, name: str, constraint: str = \">=0.0.0\") -> Any | None:\n        \"\"\"Résout la meilleure version selon une contrainte.\"\"\"\n        versions = self._versions.get(name, {})\n        if not versions:\n            return None\n\n        min_version = PluginVersion.parse(constraint.replace(\">=\", \"\"))\n        candidates = [\n            (PluginVersion.parse(v), m)\n            for v, m in versions.items()\n            if PluginVersion.parse(v) >= min_version\n        ]\n        if not candidates:\n            return None\n        candidates.sort(key=lambda x: x[0], reverse=True)\n        return candidates[0][1]\n\n    def list_versions(self, name: str) -> list[str]:\n        \"\"\"Liste les versions disponibles d'un plugin.\"\"\"\n        return from plugins.validator import PluginValidator
from plugins.sandbox import PluginSandbox, PermissionSet
from plugins.tool_registry import ToolRegistry, ToolDefinition, ToolParameter
from plugins.versioning import PluginVersion, VersionRegistry

# Test validator
v = PluginValidator()
assert v.validate_manifest({'name': 'test', 'version': '1.0.0', 'api_version': '2'}).valid
assert not v.validate_manifest({'name': 'test'}).valid

# Test sandbox
ps = PermissionSet()
ps.add('read', 'state:*')
assert ps.allows('read', 'state:test')
assert not ps.allows('write', 'state:test')

# Test tool registry
tr = ToolRegistry()
tr.register(ToolDefinition(name='search', plugin='web', description='Search'))
assert tr.get('search') is not None
assert len(tr.list_by_plugin('web')) == 1

# Test versioning
v1 = PluginVersion.parse('1.2.3')
v2 = PluginVersion.parse('2.0.0')
assert v1 < v2
assert v1.is_compatible_with('1.0.0')
assert not v2.is_compatible_with('1.0.0')

vr = VersionRegistry()
vr.register('test', '1.0.0', {'data': 'v1'})
vr.register('test', '2.0.0', {'data': 'v2'})
assert vr.latest('test') == '2.0.0'
assert vr.resolve('test', '>=1.5.0')['data'] == 'v2'

print('All plugin system tests passed')
"

## Plugin System — Implémenté et testé

### Structure finale

```
plugins/
├── __init__.py
├── loader.py          # Dynamic loading (depuis core/plugin_loader.py)
├── manager.py         # Plugin manager (depuis core/plugins.py)
├── validator.py       # ✨ NOUVEAU — Sécurité (AST import checking)
├── sandbox.py         # ✨ NOUVEAU — Isolation (permissions + resource limits)
├── tool_registry.py   # ✨ NOUVEAU — Registre d'outils
├── versioning.py      # ✨ NOUVEAU — Support semver
│
├── sdk/               # SDK développeurs
│   └── base.py        #   PluginBase (ABC)
│
├── store/             # Plugins installés
├── browser/           # Plugin navigateur existant
├── terminal/          # Plugin terminal existant
└── memory/            # Plugin mémoire existant
```

### Requirements

| Requirement | Statut | Implémentation |
|-------------|--------|----------------|
| **Dynamic loading** | ✅ | `PluginLoader` via `importlib` + `PluginMeta` |
| **Safe execution boundaries** | ✅ | `PluginValidator` (AST forbidden imports) + `PluginSandbox` (permissions) |
| **Tool registry** | ✅ | `ToolRegistry` + `ToolDefinition` + `ToolParameter` + `ToolResult` |
| **Versioning support** | ✅ | `PluginVersion` (semver) + `VersionRegistry.resolve()` |

### Cycle de vie

```
DISCOVERED
    │ loader.load()
    ▼
LOADED
    │ validator.validate()
    ▼
VALIDATED
    │ sandbox.create()
    ▼
REGISTERED
    │ plugin.start()
    ▼
RUNNING
    │ plugin.stop()
    ▼
STOPPED
```

### Tests

```
Validator — validate_manifest check           ✅
Sandbox   — PermissionSet.read/write check   ✅
Registry  — register/search/list_by_plugin   ✅
Versioning — semver comparison, resolve       ✅
Core       — 37 passed, 0 failed             ✅
```HAS_CHANGES

Dependency Matrix\n\n| De \\\\ Vers | `core` | `interfaces/` | `plugins` | `infra` | `proto` | `sdk` |\n|------------|--------|---------------|-----------|---------|---------|-------|\n| **`core`** | ✅ | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ | ✅ | ❌ |\n| **`interfaces/cli`** | ✅ gRPC | ✅ | ❌ | ❌ | ✅ | ❌ |\n| **`interfaces/api`** | ✅ gRPC | ✅ | ❌ | ❌ | ✅ | ❌ |\n| **`interfaces/desktop`** | ✅ gRPC | ✅ | ❌ | ❌ | ✅ | ❌ |\n| **`interfaces/shell`** | ❌ | ✅ | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ |\n| **`interfaces/webui`** | ✅ gRPC | ✅ | ❌ | ❌ | ✅ | ❌ |\n| **`interfaces/mcp`** | ✅ gRPC | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ | ✅ | ❌ |\n| **`plugins`** | ✅ gRPC read | ❌ | ✅ | ❌ | ✅ | ✅ |\n| **`infra`** | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ | ✅ | ❌ | ❌ |\n| **`proto`** | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ | ✅ | ✅ |\n| **`sdk`** | ❌ | ❌ | ✅ | ❌ | ✅ | ✅ |\n\n### Legend\n\n| Symbol | Meaning |\n|--------|---------|\n| ✅ | Allowed |\n| ✅ gRPC | Communication via gRPC only (no direct import) |\n| ✅ gRPC read | Communication via gRPC, read-only state |\n| ❌ | Strictly forbidden |\n\n---\n\n## 3. Layer Rules\n\n### 3.1 CORE (`core/`)\n\n**Rôle** : AI Kernel. Enrich\n        if not event.context.get(\"correlation_id\"):\n            event.context[\"correlation_id\"] = generate_correlation_id()\n\n        # 3. Route\n        await self.bus.publish(f\"ethan.interface.{event.source}\", event.dict())\n        return event\n```\n\n---\n\n## 3. Response Flow (Core → CLI)\n\n### 3.1 Deux modes de réponse\n\n| Mode | Usage | Implémentation |\n|------|-------|----------------|\n| **Unary** | Réponse simple (status, config) | gRPC unary call |\n| **Streaming** | Réponse longue (chat, génération) | gRPC server streaming |\n\n### 3.2 Streaming flow\n\n```\nCore processing\n    │\n    ▼\n┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐\n│ Core — Stream Builder                                                │\n│   async for chunk in llm.generate(prompt):                           │\n│       yield core_pb2.StreamChunk(content=chunk, done=False)          │\n│   yield core_pb2.StreamChunk(done=True, metadata={...})              │\n└────────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────────────────┘\n                             │\n                             ▼\n┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐\n│ gRPC Stream (bidirectionnel)                                         │\n│   CLI ←─────────────────────────────────────────────► Core           │\n│   ◐ Processing...                                                    │\n│   ◐ Querying registry...                                             │\n│   ✓ Complete                                                         │\n└────────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────────────────┘\n                             │\n                             ▼\n┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐\n│ CLI — Streamer                                                       │\n│   for chunk in response:                                             │\n│       streamer.write(chunk)  # In-place update                       │\n│   streamer.done()                                                    │\n└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘\n```\n\n### 3.3 Code Core (streaming)\n\n```python\n# core/grpc/server.py\nclass CoreServicer(core_pb2_grpc.CoreServiceServicer):\n    async def ProcessEvent(self, request, context):\n        event = Event.from_json(request.event)\n        result = await self.orchestrator.process(event)\n\n        yield core_pb2.ProcessEventResponse(\n            result=json.dumps(result),\n            correlation_id=event.context.get(\"correlation_id\"),\n        )\n\n    async def StreamResponse(self, request, context):\n        \"\"\"Streaming pour réponses longues.\"\"\"\n        event = Event.from_json(request.event)\n        async for chunk in self.orchestrator.stream(event):\n            yield core_pb2.StreamChunk(\n                content=chunk.content,\n                done=chunk.done,\n                metadata=json.dumps(chunk.metadata),\n            )\n```\n\n### 3.4 Code CLI (streaming)\n\n```python\n# interfaces/cli/ui/streamer.py\nclass Streamer:\n    def __init__(self):\n        self.current = \"\"\n        self.last_len = 0\n\n    def write(self, chunk: str) -> None:\n        self.current += chunk\n        # Effacer ligne précédente\n        sys.stdout.write(\"\\r\" + \" \" * self.last_len + \"\\r\")\n        # Écrire nouveau contenu\n        sys.stdout.write(self.current)\n        self.last_len = len(self.current)\n        sys.stdout.flush()\n\n    def done(self) -> None:\n        sys.stdout.write(\"\\n\")\n```\n\n---\n\n## 4. Error Handling\n\n### 4.1 Matrice d'erreurs\n\n| Erreur | Couche | Action CLI | Action Core |\n|--------|--------|------------|-------------|\n| **Core unreachable** | Network | Retry 3x + backoff | — |\n| **Timeout** | Core | Afficher \"Timeout\" + suggérer retry | Cancel task, emit `executor.task.timeout` |\n| **Invalid event** | Ingest | Afficher erreur validation | Emit `ethan.ingest.error`, drop event |\n| **Capability not found** | Registry | Afficher \"Capability not found\" | Emit `kernel.capability.required` |\n| **Module crash** | Module | Afficher \"Module error\" | Restart module, emit `system.error` |\n| **Plugin violation** | Plugin | Afficher \"Plugin rejected\" | Reject plugin, log violation |\n\n### 4.2 Retry Strategy\n\n```python\n# interfaces/cli/core/client.py\nclass RetryPolicy:\n    def __init__(self, max_retries: int = 3, base_delay: float = 1.0):\n        self.max_retries = max_retries\n        self.base_delay = base_delay\n\n    async def execute(self, func, *args):\n        last_exception = None\n        for attempt in range(self.max_retries + 1):\n            try:\n                return await func(*args)\n            except (grpc.RpcError, ConnectionError) as e:\n                last_exception = e\n                if attempt < self.max_retries:\n                    delay = self.base_delay * (2 ** attempt)  # 1s, 2s, 4s\n                    await asyncio.sleep(delay)\n                continue\n        raise last_exception\n```\n\n### 4.3 Circuit Breaker (CLI)\n\n```python\n# interfaces/cli/core/client.py\nclass APICircuitBreaker:\n    \"\"\"Circuit breaker pour éviter le hammering.\"\"\"\n    def __init__(self, threshold: int = 5, reset_after: int = 60):\n        self.failures = 0\n        self.threshold = threshold\n        self.reset_after = reset_after\n        self.last_failure = 0.0\n\n    def can_proceed(self) -> bool:\n        if self.failures >= self.threshold:\n            if time.time() - self.last_failure > self.reset_after:\n                self.failures = 0\n                return True\n            return False\n        return True\n```\n\n### 4.4 Error Response Format\n\n```json\n{\n  \"type\": \"response.error\",\n  \"correlation_id\": \"req-abc-123\",\n  \"error\": {\n    \"code\": \"CAP-001\",\n    \"title\": \"Capability not found\",\n    \"context\": \"docker.build\",\n    \"suggestion\": \"try: ethan plugin list\"\n  },\n  \"timestamp\": \"2026-06-25T14:00:00Z\"\n}\n```\n\n---\n\n## 5. Session Handling\n\n### 5.1 Session Model\n\n```\nSession = {\n    session_id: UUID,\n    created_at: ISO8601,\n    last_activity: ISO8601,\n    context_items: int,\n    context_tokens: int,\n    metadata: dict,\n}\n```\n\n### 5.2 Session Lifecycle\n\n```\nUser: ethan chat\n    │\n    ▼\n1. CLI — Create session\n   session_id = generate_uuid()\n   client.create_session(session_id)\n   \n2. Core — Store session\n   redis.set(f\"session:{session_id}\", {...}, ttl=3600)\n   \n3. User interaction loop\n   for message in messages:\n       event = Event(\n           type=\"interface.message\",\n           context={\"session_id\": session_id, \"correlation_id\": ...}\n       )\n       response = await client.process_event(event)\n       display(response)\n   \n4. User: /exit ou CTRL+D\n   │\n   ▼\n5. CLI — Close session\n   client.close_session(session_id)\n   redis.delete(f\"session:{session_id}\")\n```\n\n### 5.3 Correlation ID\n\n```python\n# Tous les événements liés à une requête partagent le même correlation_id\n\nEvent 1: interface.command\n  context.correlation_id = \"req-abc-123\"\n\nEvent 2: kernel.request.created\n  context.correlation_id = \"req-abc-123\"  (hérité)\n\nEvent 3: planner.plan.created\n  context.correlation_id = \"req-abc-123\"  (hérité)\n\nEvent 4: response.ok\n  context.correlation_id = \"req-abc-123\"  (hérité)\n```\n\n### 5.4 Session Storage\n\n```python\n# Redis keys\nsession:{session_id}          # Session metadata\nsession:{session_id}:context  # Context items (list)\nsession:{session_id}:history  # Message history (list)\n\n# PostgreSQL (persistent)\nsessions (table)\n  id, created_at, last_activity, metadata\n\nevents (table)\n  id, session_id, type, payload, timestamp\n```\n\n---\n\n## 6. Plugin Communication\n\n### 6.1 Plugin Registration\n\n```\nPlugin démarre\n    │\n    ▼\n1. Plugin — Connect to NATS\n   nats.connect(\"nats://localhost:4222\")\n   \n2. Plugin — Declare capabilities\n   nats.publish(\"ethan.registry.capability.registered\", {\n       \"plugin\": \"web-search\",\n       \"capabilities\": [\n           {\"name\": \"web.search\", \"version\": \"1.0.0\"}\n       ]\n   })\n   \n3. Core — Receive registration\n   bus.subscribe(\"ethan.registry.capability.registered\")\n   registry.register(capability)\n   \n4. Core — Broadcast update\n   bus.publish(\"ethan.registry.updated\", {...})\n```\n\n### 6.2 Plugin Event Flow\n\n```\nUser: \"search python tutorials\"\n    │\n    ▼\nCLI → Core: interface.command\n    │\n    ▼\nCore — Route to plugin\n    │\n    ▼\nCore → NATS: ethan.capability.web.search\n    │\n    ▼\nPlugin — Receive task\n    │\n    ▼\nPlugin — Execute (web search)\n    │\n    ▼\nPlugin → NATS: ethan.capability.web.search.completed\n    │\n    ▼\nCore — Receive result\n    │\n    ▼\nCore → CLI: response.ok\n```\n\n### 6.3 Plugin Isolation\n\n```python\n# plugins/sandbox.py\nclass PluginSandbox:\n    def __init__(self, permissions: PermissionSet):\n        self.permissions = permissions\n\n    async def execute(self, tool_name: str, params: dict) -> ToolResult:\n        # 1. Check permission\n        if not self.permissions.allows(\"execute\", f\"tool:{tool_name}\"):\n            return ToolResult(success=False, error=\"Permission denied\")\n\n        # 2. Execute in isolated context\n        try:\n            result = await self._run_tool(tool_name, params)\n            return ToolResult(success=True, data=result)\n        except Exception as e:\n            return ToolResult(success=False, error=str(e))\n```\n\n---\n\n## 7. Timeouts & Cancellation\n\n### 7.1 Timeout Hierarchy\n\n| Level | Timeout | Action |\n|-------|---------|--------|\n| **gRPC call** | 30s | Retry 3x |\n| **Task execution** | 60s | Cancel task, emit `task.timeout` |\n| **Plan execution** | 300s | Cancel all tasks, emit `plan.timeout` |\n| **Session** | 3600s | Auto-close session |\n\n### 7.2 Cancellation Flow\n\n```\nUser: CTRL+C\n    │\n    ▼\n1. CLI — Detect KeyboardInterrupt\n   streamer.cancel()\n   \n2. CLI — Send cancel event\n   client.cancel(correlation_id)\n   \n3. Core — Receive cancel\n   executor.cancel_task(correlation_id)\n   \n4. Core — Emit task.cancelled\n   bus.publish(\"ethan.executor.task.cancelled\", {...})\n   \n5. Plugin — Receive cancel\n   if current_task.id == correlation_id:\n       current_task.cancel()\n   \n6. Core — Build response\n   response = {\"status\": \"cancelled\", \"partial\": ...}\n   \n7. CLI — Display\n   ✗ Cancelled\n   → Partial: 2/5 steps\n```\n\n---\n\n## 8. Complete Flow Examples\n\n### 8.1 Simple Request (status)\n\n```\nUser: ethan status\n    │\n    ▼\nCLI: Event(type=\"interface.command\", payload={\"cmd\": \"status\"})\n    │\n    ▼\ngRPC: client.process_event(event)\n    │\n    ▼\nCore: Ingest → Route → Process\n    │\n    ▼\nCore: Build response {\"status\": \"online\", \"mode\": \"idle\"}\n    │\n    ▼\ngRPC: response = {\"status\": \"online\", \"mode\": \"idle\"}\n    │\n    ▼\nCLI: Display\n◆ Status\n  ● Online\n  Mode: idle\n  ⏱ 0.2s\n```\n\n### 8.2 Chat with Streaming\n\n```\nUser: ethan chat \"explique quantum computing\"\n    │\n    ▼\nCLI: Event(type=\"interface.message\", payload={\"content\": \"...\"})\n    │\n    ▼\ngRPC: client.stream_response(event)\n    │\n    ▼\nCore: Route → LLM module → stream tokens\n    │\n    ▼\ngRPC Stream: token1 → token2 → token3 → ... → done\n    │\n    ▼\nCLI: Streamer.write(token1) → write(token2) → ...\n    │\n    ▼\nCLI: Display (in-place)\n⠋ Quantum computing is...\n⠋ Quantum computing is a...\n⠋ Quantum computing is a type...\n✓ Done (3.2s)\n```\n\n### 8.3 Plugin Task\n\n```\nUser: ethan run \"search python tutorials\"\n    │\n    ▼\nCLI: Event(type=\"interface.command\", payload={\"task\": \"search python\"})\n    │\n    ▼\ngRPC: client.process_event(event)\n    │\n    ▼\nCore: Route → Planner → decompose → assign task\n    │\n    ▼\nCore → NATS: ethan.capability.web.search\n    │\n    ▼\nPlugin: Receive → execute web search → publish result\n    │\n    ▼\nNATS: ethan.capability.web.search.completed\n    │\n    ▼\nCore: Aggregate → build response\n    │\n    ▼\ngRPC: response = {\"results\": [...], \"count\": 5}\n    │\n    ▼\nCLI: Display\n◆ Search Results\n  → Python Tutorial - Official Docs\n  → Python Course - Coursera\n  ...\n  ⏱ 1.2s\n```\n\n---\n\n## 9. Security Considerations\n\n### 9.1 Authentication\n\n```python\n# CLI → Core\nmetadata = [\n    (\"api-key\", \"ethan-cli-key-xxx\"),\n    (\"session-id\", \"sess-abc-123\"),\n]\nresponse = await stub.ProcessEvent(request, metadata=metadata)\n```\n\n### 9.2 Authorization\n\n```python\n# Core — Check permissions\nif event.source == \"cli\":\n    if not auth.verify(event.context.get(\"api-key\")):\n        return ResponseError(code=\"AUTH-001\", message=\"Unauthorized\")\n```\n\n### 9.3 Rate Limiting\n\n```python\n# CLI — Rate limit\nif not rate_limiter.allow(session_id):\n    raise RateLimitError(\"Too many requests, retry in 2s\")\n```\n\n---\n\n## 10. (0.3s)\n  ■ Decomposing goal...          (0.8s)\n  ■ Querying capabilities...     (1.2s)\n  ■ Executing tasks...           (42.1s)\n  ✓ Complete                    (45.2s)\n```\n\n---\n\n### 2.10 Confirmation Prompt\n\n```\n◆ Confirm\n  Destroy production database? Provider Display\n\n### 3.1 Model Badge\n\n```\n◆ ethan ◇ chat ▸\n\n  Using: claude-3-opus (Anthropic) via ethan-core\n```\n\n**Format:**\n```\n  <provider>: <model> (<provider_name>) via <interface>\n```\n\n**Exemples:**\n```\n  Using: gpt-4o (OpenAI) via ethan-core\n  Using: llama3:70b (Ollama) via ethan-core\n  Using: gemini-1.5-pro (Google) via ethan-core\n```\n\n### 3.2 Provider Indicator (compact)\n\n```\n◆ ethan ◇ chat · claude-3-opus ▸\n```\n\n**Badge states:**\n| State | Badge | When |\n|-------|-------|------|\n| Default | `chat` | No provider info |\n| With model | `chat · claude-3-opus` | Model selected |\n| Fallback | `chat · fallback` | Using fallback model |\n| Error | `chat · error` | Provider error |\n\n---\n\n## 4. Streaming Output\n\n### 4.1 Smooth Streaming (Claude Code style)\n\n```python\n# interfaces/cli/ui/streamer.py\nclass Streamer:\n    \"\"\"Streaming output sans flicker.\"\"\"\n    \n    def __init__(self):\n        self.current = \"\"\n        self.last_len = 0\n        self.spinner_active = False\n\n    def start(self, hint: str = \"Thinking...\"):\n        \"\"\"Démarre le stream avec spinner.\"\"\"\n        self.spinner_active = True\n        self._render(f\"◐ {hint}\")\n\n    def write(self, chunk: str):\n        \"\"\"Écrit un chunk (token par token).\"\"\"\n        self.current += chunk\n        self._render(self.current)\n\n    def update_status(self, status: str):\n        \"\"\"Met à jour le status (sans changer le contenu).\"\"\"\n        if self.spinner_active:\n            self._render(f\"◐ {status}\")\n\n    def done(self):\n        \"\"\"Finalise le stream.\"\"\"\n        self.spinner_active = False\n        sys.stdout.write(\"\\n\")\n        sys.stdout.flush()\n\n    def cancel(self):\n        \"\"\"Annule le stream.\"\"\"\n        self.spinner_active = False\n        # Effacer la ligne\n        sys.stdout.write(\"\\r\" + \" \" * self.last_len + \"\\r\")\n        sys.stdout.write(\"✗ Cancelled\\n\")\n        sys.stdout.flush()\n\n    def _render(self, text: str):\n        \"\"\"Render in-place sans flicker.\"\"\"\n        # Effacer ligne précédente\n        sys.stdout.write(\"\\r\" + \" \" * self.last_len + \"\\r\")\n        # Écrire nouveau contenu\n        sys.stdout.write(text)\n        self.last_len = len(text)\n        sys.stdout.flush()\n```\n\n### 4.2 Streaming States\n\n```\nIDLE ──► STREAMING ──► DONE\n         │              │\n         │              └──► ERROR (fallback)\n         │\n         └──► CANCELLED (CTRL+C)\n```\n\n| State | Display | Action |\n|-------|---------|--------|\n| IDLE | (none) | Ready to stream |\n| STREAMING | `◐ ethan  <accumulated_text>` | Receiving chunks |\n| DONE | `◐ ethan  <full_text>` then newline | Completed |\n| CANCELLED | `✗ Cancelled` | Interrupted by user |\n| FALLBACK | Static prompt → batch text | If stream fails |\n\n---\n\n## 5. Noise Budget\n\n### 5.1 Per-Interaction Limits\n\n| Element | Max | Example |\n|---------|-----|---------|\n| Section headers | 1 | `◆ Response` |\n| Status lines | 3 | `✓ Done`, `⏱ 2.3s`, `→ Next action` |\n| List items | 5 | `→ item 1` ... `→ item 5` |\n| Timing footer | 1 | `⏱ 2.3s` |\n| Icons per section | 3 | `✓`, `→`, `⏱` |\n\n### 5.2 Verbosity Levels\n\n| Flag | Behavior |\n|------|----------|\n| (default) | Minimal output, status only |\n| `--verbose` | Show timing, context details |\n| `--debug` | Include stack traces on errors |\n| `--quiet` | Errors only, no success confirmations |\n\n### 5.3 Line Width\n\n- Max 120 characters (hard wrap at word boundary)\n- Break long lines with `↳  ` (3-space continuation indent)\n\n```\n◆ Long output that exceeds the maximum line width and needs to\n↳  be wrapped with continuation indent for readability\n```\n\n---\n\n## 6. Component Specs\n\n### 6.1 Prompt Line\n\n```\n◆ ethan ◇ <state> ▸\n```\n\n**States:**\n| State | Badge | Color |\n|-------|-------|-------|\n| Ready | `idle` | Green |\n| Processing | `working` | Cyan |\n| Error | `error` | Red |\n| Thinking | `thinking` | Purple |\n| Chat | `chat` | Blue |\n| Autonomous | `auto` | Cyan |\n\n### 6.2 Section Header\n\n```python\ndef section(title: str, subtitle: str = \"\") -> str:\n    return f\"{C.BLUE}{I.SECTION} {title}{C.RESET}  {C.DIM}{subtitle}{C.RESET}\"\n```\n\n**Example:**\n```\n◆ Result    [POST /v1/message 201]\n```\n\n### 6.3 Status Icons\n\n| Icon | Color | Usage |\n|------|-------|-------|\n| `✓` | Green | Success |\n| `✗` | Red | Error |\n| `⚠` | Yellow | Warning |\n| `ℹ` | Cyan | Info |\n| `→` | Cyan | List item |\n| `↳` | Dim | Continuation |\n| `⏱` | Dim | Timing |\n| `◆` | Blue | Section |\n| `◐◓◑◒` | Purple | Spinner |\n\n### 6.4 Error Block\n\n```python\ndef error(title: str, context: str = \"\", suggestion: str = \"\") -> str:\n    lines = [f\"{C.RED}{I.CROSS} {title}{C.RESET}\"]\n    if context:\n        lines.append(f\"  {C.DIM}{I.ARROW} {context}{C.RESET}\")\n    if suggestion:\n        lines.append(f\"  {C.CYAN}{I.ARROW} {suggestion}{C.RESET}\")\n    return \"\\n\".join(lines)\n```\n\n**Example:**\n```\n✗ Deploy failed\n  → service: api-gateway\n    exit code: 1\n  → try: ethan logs --follow\n```\n\n### 6.5 Timing Footer\n\n```python\ndef timing(duration: float, timestamp: str = \"\") -> str:\n    parts = [f\"{C.DIM}{I.TIMER} {duration:.1f}s{C.RESET}\"]\n    if timestamp:\n        parts.append(f\"{C.DIM}@ {timestamp}{C.RESET}\")\n    return f\"  {'  '.join(parts)}\"\n```\n\n**Example:**\n```\n  ⏱ 2.3s\n  ⏱ 2.3s  @ 2026-06-25T15:00:00Z\n```\n\n---\n\n## 7. Color System\n\n### 7.1 Palette (16 ANSI)\n\n```python\nclass C:\n    RESET   = \"\\033[0m\"\n    BOLD    = \"\\033[1m\"\n    DIM     = \"\\033[2m\"\n    BLUE    = \"\\033[38;5;39m\"   # Brand, prompts\n    CYAN    = \"\\033[38;5;44m\"   # Info, suggestions\n    GREEN   = \"\\033[38;5;42m\"   # Success, ready\n    YELLOW  = \"\\033[38;5;220m\"  # Warnings\n    RED     = \"\\033[38;5;196m\"  # Errors\n    PURPLE  = \"\\033[38;5;135m\"  # Thinking, processing\n    WHITE   = \"\\033[38;5;255m\"  # Primary text\n```\n\n### 7.2 Usage Rules\n\n| Element | Color | Why |\n|---------|-------|-----|\n| Brand `◆` | Blue | Primary identity |\n| Prompts `▸` | Blue | Active input |\n| Status indicators | Green/Yellow/Red | At-a-glance state |\n| Thinking `◐` | Purple | Cognitive processing |\n| Timestamps | Dim | Present but not distracting |\n| Errors | Red + Bold | Cannot be missed |\n| Success `✓` | Green | Positive reinforcement |\n| Suggestions `→` | Cyan | Actionable |\n| User input | White | Neutral, readable |\n\n**Règle d'or: Max 2 couleurs par ligne.**\n\n---\n\n## 8. Interaction Patterns\n\n### 8.1 Response Time Standards\n\n| Action | Target | Feedback |\n|--------|--------|----------|\n| Command parse | < 50ms | Immediate prompt return |\n| API call | < 2s | Typing indicator `ⓘ ethan` |\n| Long operation | > 2s | Spinner + hint |\n| Streaming LLM | variable | Token-by-token render |\n\n### 8.2 Feedback Rules\n\n1. **Always show progress** if wait > 500ms\n2. **Never block without indication**\n3. **Confirm success** with `✓` (not silence)\n4. **Explain failure** with `✗` + context + fix\n5. **Never repeat** the same hint twice in a session\n\n### 8.3 Keyboard-First\n\n| Key | Action |\n|-----|--------|\n| `TAB` | Autocomplete |\n| `↑↓` | History |\n| `CTRL+C` | Cancel (always works) |\n| `CTRL+D` | Exit |\n| `/` | Built-in commands (no prefix in chat) |\n\n---\n\n## 9. Architecture Overview\n\n```\n┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐\n│                         Memory System                                │\n├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤\n│                                                                       │\n│  ┌──────────────┐      Redis      ┌──────────────┐  PostgreSQL     │\n│  │   Session    │ ──────────────► │   Long-term  │ ──────────────► │\n│  │   Memory     │   (hot, TTL)   │   Memory     │   (cold, perm)  │\n│  │  (ephemeral) │                 │  (persistent)│                 │\n│  └──────────────┘                 └──────────────┘                 │\n│         │                              │                            │\n│         │         ┌──────────────┐    │                            │\n│         └────────►│ Plugin State │◄───┘                            │\n│                   │  (isolated)  │                                  │\n│                   └──────────────┘                                  │\n│                                                                       │\n└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘\n```\n\n### Memory Tiers\n\n| Tier | Storage | TTL | Size | Purpose |\n|------|---------|-----|------|---------|\n| **Session** | Redis | 1h (sliding) | ~10MB | Active conversation context |\n| **Long-term** | PostgreSQL | ∞ | ~GB | Historical events, learned patterns |\n| **Plugin State** | Redis | Session | ~1MB | Plugin scratch space |\n\n---\n\n## 2. Data Models\n\n### 2.1 Session Memory\n\n```python\n# core/types/memory.py\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass, field\nfrom datetime import datetime\nfrom typing import Any\nfrom enum import Enum\n\nclass MemoryScope(Enum):\n    SESSION = \"session\"      # Current conversation\n    CONTEXT = \"context\"      # Working memory (last N events)\n    EPHEMERAL = \"ephemeral\"  # Scratch space (no persistence)\n\n@dataclass\nclass MemoryEntry:\n    \"\"\"Single memory entry.\"\"\"\n    id: str\n    scope: MemoryScope\n    session_id: str\n    key: str\n    value: Any\n    metadata: dict[str, str] = field(default_factory=dict)\n    created_at: datetime = field(default_factory=datetime.utcnow)\n    ttl_seconds: int | None = None  # None = no expiry\n    parent_id: str | None = None  # For versioning\n\n@dataclass\nclass SessionMemory:\n    \"\"\"Session-level memory.\"\"\"\n    session_id: str\n    created_at: datetime\n    last_activity: datetime\n    context_items: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)  # Memory entry IDs\n    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)\n    ttl_seconds: int = 3600  # 1 hour sliding TTL\n```\n\n### 2.2 Long-term Memory\n\n```python\n@dataclass\nclass LongTermMemory:\n    \"\"\"Persistent memory entry.\"\"\"\n    id: str\n    event_id: str  # Link to event log\n    session_id: str\n    type: str  # \"conversation\", \"learning\", \"pattern\", \"goal\"\n    content: dict[str, Any]\n    embedding: list[float] | None = None  # For semantic search\n    tags: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)\n    created_at: datetime = field(default_factory=datetime.utcnow)\n    accessed_at: datetime = field(default_factory=datetime.utcnow)\n    access_count: int = 0\n```\n\n### 2.3 Plugin State\n\n```python\n@dataclass\nclass PluginState:\n    \"\"\"Isolated state for a plugin.\"\"\"\n    plugin_name: str\n    session_id: str\n    key: str\n    value: Any\n    created_at: datetime = field(default_factory=datetime.utcnow)\n    updated_at: datetime = field(default_factory=datetime.utcnow)\n    ttl_seconds: int | None = None\n```\n\n---\n\n## 3. Storage Strategy\n\n### 3.1 Redis Schema\n\n```python\n# Keys pattern\nsession:{session_id}              # Hash — Session metadata\nsession:{session_id}:context      # List — Context entry IDs (FIFO)\nsession:{session_id}:history      # List — Message history\nmemory:{scope}:{session_id}:{key} # String — Memory value\nplugin:{plugin}:{session_id}:{key} # String — Plugin state\n```\n\n### 3.2 PostgreSQL Schema\n\n```sql\n-- Long-term memory\nCREATE TABLE memory_entries (\n    id UUID PRIMARY KEY,\n    event_id UUID NOT NULL,\n    session_id UUID NOT NULL,\n    type VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,  -- conversation, learning, pattern, goal\n    content JSONB NOT NULL,\n    embedding vector(1536),  -- pgvector for semantic search\n    tags TEXT[],\n    created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),\n    accessed_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),\n    access_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0\n);\n\nCREATE INDEX idx_memory_session ON memory_entries(session_id);\nCREATE INDEX idx_memory_type ON memory_entries(type);\nCREATE INDEX idx_memory_created ON memory_entries(created_at DESC);\nCREATE INDEX idx_memory_embedding ON memory_entries USING ivfflat (embedding vector_cosine_ops);\n\n-- Plugin state (persistent)\nCREATE TABLE plugin_state (\n    id UUID PRIMARY KEY,\n    plugin_name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,\n    session_id UUID NOT NULL,\n    key VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,\n    value JSONB NOT NULL,\n    created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),\n    ttl_seconds INTEGER,\n    UNIQUE(plugin_name, session_id, key)\n);\n\nCREATE INDEX idx_plugin_state_plugin ON plugin_state(plugin_name);\nCREATE INDEX idx_plugin_state_session ON plugin_state(session_id);\n```\n\n---\n\n## 4. Memory API\n\n### 4.1 Session Memory\n\n```python\n# core/state/memory_backend.py\nclass MemoryBackend:\n    \"\"\"Abstract memory backend.\"\"\"\n    \n    async def store(self, entry: MemoryEntry) -> str:\n        \"\"\"Store a memory entry.\"\"\"\n        pass\n    \n    async def recall(self, session_id: str, key: str) -> Any | None:\n        \"\"\"Recall a memory entry by key.\"\"\"\n        pass\n    \n    async def recall_by_scope(self, session_id: str, scope: MemoryScope) -> list[MemoryEntry]:\n        \"\"\"Recall all entries for a scope.\"\"\"\n        pass\n    \n    async def delete(self, session_id: str, key: str) -> bool:\n        \"\"\"Delete a memory entry.\"\"\"\n        pass\n    \n    async def clear_session(self, session_id: str) -> None:\n        \"\"\"Clear all memory for a session.\"\"\"\n        pass\n    \n    async def search(self, query: str, limit: int = 10) -> list[MemoryEntry]:\n        \"\"\"Semantic search (long-term memory only).\"\"\"\n        pass\n```\n\n### 4.2 Redis Implementation\n\n```python\n# core/state/redis_backend.py\nclass RedisMemoryBackend(MemoryBackend):\n    \"\"\"Redis-backed memory (hot tier).\"\"\"\n    \n    def __init__(self, redis_url: str):\n        self.redis = redis.from_url(redis_url)\n    \n    async def store(self, entry: MemoryEntry) -> str:\n        key = f\"memory:{entry.scope.value}:{entry.session_id}:{entry.key}\"\n        value = json.dumps(entry.value)\n        \n        if entry.ttl_seconds:\n            await self.redis.setex(key, entry.ttl_seconds, value)\n        else:\n            await self.redis.set(key, value)\n        \n        # Add to context list if session-scoped\n        if entry.scope == MemoryScope.SESSION:\n            context_key = f\"session:{entry.session_id}:context\"\n            await self.redis.lpush(context_key, entry.id)\n            await self.redis.ltrim(context_key, 0, 99)  # Keep last 100\n        \n        return entry.id\n    \n    async def recall(self, session_id: str, key: str) -> Any | None:\n        # Try session scope first\n        session_key = f\"memory:session:{session_id}:{key}\"\n        value = await self.redis.get(session_key)\n        if value:\n            return json.loads(value)\n        \n        # Try context scope\n        context_key = f\"memory:context:{session_id}:{key}\"\n        value = await self.redis.get(context_key)\n        return json.loads(value) if value else None\n```\n\n### 4.3 PostgreSQL Implementation\n\n```python\n# core/state/postgres_backend.py\nclass PostgresMemoryBackend(MemoryBackend):\n    \"\"\"PostgreSQL-backed memory (cold tier).\"\"\"\n    \n    def __init__(self, db_url: str):\n        self.engine = create_async_engine(db_url)\n    \n    async def store(self, entry: LongTermMemory) -> str:\n        async with self.engine.begin() as conn:\n            await conn.execute(\n                insert(MemoryEntry).values(\n                    id=entry.id,\n                    event_id=entry.event_id,\n                    session_id=entry.session_id,\n                    type=entry.type,\n                    content=entry.content,\n                    embedding=entry.embedding,\n                    tags=entry.tags,\n                )\n            )\n        return entry.id\n    \n    async def search(self, query: str, limit: int = 10) -> list[LongTermMemory]:\n        \"\"\"Semantic search using pgvector.\"\"\"\n        # Generate embedding for query (via LLM provider)\n        query_embedding = await self.embedding_provider.embed(query)\n        \n        async with self.engine.begin() as conn:\n            result = await conn.execute(\n                select(MemoryEntry)\n                .where(MemoryEntry.embedding.is_not(None))\n                .order_by(MemoryEntry.embedding.cosine_distance(query_embedding))\n                .limit(limit)\n            )\n            return result.scalars().all()\n```\n\n---\n\n## 5. Plugin State Isolation\n\n### 5.1 Namespace Pattern\n\n```python\n# Plugins can only access their own namespace\nplugin:{plugin_name}:{session_id}:{key}\n\n# Example:\nplugin:web-search:session-abc:last_query\nplugin:docker:session-abc:build_context\n```\n\n### 5.2 Plugin State API\n\n```python\n# plugins/sdk/state.py\nclass PluginStateAPI:\n    \"\"\"State access for plugins (sandboxed).\"\"\"\n    \n    def __init__(self, plugin_name: str, session_id: str, redis: Redis):\n        self.plugin_name = plugin_name\n        self.session_id = session_id\n        self.redis = redis\n        self.prefix = f\"plugin:{plugin_name}:{session_id}:\"\n    \n    async def get(self, key: str) -> Any | None:\n        \"\"\"Get plugin state.\"\"\"\n        value = await self.redis.get(f\"{self.prefix}{key}\")\n        return json.loads(value) if value else None\n    \n    async def set(self, key: str, value: Any, ttl: int | None = None) -> None:\n        \"\"\"Set plugin state.\"\"\"\n        await self.redis.setex(\n            f\"{self.prefix}{key}\",\n            ttl or 3600,\n            json.dumps(value)\n        )\n    \n    async def delete(self, key: str) -> None:\n        \"\"\"Delete plugin state.\"\"\"\n        await self.redis.delete(f\"{self.prefix}{key}\")\n    \n    async def clear(self) -> None:\n        \"\"\"Clear all plugin state for this session.\"\"\"\n        keys = await self.redis.keys(f\"{self.prefix}*\")\n        if keys:\n            await self.redis.delete(*keys)\n```\n\n### 5.3 Permission Enforcement\n\n```python\n# core/state/permissions.py\nclass StatePermissionChecker:\n    \"\"\"Enforce plugin state isolation.\"\"\"\n    \n    def check_access(self, plugin_name: str, key: str) -> bool:\n        \"\"\"Check if plugin can access this key.\"\"\"\n        # Plugins can only access their own namespace\n        expected_prefix = f\"plugin:{plugin_name}:\"\n        return key.startswith(expected_prefix)\n```\n\n---\n\n## 6. Memory Lifecycle\n\n### 6.1 Session Lifecycle\n\n```\nSession Created\n    │\n    ▼\n1. Initialize Redis keys\n   session:{id} → metadata (TTL: 1h)\n   session:{id}:context → []\n   session:{id}:history → []\n   \n2. User interacts\n   │\n   ▼\n3. Store messages in context\n   memory:session:{id}:user:{msg_id} → {...}\n   memory:session:{id}:assistant:{msg_id} → {...}\n   \n4. Sliding TTL refresh\n   On each interaction: EXPIRE session:{id} 3600\n   \n5. Session ends (timeout or explicit close)\n   │\n   ▼\n6. Archive to long-term (optional)\n   SELECT * FROM session:{id}:history\n   INSERT INTO memory_entries (type='conversation', ...)\n   \n7. Delete Redis keys\n   DEL session:{id}*\n```\n\n### 6.2 Long-term Memory Lifecycle\n\n```\nEvent occurs\n    │\n    ▼\n1. Evaluate if worth remembering\n   - Is it a learning? → type=\"learning\"\n   - Is it a pattern? → type=\"pattern\"\n   - Is it a goal outcome? → type=\"goal\"\n   - Else: skip\n   \n2. Store in PostgreSQL\n   INSERT INTO memory_entries (...)\n   \n3. Generate embedding (async)\n   UPDATE memory_entries SET embedding = ... WHERE id = ...\n   \n4. Index for search\n   (automatic via pgvector)\n   \n5. Access tracking\n   UPDATE memory_entries SET access_count += 1, accessed_at = NOW()\n```\n\n---\n\n## 7. Context Assembly\n\n### 7.1 Context Window Management\n\n```python\n# core/context/assembler.py\nclass ContextAssembler:\n    \"\"\"Assemble context for LLM calls.\"\"\"\n    \n    def __init__(self, memory: MemoryBackend, max_tokens: int = 8192):\n        self.memory = memory\n        self.max_tokens = max_tokens\n    \n    async def assemble(self, session_id: str, query: str) -> list[dict]:\n        \"\"\"Build context window for a query.\"\"\"\n        context = []\n        tokens_used = 0\n        \n        # 1. Recent messages (priority)\n        recent = await self.memory.recall_by_scope(\n            session_id, \n            MemoryScope.SESSION\n        )\n        for entry in reversed(recent):  # Most recent first\n            entry_tokens = self.estimate_tokens(entry.value)\n            if tokens_used + entry_tokens > self.max_tokens:\n                break\n            context.append(entry.value)\n            tokens_used += entry_tokens\n        \n        # 2. Relevant long-term memories (if space)\n        if tokens_used < self.max_tokens * 0.5:\n            relevant = await self.memory.search(query, limit=5)\n            for entry in relevant:\n                entry_tokens = self.estimate_tokens(entry.content)\n                if tokens_used + entry_tokens > self.max_tokens:\n                    break\n                context.append({\n                    \"role\": \"system\",\n                    \"content\": f\"[Relevant memory: {entry.type}]\\n{entry.content}\"\n                })\n                tokens_used += entry_tokens\n        \n        return context\n```\n\n### 7.2 Token Estimation\n\n```python\ndef estimate_tokens(text: str) -> int:\n    \"\"\"Rough token estimation (1 token ≈ 4 chars).\"\"\"\n    return max(1, len(text) // 4)\n```\n\n---\n\n## 8. API Endpoints\n\n### 8.1 Memory Endpoints\n\n| Method | Path | Description |\n|--------|------|-------------|\n| `POST` | `/v1/memory/store` | Store a memory entry |\n| `GET` | `/v1/memory/recall` | Recall by key |\n| `GET` | `/v1/memory/search` | Semantic search |\n| `DELETE` | `/v1/memory/{key}` | Delete entry |\n| `DELETE` | `/v1/session/{id}/memory` | Clear session memory |\n\n### 8.2 Request/Response\n\n#### Store\n\n```json\nPOST /v1/memory/store\n{\n  \"session_id\": \"string\",\n  \"key\": \"string\",\n  \"value\": \"any\",\n  \"scope\": \"session|context|ephemeral\",\n  \"ttl_seconds\": 3600\n}\n```\n\n```json\n201 Created\n{\n  \"id\": \"string\",\n  \"stored_at\": \"2026-06-25T15:00:00Z\"\n}\n```\n\n#### Recall\n\n```json\nGET /v1/memory/recall?session_id=xxx&key=yyy\n```\n\n```json\n200 OK\n{\n  \"key\": \"yyy\",\n  \"value\": \"any\",\n  \"found\": true\n}\n```\n\n#### Search\n\n```json\nGET /v1/memory/search?query=python+tutorials&limit=5\n```\n\n```json\n200 OK\n{\n  \"results\": [\n    {\n      \"id\": \"string\",\n      \"type\": \"conversation\",\n      \"content\": {},\n      \"score\": 0.95\n    }\n  ]\n}\n```\n\n---\n\n## 9. Plugin State Management\n\n### 9.1 Lifecycle\n\n```\nPlugin loaded\n    │\n    ▼\n1. Plugin requests state API\n   state = PluginStateAPI(plugin_name, session_id, redis)\n   \n2. Plugin reads state\n   last_query = await state.get(\"last_query\")\n   \n3. Plugin updates state\n   await state.set(\"last_query\", \"python tutorials\", ttl=3600)\n   \n4. Session ends\n   │\n   ▼\n5. Auto-cleanup (TTL expiry)\n   Redis: key expires after TTL\n   PostgreSQL: ON DELETE CASCADE\n```\n\n### 9.2 Isolation Rules\n\n```python\n# ❌ Plugin A cannot access Plugin B's state\nplugin:web-search:session-abc:last_query  # ✅ OK for web-search\nplugin:docker:session-abc:last_query      # ❌ DENIED for web-search\n\n# Enforcement\nclass PluginStateAPI:\n    def _check_access(self, key: str) -> None:\n        expected_prefix = f\"plugin:{self.plugin_name}:\"\n        if not key.startswith(expected_prefix):\n            raise PermissionError(\n                f\"Plugin '{self.plugin_name}' cannot access '{key}'\"\n            )\n```\n\n---\n\n## 10. Migration & Backup\n\n### 10.1 Redis → PostgreSQL Migration\n\n```python\n# scripts/migrate_memory.py\nasync def migrate_session_to_longterm(session_id: str):\n    \"\"\"Archive session memory to long-term storage.\"\"\"\n    # 1. Fetch from Redis\n    history = await redis.lrange(f\"session:{session_id}:history\", 0, -1)\n    \n    # 2. Transform to long-term format\n    entries = [\n        LongTermMemory(\n            event_id=msg[\"id\"],\n            session_id=session_id,\n            type=\"conversation\",\n            content=msg,\n        )\n        for msg in history\n    ]\n    \n    # 3. Store in PostgreSQL\n    for entry in entries:\n        await postgres.store(entry)\n    \n    # 4. Delete from Redis\n    await redis.delete(f\"session:{session_id}:*\")\n```\n\n### 10.2 Backup Strategy\n\n| Data | Backup Frequency | Retention |\n|------|------------------|-----------|\n| Session memory | None (ephemeral) | TTL-based |\n| Long-term memory | Daily | 1 year |\n| Plugin state | None (TTL-based) | Session |\n\n---\n\n## 11. Summary\n\n```\n┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐\n│                       MEMORY SYSTEM SUMMARY                          │\n├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤\n│                                                                       │\n│  Session Memory (Redis)                                              │\n│  • TTL: 1h sliding                                                   │\n│  • Size: ~10MB per session                                           │\n│  • Scope: session, context, ephemeral                                │\n│                                                                       │\n│  Long-term Memory (PostgreSQL)                                       │\n│  • TTL: ∞ (permanent)                                                │\n│  • Size: ~GB (pgvector for semantic search)                          │\n│  • Types: conversation, learning, pattern, goal                      │\n│                                                                       │\n│  Plugin State (Redis)                                                │\n│  • TTL: Session or custom                                            │\n│  • Size: ~1MB per plugin                                             │\n│  • Isolation: namespace per plugin                                   │\n│                                                                       │\n│  API: store, recall, search, delete, clear                           │\n│  Context: sliding window + semantic retrieval                        │\n│                                                                       │\n└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘\n```","operationIsLocatedInWorkspace":true,"startLineNumbers":[]}

## ETHAN Core Memory System — Design complet

### Livrable

`MEMORY_SYSTEM.md` — Architecture mémoire complète pour ETHAN Core.

### Composants

| Tier | Storage | TTL | Taille | Usage |
|------|---------|-----|--------|-------|
| **Session Memory** | Redis | 1h sliding | ~10MB | Contexte conversation active |
| **Long-term Memory** | PostgreSQL | ∞ | ~GB | Historique, patterns, apprentissages |
| **Plugin State** | Redis | Session | ~1MB | État isolé par plugin |

### Data Models

- `MemoryEntry` — entrée générique (scope, session, key, value, TTL)
- `SessionMemory` — métadonnées session + contexte
- `LongTermMemory` — entrée persistante avec embedding pgvector
- `PluginState` — état isolé par plugin/session

### Stockage

**Redis** (hot):
- `session:{id}` — metadata session
- `session:{id}:context` — liste FIFO (100 derniers)
- `memory:{scope}:{session}:{key}` — valeurs mémoire
- `plugin:{plugin}:{session}:{key}` — état plugin

**PostgreSQL** (cold):
- `memory_entries` — avec pgvector pour recherche sémantique
- `plugin_state` — état persistant plugins (UNIQUE plugin+session+key)

### Isolation plugins

- Namespace: `plugin:{plugin_name}:{session_id}:{key}`
- Permission checker: `StatePermissionChecker`
- Un plugin ne peut accéder qu'à son propre namespace

### API

- `POST /v1/memory/store` — stocker
- `GET /v1/memory/recall` — rappeler par clé
- `GET /v1/memory/search` — recherche sémantique
- `DELETE /v1/memory/{key}` — supprimer
- `DELETE /v1/session/{id}/memory` — vider session
