Security Principles\n\n### 1.1 Defense in Depth\n\n```\n┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐\n│                    Defense Layers                                    │\n├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤\n│                                                                       │\n│  Layer 1: Input Validation                                           │\n│  └─ Schema validation, sanitization, rate limiting                   │\n│                                                                       │\n│  Layer 2: Authentication                                             │\n│  └─ API keys, session tokens, plugin signatures                      │\n│                                                                       │\n│  Layer 3: Authorization                                              │\n│  └─ Capability-based, permissions, sandboxing                        │\n│                                                                       │\n│  Layer 4: Isolation                                                  │\n│  └─ Process isolation, namespace isolation, resource limits          │\n│                                                                       │\n│  Layer 5: Audit                                                      │\n│  └─ Logging, tracing, immutable audit trail                          │\n│                                                                       │\n└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘\n```\n\n### 1.2 Security Rules\n\n| Rule | Description |\n|------|-------------|\n| **Least Privilege** | Chaque composant a uniquement les permissions nécessaires |\n| **Fail Secure** | En cas d'erreur, refuser par défaut |\n| **Audit Everything** | Toutes les actions sont loggées |\n| **No Silent Failures** | Toute violation est remontée |\n| **Immutable History** | Les logs ne peuvent pas être modifiés |\n\n---\n\n## 2. Plugin Sandbox Rules\n\n### 2.1 Permission Model\n\n```python\n# plugins/sandbox.py\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass, field\nfrom typing import Any\n\n@dataclass\nclass PermissionSet:\n    \"\"\"Ensemble de permissions vérifiables.\"\"\"\n    \n    def __init__(self):\n        self._permissions: list[tuple[str, str]] = []\n    \n    def add(self, action: str, resource: str) -> None:\n        \"\"\"Ajoute une permission action:resource.\"\"\"\n        self._permissions.append((action, resource))\n    \n    def allows(self, action: str, resource: str) -> bool:\n        \"\"\"Vérifie si l'action est autorisée.\"\"\"\n        import fnmatch\n        for perm_action, perm_resource in self._permissions:\n            if fnmatch.fnmatch(action, perm_action) and fnmatch.fnmatch(resource, perm_resource):\n                return True\n        return False\n\n@dataclass\nclass ResourceLimits:\n    \"\"\"Limites de ressources pour un plugin.\"\"\"\n    max_memory_mb: int = 512\n    max_cpu_percent: float = 50.0\n    max_execution_time_s: int = 30\n    max_file_descriptors: int = 100\n    max_network_connections: int = 10\n```\n\n### 2.2 Permission Levels\n\n| Level | Actions | Resources | Usage |\n|-------|---------|-----------|-------|\n| **none** | Aucune | Aucune | Plugin minimal |\n| **read** | read | state:*, memory:* | Lecture seule |\n| **write** | read, write | state:self:* | Écriture limitée |\n| **execute** | read, write, execute | tools:*, shell:limited | Exécution restreinte |\n| **admin** | * | * | Administration (interdit par défaut) |\n\n### 2.3 Permission Patterns\n\n```python\n# Format: action:resource\n# Actions: read, write, execute, subscribe, publish\n# Resources: state:*, memory:*, tools:*, shell:*, network:*\n\nPERMISSIONS_EXAMPLES = {\n    # Lecture seule\n    \"read:state:*\": \"Lire tout l'état\",\n    \"read:memory:session:*\": \"Lire mémoire session\",\n    \n    # Écriture limitée\n    \"write:state:self:*\": \"Écrire dans son propre namespace\",\n    \"write:memory:session:self:*\": \"Écrire dans sa mémoire\",\n    \n    # Exécution d'outils\n    \"execute:tools:web.*\": \"Exécuter outils web\",\n    \"execute:tools:docker.*\": \"Exécuter outils docker\",\n    \n    # Shell (très restreint)\n    \"execute:shell:git:*\": \"Exécuter commandes git uniquement\",\n    \"execute:shell:docker:*\": \"Exécuter commandes docker uniquement\",\n    \n    # Network\n    \"network:request:https://[REDACTED:PASSWORD]@contextmanager\n    def timeout(self, seconds: int):\n        \"\"\"Context manager avec timeout.\"\"\"\n        def timeout_handler(signum, frame):\n            raise TimeoutError(f\"Execution exceeded {seconds}s limit\")\n        \n        old_handler = signal.signal(signal.SIGALRM, timeout_handler)\n        signal.alarm(seconds)\n        try:\n            yield\n        finally:\n            signal.alarm(0)\n            signal.signal(signal.SIGALRM, old_handler)\n```\n\n---\n\n## 3. Shell Execution Limits\n\n### 3.1 Command Whitelist\n\n```python\n# core/safety/shell_executor.py\nclass ShellExecutor:\n    \"\"\"Exécution shell sécurisée.\"\"\"\n    \n    # Commandes autorisées par défaut\n    WHITELIST = {\n        \"git\": [\"status\", \"log\", \"diff\", \"show\", \"branch\", \"checkout\", \"pull\", \"push\", \"clone\"],\n        \"docker\": [\"ps\", \"images\", \"build\", \"run\", \"stop\", \"rm\", \"logs\", \"inspect\"],\n        \"kubectl\": [\"get\", \"describe\", \"logs\", \"apply\", \"delete\"],\n        \"npm\": [\"install\", \"run\", \"test\", \"build\"],\n        \"pip\": [\"install\", \"list\", \"show\"],\n        \"curl\": [\"*\"],  # Toutes les sous-commandes curl\n        \"ls\": [\"*\"],\n        \"cat\": [\"*\"],\n        \"grep\": [\"*\"],\n        \"find\": [\"*\"],\n    }\n    \n    # Arguments interdits (quel que soit la commande)\n    FORBIDDEN_ARGS = {\n        \"--force\", \"-f\",  # Force operations\n        \"--recursive\", \"-r\",  # Recursive operations\n        \"--all\", \"-a\",  # All-inclusive\n        \"sudo\",  # Privilege escalation\n        \"su\",  # User switching\n        \"chmod\", \"chown\",  # Permission changes\n        \"rm\", \"del\",  # Deletion (trop dangereux)\n        \"eval\", \"exec\",  # Code execution\n    }\n    \n    def validate_command(self, command: str) -> tuple[bool, str]:\n        \"\"\"Valide une commande shell.\"\"\"\n        parts = command.strip().split()\n        if not parts:\n            return False, \"Empty command\"\n        \n        cmd = parts[0]\n        \n        # Vérifier whitelist\n        if cmd not in self.WHITELIST:\n            return False, f\"Command '{cmd}' not in whitelist\"\n        \n        allowed_subcommands = self.WHITELIST[cmd]\n        \n        # Si \"*\", toutes les sous-commandes sont autorisées\n        if \"*\" in allowed_subcommands:\n            # Vérifier les arguments interdits\n            for arg in parts[1:]:\n                if arg in self.FORBIDDEN_ARGS:\n                    return False, f\"Forbidden argument: {arg}\"\n            return True, \"OK\"\n        \n        # Vérifier la sous-commande\n        if len(parts) < 2:\n            return False, f\"Missing subcommand for {cmd}\"\n        \n        subcmd = parts[1]\n        if subcmd not in allowed_subcommands:\n            return False, f\"Subcommand '{subcmd}' not allowed for {cmd}\"\n        \n        # Vérifier les arguments interdits\n        for arg in parts[2:]:\n            if arg in self.FORBIDDEN_ARGS:\n                return False, f\"Forbidden argument: {arg}\"\n        \n        return True, \"OK\"\n```\n\n### 3.2 Timeout & Resource Limits\n\n```python\n# core/safety/shell_executor.py\nimport subprocess\nimport asyncio\nfrom typing import Optional\n\nclass ShellExecutor:\n    def __init__(self):\n        self.default_timeout = 30  # secondes\n        self.max_output_size = 1024 * 1024  # 1MB\n    \n    async def execute(self, command: str, timeout: Optional[int] = None) -> dict:\n        \"\"\"Exécute une commande shell de manière sécurisée.\"\"\"\n        # 1. Valider la commande\n        valid, reason = self.validate_command(command)\n        if not valid:\n            return {\n                \"success\": False,\n                \"error\": f\"Command rejected: {reason}\",\n                \"output\": \"\",\n            }\n        \n        # 2. Timeout\n        timeout = timeout or self.default_timeout\n        \n        try:\n            # 3. Exécuter avec limites\n            process = await asyncio.create_subprocess_shell(\n                command,\n                stdout=asyncio.subprocess.PIPE,\n                stderr=asyncio.subprocess.PIPE,\n                limit=self.max_output_size,\n            )\n            \n            try:\n                stdout, stderr = await asyncio.wait_for(\n                    process.communicate(),\n                    timeout=timeout\n                )\n            except asyncio.TimeoutError:\n                process.kill()\n                await process.wait()\n                return {\n                    \"success\": False,\n                    \"error\": f\"Command timed out after {timeout}s\",\n                    \"output\": \"\",\n                }\n            \n            return {\n                \"success\": process.returncode == 0,\n                \"output\": stdout.decode(\"utf-8\", errors=\"replace\"),\n                \"error\": stderr.decode(\"utf-8\", errors=\"replace\") if stderr else None,\n                \"exit_code\": process.returncode,\n            }\n        \n        except Exception as e:\n            return {\n                \"success\": False,\n                \"error\": f\"Execution failed: {str(e)}\",\n                \"output\": \"\",\n            }\n```\n\n### 3.3 Dangerous Patterns Detection\n\n```python\n# core/safety/shell_executor.py\nclass ShellExecutor:\n    DANGEROUS_PATTERNS = [\n        r\";\\s*rm\\s+\",  # Command chaining with rm\n        r\"&&\\s*rm\\s+\",  # Command chaining with rm\n        r\"\\|\\s*rm\\s+\",  # Pipe to rm\n        r\">\\s*/dev/\",  # Write to device\n        r\"<\\s*/etc/\",  # Read from /etc\n        r\"\\$\\(.*\\)\",  # Command substitution\n        r\"`.*`\",  # Backtick substitution\n        r\"curl.*\\|.*sh\",  # Pipe curl to shell\n        r\"wget.*\\|.*sh\",  # Pipe wget to shell\n    ]\n    \n    def check_dangerous_patterns(self, command: str) -> tuple[bool, str]:\n        \"\"\"Détecte des patterns dangereux.\"\"\"\n        import re\n        for pattern in self.DANGEROUS_PATTERNS:\n            if re.search(pattern, command):\n                return False, f\"Dangerous pattern detected: {pattern}\"\n        return True, \"OK\"\n```\n\n---\n\n## 4. LLM Tool Permissions\n\n### 4.1 Capability-Based Access\n\n```python\n# core/safety/tool_permissions.py\nclass ToolPermission:\n    \"\"\"Permission pour un outil.\"\"\"\n    \n    def __init__(\n        self,\n        tool_name: str,\n        allowed_scopes: list[str],\n        requires_confirmation: bool = False,\n        max_calls_per_session: int = 10,\n        allowed_params: dict[str, Any] | None = None,\n    ):\n        self.tool_name = tool_name\n        self.allowed_scopes = allowed_scopes\n        self.requires_confirmation = requires_confirmation\n        self.max_calls_per_session = max_calls_per_session\n        self.allowed_params = allowed_params or {}\n\nclass ToolPermissionManager:\n    \"\"\"Gestionnaire de permissions d'outils.\"\"\"\n    \n    def __init__(self):\n        self._permissions: dict[str, ToolPermission] = {}\n        self._usage: dict[str, int] = {}  # tool_name -> count\n    \n    def register(self, permission: ToolPermission) -> None:\n        \"\"\"Enregistre une permission.\"\"\"\n        self._permissions[permission.tool_name] = permission\n    \n    def check(self, tool_name: str, session_id: str, params: dict) -> tuple[bool, str]:\n        \"\"\"Vérifie si l'appel est autorisé.\"\"\"\n        # 1. Vérifier que l'outil existe\n        if tool_name not in self._permissions:\n            return False, f\"Tool '{tool_name}' not registered\"\n        \n        perm = self._permissions[tool_name]\n        \n        # 2. Vérifier le scope\n        if session_id not in perm.allowed_scopes:\n            return False, f\"Tool '{tool_name}' not allowed in this scope\"\n        \n        # 3. Vérifier le rate limit\n        usage_key = f\"{tool_name}:{session_id}\"\n        current_usage = self._usage.get(usage_key, 0)\n        if current_usage >= perm.max_calls_per_session:\n            return False, f\"Rate limit exceeded for '{tool_name}' ({current_usage}/{perm.max_calls_per_session})\"\n        \n        # 4. Vérifier les paramètres autorisés\n        for param, value in params.items():\n            if param in perm.allowed_params:\n                allowed = perm.allowed_params[param]\n                if isinstance(allowed, list) and value not in allowed:\n                    return False, f\"Parameter '{param}' value '{value}' not allowed\"\n        \n        return True, \"OK\"\n    \n    def record_usage(self, tool_name: str, session_id: str) -> None:\n        \"\"\"Enregistre un appel.\"\"\"\n        usage_key = f\"{tool_name}:{session_id}\"\n        self._usage[usage_key] = self._usage.get(usage_key, 0) + 1\n```\n\n### 4.2 User Consent Flow\n\n```python\n# core/safety/consent.py\nclass ConsentManager:\n    \"\"\"Gestionnaire de consentement utilisateur.\"\"\"\n    \n    def __init__(self):\n        self._pending_consents: dict[str, asyncio.Future] = {}\n    \n    async def request_consent(\n        self,\n        session_id: str,\n        action: str,\n        details: dict,\n        timeout: int = 30,\n    ) -> bool:\n        \"\"\"Demande le consentement utilisateur.\"\"\"\n        consent_id = generate_uuid()\n        \n        # 1. Emettre event pour demander consentement\n        await self.bus.publish(\"ethan.safety.consent.requested\", {\n            \"consent_id\": consent_id,\n            \"session_id\": session_id,\n            \"action\": action,\n            \"details\": details,\n        })\n        \n        # 2. Attendre la réponse (avec timeout)\n        try:\n            response = await asyncio.wait_for(\n                self._wait_for_consent(consent_id),\n                timeout=timeout\n            )\n            return response.get(\"approved\", False)\n        except asyncio.TimeoutError:\n            # Timeout = refus par défaut\n            return False\n    \n    async def _wait_for_consent(self, consent_id: str):\n        \"\"\"Attend la réponse utilisateur.\"\"\"\n        future = asyncio.Future()\n        self._pending_consents[consent_id] = future\n        return await future\n    \n    async def respond_to_consent(self, consent_id: str, approved: bool):\n        \"\"\"Répond à une demande de consentement.\"\"\"\n        if consent_id in self._pending_consents:\n            future = self._pending_consents.pop(consent_id)\n            future.set_result({\"approved\": approved})\n```\n\n### 4.3 Tool Permission Configuration\n\n```json\n{\n  \"tools\": {\n    \"web.search\": {\n      \"allowed_scopes\": [\"chat\", \"research\"],\n      \"requires_confirmation\": false,\n      \"max_calls_per_session\": 20,\n      \"allowed_params\": {\n        \"query\": \"*\",\n        \"max_results\": [5, 10, 20]\n      }\n    },\n    \"shell.execute\": {\n      \"allowed_scopes\": [\"admin\", \"developer\"],\n      \"requires_confirmation\": true,\n      \"max_calls_per_session\": 5,\n      \"allowed_commands\": [\"git\", \"docker\", \"npm\"]\n    },\n    \"file.write\": {\n      \"allowed_scopes\": [\"developer\"],\n      \"requires_confirmation\": true,\n      \"max_calls_per_session\": 10,\n      \"allowed_paths\": [\"/home/user/projects/*\"]\n    },\n    \"docker.build\": {\n      \"allowed_scopes\": [\"developer\", \"ci\"],\n      \"requires_confirmation\": false,\n      \"max_calls_per_session\": 3,\n      \"allowed_params\": {\n        \"tag\": \"*\",\n        \"no_cache\": [true, false]\n      }\n    }\n  }\n}\n```\n\n---\n\n## 5. Security Boundaries\n\n### 5.1 Layer Boundaries\n\n```\n┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐\n│                         Security Boundaries                          │\n├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤\n│                                                                       │\n│  ┌──────────────┐      Trust Boundary      ┌──────────────┐        │\n│  │   User       │ ────────────────────────► │   CLI        │        │\n│  │  (untrusted) │                           │  (trusted)   │        │\n│  └──────────────┘                           └──────┬───────┘        │\n│                                                    │                 │\n│                                          Trust Boundary              │\n│                                                    │                 │\n│  ┌──────────────┐                           ┌──────▼───────┐        │\n│  │   Plugin     │                           │   Core       │        │\n│  │ (sandboxed)  │                           │  (trusted)   │        │\n│  └──────────────┘                           └──────────────┘        │\n│                                                                       │\n└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘\n```\n\n### 5.2 Trust Levels\n\n| Component | Trust Level | Justification |\n|-----------|-------------|----------------|\n| **User input** | Untrusted | Peut être malveillant |\n| **CLI** | Trusted | Code signé, distribué officiellement |\n| **Core** | Trusted | Code signé, isolé |\n| **Plugin** | Sandboxed | Code tiers, isolé |\n| **LLM output** | Untrusted | Peut être manipulé (prompt injection) |\n| **External API** | Untrusted | Réseau non fiable |\n\n### 5.3 Data Flow Security\n\n```python\n# User Input → CLI → Core → Plugin\n# Chaque étape valide et sanitize\n\n1. User Input\n   └─ Validate: schema, length, encoding\n   └─ Sanitize: escape special chars, strip control chars\n   └─ Rate limit: max requests per minute\n\n2. CLI\n   └─ Authenticate: API key validation\n   └─ Authorize: session validation\n   └─ Log: audit trail\n\n3. Core\n   └─ Validate: event schema\n   └─ Authorize: capability check\n   └─ Route: capability-based routing\n\n4. Plugin\n   └─ Sandbox: permission check\n   └─ Isolate: resource limits\n   └─ Monitor: execution time, memory\n```\n\n---\n\n## 6. Audit & Compliance\n\n### 6.1 Audit Log Schema\n\n```python\n# core/telemetry/audit.py\n@dataclass\nclass AuditEntry:\n    \"\"\"Entrée d'audit.\"\"\"\n    id: str\n    timestamp: datetime\n    actor: str  # user_id, plugin_name, system\n    action: str  # tool.execute, shell.run, memory.store\n    resource: str  # tool:web.search, shell:git, memory:*\n    params: dict[str, Any]\n    result: str  # success, denied, error\n    session_id: str\n    correlation_id: str\n    metadata: dict[str, str] = field(default_factory=dict)\n```\n\n### 6.2 Audit Log Storage\n\n```sql\n-- PostgreSQL\nCREATE TABLE audit_log (\n    id UUID PRIMARY KEY,\n    timestamp TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),\n    actor VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,\n    action VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,\n    resource VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,\n    params JSONB,\n    result VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,\n    session_id UUID NOT NULL,\n    correlation_id UUID NOT NULL,\n    metadata JSONB\n);\n\nCREATE INDEX idx_audit_timestamp ON audit_log(timestamp DESC);\nCREATE INDEX idx_audit_actor ON audit_log(actor);\nCREATE INDEX idx_audit_action ON audit_log(action);\nCREATE INDEX idx_audit_session ON audit_log(session_id);\n```\n\n### 6.3 Audit Events\n\n| Event | Actor | Action | When |\n|-------|-------|--------|------|\n| Plugin loaded | system | plugin.load | Plugin chargé |\n| Tool executed | plugin | tool.execute | Appel outil |\n| Shell command | plugin | shell.execute | Commande shell |\n| Memory access | plugin | memory.read/write | Accès mémoire |\n| Permission denied | system | permission.denied | Violation détectée |\n| Session created | user | session.create | Nouvelle session |\n| Config changed | user | config.update | Modification config |\n\n### 6.4 Compliance Rules\n\n```python\n# core/safety/compliance.py\nclass ComplianceChecker:\n    \"\"\"Vérifie la conformité.\"\"\"\n    \n    def __init__(self, audit_log: AuditLog):\n        self.audit_log = audit_log\n    \n    async def check_rate_limit(self, actor: str, action: str, window: int = 60) -> bool:\n        \"\"\"Vérifie le rate limiting.\"\"\"\n        # Compter les actions dans la fenêtre\n        count = await self.audit_log.count(\n            actor=actor,\n            action=action,\n            since=datetime.utcnow() - timedelta(seconds=window)\n        )\n        \n        # Limites par action\n        LIMITS = {\n            \"tool.execute\": 100,\n            \"shell.execute\": 10,\n            \"memory.write\": 50,\n        }\n        \n        limit = LIMITS.get(action, 50)\n        return count < limit\n    \n    async def check_anomalies(self, session_id: str) -> list[str]:\n        \"\"\"Détecte des anomalies.\"\"\"\n        anomalies = []\n        \n        # 1. Trop de permissions denied\n        denied = await self.audit_log.count(\n            session_id=session_id,\n            result=\"denied\",\n            since=datetime.utcnow() - timedelta(minutes=5)\n        )\n        if denied > 10:\n            anomalies.append(f\"High denial rate: {denied} denials in 5min\")\n        \n        # 2. Trop de shell executions\n        shell_calls = await self.audit_log.count(\n            session_id=session_id,\n            action=\"shell.execute\",\n            since=datetime.utcnow() - timedelta(minutes=5)\n        )\n        if shell_calls > 20:\n            anomalies.append(f\"High shell usage: {shell_calls} calls in 5min\")\n        \n        return anomalies\n```\n\n---\n\n## 7. Security Configuration\n\n### 7.1 Plugin Security Config\n\n```json\n{\n  \"plugin_security\": {\n    \"default_permissions\": [\"read:state:self:*\"],\n    \"max_plugins\": 20,\n    \"require_signature\": true,\n    \"allowed_sources\": [\"official\", \"verified\"],\n    \"sandbox_enabled\": true,\n    \"resource_limits\": {\n      \"max_memory_mb\": 512,\n      \"max_cpu_percent\": 50,\n      \"max_execution_time_s\": 30\n    }\n  }\n}\n```\n\n### 7.2 Shell Security Config\n\n```json\n{\n  \"shell_security\": {\n    \"enabled\": true,\n    \"require_confirmation\": true,\n    \"default_timeout\": 30,\n    \"max_output_size_mb\": 1,\n    \"whitelist\": {\n      \"git\": [\"status\", \"log\", \"diff\", \"show\"],\n      \"docker\": [\"ps\", \"images\", \"logs\"],\n      \"npm\": [\"install\", \"run\", \"test\"]\n    },\n    \"forbidden_args\": [\"--force\", \"-f\", \"sudo\", \"rm\", \"del\"],\n    \"forbidden_patterns\": [\n      \".*\\\\|.*rm\",\n      \".*\\\\|.*sh\",\n      \"curl.*\\\\|.*sh\"\n    ]\n  }\n}\n```\n\n### 7.3 LLM Tool Security Config\n\n```json\n{\n  \"llm_tool_security\": {\n    \"require_confirmation_threshold\": \"high\",\n    \"max_calls_per_session\": 50,\n    \"rate_limit_per_minute\": 10,\n    \"blocked_tools\": [\"shell.execute\", \"file.delete\"],\n    \"allowed_tools\": [\"web.search\", \"web.fetch\", \"docker.build\"],\n    \"consent_timeout_s\": 30\n  }\n}\n```\n\n---\n\n## 8. Incident Response\n\n### 8.1 Security Events\n\n| Severity | Event | Action |\n|----------|-------|--------|\n| **Critical** | Plugin escape sandbox | Kill plugin, alert admin, freeze system |\n| **High** | Permission violation | Log, deny, alert if repeated |\n| **Medium** | Rate limit exceeded | Throttle, notify user |\n| **Low** | Invalid input | Reject, log |\n\n### 8.2 Response Flow\n\n```\nSecurity Event Detected\n    │\n    ▼\n1. Classify severity\n   critical / high / medium / low\n   \n2. Take immediate action\n   - Kill plugin (critical)\n   - Deny request (high)\n   - Throttle (medium)\n   - Log only (low)\n   \n3. Notify\n   - Admin (critical, high)\n   - User (medium)\n   - None (low)\n   \n4. Audit\n   - Log to audit_log\n   - Update metrics\n   - Alert if threshold exceeded\n```\n\n---\n\n## 9. Summary\n\n```\n┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐\n│                       SECURITY MODEL SUMMARY                         │\n├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤\n│                                                                       │\n│  Plugin Sandbox                                                      │\n│  • Permissions: action:resource pattern                              │\n│  • Levels: none, read, write, execute, admin                         │\n│  • Resource limits: memory, CPU, time, FDs                           │\n│  • Enforcement: validate before execute                              │\n│                                                                       │\n│  Shell Execution                                                     │\n│  • Whitelist: commands autorisés                                     │\n│  • Forbidden args: --force, sudo, rm, etc.                           │\n│  • Timeout: 30s par défaut                                           │\n│  • Pattern detection: injection, chaining                            │\n│                                                                       │\n│  LLM Tool Permissions                                                │\n│  • Capability-based: tool + scope + params                           │\n│  • Rate limiting: max calls per session                              │\n│  • User consent: confirmation pour actions sensibles                 │\n│  • Audit: toutes les actions loggées                                 │\n│                                                                       │\n│  Defense in Depth                                                    │\n│  • 5 layers: validation, auth, authz, isolation, audit              │\n│  • Trust levels: untrusted, sandboxed, trusted                       │\n│  • Incident response: classify → act → notify → audit                │\n│                                                                       │\n└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘\n```","operationIsLocatedInWorkspace":true,"startLineNumbers":[]}

## ETHAN Security Model — Design complet

### Livrable

`SECURITY_MODEL.md` — Modèle de sécurité complet pour ETHAN.

### Composants

| Section | Sujet |
|---------|-------|
| **1. Security Principles** | Defense in Depth (5 layers), règles de sécurité |
| **2. Plugin Sandbox Rules** | Permissions action:resource, niveaux, enforcement, resource limits |
| **3. Shell Execution Limits** | Whitelist commands, forbidden args, timeout, pattern detection |
| **4. LLM Tool Permissions** | Capability-based access, user consent, rate limiting |
| **5. Security Boundaries** | Trust levels, data flow security |
| **6. Audit & Compliance** | Audit log schema, compliance checker, anomaly detection |
| **7. Security Configuration** | JSON configs pour plugins, shell, LLM tools |
| **8. Incident Response** | Severity classification, response flow |

### Règles clés

- **Least Privilege** — permissions minimales nécessaires

                      │   │   Provider Pool           │    │\n│                               │   │  ┌────────┐ ┌────────┐   │    │\n│                               │   │  │ OpenAI │ │Anthropic│   │    │\n│                               │   │  └────────┘ └────────┘   │    │\n│                               │   │  ┌────────┐ ┌────────┐   │    │\n│                               │   │  │ Google │ │                              │\n│                               │   ┌──────────────────────────┐    │\n│                               │   │   Fallback Chain          │    │\n│                               │   │  Primary → Secondary →   │    │\n│                               │   │  Tertiary → Local         │    │\n│                               │   └──────────────────────────┘    │\n│                               │                                    │\n│                               │   ┌──────────────────────────┐    │\n│                               │   │   Cost Optimizer          │ Provider Registry\n\n### 2.1 Provider Model\n\n```python\n# core/llm/provider.py\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass, field\nfrom typing import Any\nfrom enum import Enum\n\nclass ProviderType(Enum):\n    OPENAI = \"openai\"\n    ANTHROPIC = \"anthropic\"\n    GOOGLE = \"google\"\n    OLLAMA = \"ollama\"\n    VLLM = \"vllm\"\n    SGLANG = \"sglang\"\n    LLAMACPP = \"llamacpp\"\n\n@dataclass\nclass ProviderConfig:\n    \"\"\"Configuration d'un provider.\"\"\"\n    name: str\n    type: ProviderType\n    api_key: str | None = None\n    base_url: str | None = None\n    models: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)\n    enabled: bool = True\n    priority: int = 0  # Plus élevé = plus prioritaire\n    rate_limit: int = 100  # Requests per minute\n    cost_per_1k_tokens: float = 0.0\n    max_context_length: int = 8192\n    supports_streaming: bool = True\n    supports_functions: bool = False\n    timeout: int = 30\n\n@dataclass\nclass ModelCapabilities:\n    \"\"\"Capacités d'un modèle.\"\"\"\n    model_id: str\n    provider: str\n    max_tokens: int\n    supports_vision: bool = False\n    supports_functions: bool = False\n    supports_json_mode: bool = False\n    cost_per_1k_input: float = 0.0\n    cost_per_1k_output: float = 0.0\n    latency_p50_ms: int = 500\n    latency_p99_ms: int = 2000\n    quality_score: float = 0.8  # 0.0-1.0\n```\n\n### 2.2 Provider Registry\n\n```python\n# core/llm/registry.py\nclass LLMProviderRegistry:\n    \"\"\"Registre des providers LLM.\"\"\"\n    \n    def __init__(self):\n        self._providers: dict[str, ProviderConfig] = {}\n        self._models: dict[str, ModelCapabilities] = {}\n    \n    def register_provider(self, config: ProviderConfig) -> None:\n        \"\"\"Enregistre un provider.\"\"\"\n        self._providers[config.name] = config\n    \n    def register_model(self, capabilities: ModelCapabilities) -> None:\n        \"\"\"Enregistre un modèle.\"\"\"\n        self._models[capabilities.model_id] = capabilities\n    \n    def get_provider(self, name: str) -> ProviderConfig | None:\n        \"\"\"Récupère un provider.\"\"\"\n        return self._providers.get(name)\n    \n    def get_model(self, model_id: str) -> ModelCapabilities | None:\n        \"\"\"Récupère un modèle.\"\"\"\n        return self._models.get(model_id)\n    \n    def list_providers(self, enabled_only: bool = True) -> list[ProviderConfig]:\n        \"\"\"Liste les providers.\"\"\"\n        providers = list(self._providers.values())\n        if enabled_only:\n            providers = [p for p in providers if p.enabled]\n        return sorted(providers, key=lambda p: p.priority, reverse=True)\n    \n    def list_models(self, provider: str | None = None) -> list[ModelCapabilities]:\n        \"\"\"Liste les modèles.\"\"\"\n        models = list(self._models.values())\n        if provider:\n            models = [m for m in models if m.provider == provider]\n        return sorted(models, key=lambda m: m.quality_score, reverse=True)\n```\n\n---\n\n## 3. Routing Logic\n\n### 3.1 Router Strategy\n\n```python\n# core/llm/router.py\nfrom enum import Enum\nfrom typing import Any\n\nclass RoutingStrategy(Enum):\n    COST_OPTIMIZED = \"cost_optimized\"      # Minimiser le coût\n    QUALITY_OPTIMIZED = \"quality_optimized\" # Maximiser la qualité\n    LATENCY_OPTIMIZED = \"latency_optimized\" # Minimiser la latence\n    BALANCED = \"balanced\"                   # Équilibré\n    LOCAL_FIRST = \"local_first\"             # Préférer local\n    CLOUD_FIRST = \"cloud_first\"             # Préférer cloud\n\nclass LLMRouter:\n    \"\"\"Routeur LLM multi-provider.\"\"\"\n    \n    def __init__(\n        self,\n        registry: LLMProviderRegistry,\n        strategy: RoutingStrategy = RoutingStrategy.BALANCED,\n        budget: float | None = None,  # Budget en USD par session\n    ):\n        self.registry = registry\n        self.strategy = strategy\n        self.budget = budget\n        self._usage: dict[str, float] = {}  # session_id -> cost\n    \n    async def route(self, request: LLMRequest) -> LLMResponse:\n        \"\"\"Route une requête vers le meilleur provider.\"\"\"\n        \n        # 1. Filtrer les providers disponibles\n        candidates = self._filter_candidates(request)\n        \n        if not candidates:\n            raise NoProviderAvailableError(\"No provider available for this request\")\n        \n        # 2. Appliquer la stratégie de routing\n        selected = self._apply_strategy(candidates, request)\n        \n        # 3. Vérifier le budget\n        if not self._check_budget(request.session_id, selected):\n            # Fallback vers provider moins cher\n            selected = self._fallback_to_cheaper(candidates, request)\n        \n        # 4. Exécuter avec fallback\n        return await self._execute_with_fallback(selected, request)\n    \n    def _filter_candidates(self, request: LLMRequest) -> list[ProviderConfig]:\n        \"\"\"Filtre les providers selon les critères.\"\"\"\n        candidates = []\n        \n        for provider in self.registry.list_providers():\n            # Vérifier le modèle\n            model = self.registry.get_model(request.model_id)\n            if not model or model.provider != provider.name:\n                continue\n            \n            # Vérifier les capacités\n            if request.requires_vision and not model.supports_vision:\n                continue\n            if request.requires_functions and not model.supports_functions:\n                continue\n            if request.max_tokens > model.max_tokens:\n                continue\n            \n            candidates.append(provider)\n        \n        return candidates\n```\n\n### 3.2 Model Selection Rules\n\n```python\n# core/llm/router.py\nclass LLMRouter:\n    def _apply_strategy(\n        self,\n        candidates: list[ProviderConfig],\n        request: LLMRequest\n    ) -> ProviderConfig:\n        \"\"\"Applique la stratégie de routing.\"\"\"\n        \n        if self.strategy == RoutingStrategy.COST_OPTIMIZED:\n            return min(candidates, key=lambda p: p.cost_per_1k_tokens)\n        \n        elif self.strategy == RoutingStrategy.QUALITY_OPTIMIZED:\n            # Prendre le modèle avec le meilleur quality_score\n            models = [\n                self.registry.get_model(request.model_id)\n                for _ in candidates\n            ]\n            best_model = max(m for m in models if m, key=lambda m: m.quality_score)\n            return self.registry.get_provider(best_model.provider)\n        \n        elif self.strategy == RoutingStrategy.LATENCY_OPTIMIZED:\n            # Prendre le provider avec la latence P50 la plus basse\n            return min(candidates, key=lambda p: p.timeout)\n        \n        elif self.strategy == RoutingStrategy.LOCAL_FIRST:\n            # Préférer Ollama, vLLM, SGLang, llama.cpp\n            local_providers = {ProviderType.OLLAMA, ProviderType.VLLM, \n                             ProviderType.SGLANG, ProviderType.LLAMACPP}\n            local = [p for p in candidates if p.type in local_providers]\n            return local[0] if local else candidates[0]\n        \n        elif self.strategy == RoutingStrategy.CLOUD_FIRST:\n            # Préférer OpenAI, Anthropic, Google\n            cloud_providers = {ProviderType.OPENAI, ProviderType.ANTHROPIC, \n                              ProviderType.GOOGLE}\n            cloud = [p for p in candidates if p.type in cloud_providers]\n            return cloud[0] if cloud else candidates[0]\n        \n        else:  # BALANCED\n            # Score composite: 0.4 * quality + 0.3 * (1/cost) + 0.3 * (1/latency)\n            def score(p: ProviderConfig) -> float:\n                model = self.registry.get_model(request.model_id)\n                if not model:\n                    return 0.0\n                quality = model.quality_score * 0.4\n                cost_score = (1.0 / (p.cost_per_1k_tokens + 0.001)) * 0.3\n                latency_score = (1.0 / (p.timeout + 0.001)) * 0.3\n                return quality + cost_score + latency_score\n            \n            return max(candidates, key=score)\n```\n\n### 3.3 Complexity-Based Routing\n\n```python\n# core/llm/complexity.py\nclass QueryComplexity:\n    \"\"\"Évalue la complexité d'une requête.\"\"\"\n    \n    @staticmethod\n    def estimate(query: str, context: dict) -> float:\n        \"\"\"Retourne un score 0.0-1.0.\"\"\"\n        score = 0.0\n        \n        # 1. Longueur de la requête\n        words = len(query.split())\n        if words > 100:\n            score += 0.3\n        elif words > 50:\n            score += 0.2\n        else:\n            score += 0.1\n        \n        # 2. Mots-clés complexes\n        complex_keywords = {\"explain\", \"analyze\", \"compare\", \"evaluate\", \n                          \"reasoning\", \"logic\", \"proof\", \"derive\"}\n        if any(kw in query.lower() for kw in complex_keywords):\n            score += 0.3\n        \n        # 3. Contexte nécessaire\n        if context.get(\"requires_reasoning\"):\n            score += 0.2\n        if context.get(\"requires_vision\"):\n            score += 0.2\n        \n        return min(1.0, score)\n\nclass LLMRouter:\n    def route_by_complexity(self, request: LLMRequest) -> ProviderConfig:\n        \"\"\"Route selon la complexité.\"\"\"\n        complexity = QueryComplexity.estimate(request.query, request.context)\n        \n        # Low complexity → local/cheap\n        if complexity < 0.3:\n            return self._select_local_or_cheap(request)\n        \n        # Medium complexity → balanced\n        elif complexity < 0.7:\n            return self._apply_strategy(\n                self._filter_candidates(request),\n                request\n            )\n        \n        # High complexity → best quality\n        else:\n            return self._select_best_quality(request)\n```\n\n---\n\n## 4. Fallback Strategy\n\n### 4.1 Fallback Chain\n\n```python\n# core/llm/fallback.py\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\nfrom typing import Any\n\n@dataclass\nclass FallbackConfig:\n    \"\"\"Configuration de fallback.\"\"\"\n    max_retries: int = 3\n    retry_delay_ms: int = 1000\n    backoff_factor: float = 2.0\n    fallback_chain: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)\n    fallback_on: list[str] = field(default_factory=lambda: [\"timeout\", \"error\", \"rate_limit\"])\n\nclass FallbackManager:\n    \"\"\"Gestionnaire de fallback.\"\"\"\n    \n    def __init__(self, registry: LLMProviderRegistry):\n        self.registry = registry\n    \n    async def execute_with_fallback(\n        self,\n        primary: ProviderConfig,\n        request: LLMRequest,\n        config: FallbackConfig\n    ) -> LLMResponse:\n        \"\"\"Exécute avec fallback automatique.\"\"\"\n        \n        # Construire la chaîne de fallback\n        chain = [primary] + [\n            self.registry.get_provider(name)\n            for name in config.fallback_chain\n            if self.registry.get_provider(name)\n        ]\n        \n        last_error = None\n        \n        for attempt, provider in enumerate(chain):\n            if attempt >= config.max_retries:\n                break\n            \n            try:\n                response = await self._execute(provider, request)\n                if response.success:\n                    return response\n                \n                # Vérifier si on doit fallback\n                if response.error_type in config.fallback_on:\n                    last_error = response.error\n                    continue\n                \n                # Erreur non-retryable\n                return response\n                \n            except Exception as e:\n                last_error = str(e)\n                continue\n        \n        # Tous les providers ont échoué\n        return LLMResponse(\n            success=False,\n            error=f\"All providers failed. Last error: {last_error}\",\n            provider=\"none\"\n        )\n    \n    async def _execute(self, provider: ProviderConfig, request: LLMRequest) -> LLMResponse:\n        \"\"\"Exécute la requête sur un provider.\"\"\"\n        try:\n            adapter = ProviderAdapter.create(provider.type)\n            return await adapter.execute(request)\n        except TimeoutError:\n            return LLMResponse(success=False, error_type=\"timeout\", \n                             error=\"Request timed out\")\n        except RateLimitError:\n            return LLMResponse(success=False, error_type=\"rate_limit\",\n                             error=\"Rate limit exceeded\")\n        except Exception as e:\n            return LLMResponse(success=False, error_type=\"error\", error=str(e))\n```\n\n### 4.2 Default Fallback Chains\n\n```python\n# core/llm/fallback.py\nDEFAULT_FALLBACK_CHAINS = {\n    # Cloud providers (par ordre de coût)\n    \"openai\": [\"anthropic\", \"google\", \"ollama\"],\n    \"anthropic\": [\"openai\", \"google\", \"ollama\"],\n    \"google\": [\"openai\", \"anthropic\", \"ollama\"],\n    \n    # Local providers (par ordre de qualité)\n    \"ollama\": [\"vllm\", \"sglang\", \"llamacpp\", \"openai\"],\n    \"vllm\": [\"sglang\", \"llamacpp\", \"ollama\", \"openai\"],\n    \"sglang\": [\"vllm\", \"llamacpp\", \"ollama\", \"openai\"],\n    \"llamacpp\": [\"ollama\", \"vllm\", \"sglang\", \"openai\"],\n}\n\ndef get_fallback_chain(provider_name: str) -> list[str]:\n    \"\"\"Retourne la chaîne de fallback pour un provider.\"\"\"\n    return DEFAULT_FALLBACK_CHAINS.get(provider_name, [\"openai\"])\n```\n\n---\n\n## 5. Cost Optimization Strategy\n\n### 5.1 Token Estimation\n\n```python\n# core/llm/cost.py\nclass TokenEstimator:\n    \"\"\"Estimation du nombre de tokens.\"\"\"\n    \n    @staticmethod\n    def estimate(text: str, model: str) -> int:\n        \"\"\"Estime le nombre de tokens.\"\"\"\n        # Approximation: 1 token ≈ 4 caractères\n        # Pour une estimation précise, utiliser tiktoken ou similar\n        return max(1, len(text) // 4)\n    \n    @staticmethod\n    def estimate_cost(\n        input_tokens: int,\n        output_tokens: int,\n        input_cost_per_1k: float,\n        output_cost_per_1k: float\n    ) -> float:\n        \"\"\"Calcule le coût estimé.\"\"\"\n        input_cost = (input_tokens / 1000) * input_cost_per_1k\n        output_cost = (output_tokens / 1000) * output_cost_per_1k\n        return input_cost + output_cost\n```\n\n### 5.2 Budget Enforcement\n\n```python\n# core/llm/cost.py\nclass BudgetManager:\n    \"\"\"Gestionnaire de budget.\"\"\"\n    \n    def __init__(self, default_budget: float = 10.0):\n        self.default_budget = default_budget\n        self._session_budgets: dict[str, float] = {}\n        self._session_usage: dict[str, float] = {}\n    \n    def set_budget(self, session_id: str, budget: float) -> None:\n        \"\"\"Définit le budget pour une session.\"\"\"\n        self._session_budgets[session_id] = budget\n    \n    def record_usage(self, session_id: str, cost: float) -> None:\n        \"\"\"Enregistre une utilisation.\"\"\"\n        self._session_usage[session_id] = self._session_usage.get(session_id, 0.0) + cost\n    \n    def check_budget(self, session_id: str, estimated_cost: float) -> tuple[bool, str]:\n        \"\"\"Vérifie si le budget est suffisant.\"\"\"\n        budget = self._session_budgets.get(session_id, self.default_budget)\n        current_usage = self._session_usage.get(session_id, 0.0)\n        \n        if current_usage + estimated_cost > budget:\n            return False, f\"Budget exceeded: ${current_usage:.2f} / ${budget:.2f}\"\n        \n        return True, \"OK\"\n    \n    def get_remaining_budget(self, session_id: str) -> float:\n        \"\"\"Retourne le budget restant.\"\"\"\n        budget = self._session_budgets.get(session_id, self.default_budget)\n        current_usage = self._session_usage.get(session_id, 0.0)\n        return max(0.0, budget - current_usage)\n```\n\n### 5.3 Cost-Aware Routing\n\n```python\n# core/llm/router.py\nclass LLMRouter:\n    def _select_cost_optimized(\n        self,\n        candidates: list[ProviderConfig],\n        request: LLMRequest\n    ) -> ProviderConfig:\n        \"\"\"Sélectionne le provider le moins cher.\"\"\"\n        \n        min_cost = float('inf')\n        selected = candidates[0]\n        \n        for provider in candidates:\n            model = self.registry.get_model(request.model_id)\n            if not model:\n                continue\n            \n            # Estimer le coût\n            input_tokens = TokenEstimator.estimate(request.prompt, request.model_id)\n            estimated_output = request.max_tokens or 1000\n            cost = TokenEstimator.estimate_cost(\n                input_tokens=input_tokens,\n                output_tokens=estimated_output,\n                input_cost_per_1k=model.cost_per_1k_input,\n                output_cost_per_1k=model.cost_per_1k_output,\n            )\n            \n            if cost < min_cost:\n                min_cost = cost\n                selected = provider\n        \n        return selected\n    \n    def _fallback_to_cheaper(\n        self,\n        candidates: list[ProviderConfig],\n        request: LLMRequest\n    ) -> ProviderConfig:\n        \"\"\"Fallback vers un provider moins cher.\"\"\"\n        # Trier par coût croissant\n        sorted_candidates = sorted(candidates, key=lambda p: p.cost_per_1k_tokens)\n        \n        for provider in sorted_candidates:\n            model = self.registry.get_model(request.model_id)\n            if not model:\n                continue\n            \n            # Vérifier le budget\n            input_tokens = TokenEstimator.estimate(request.prompt, request.model_id)\n            estimated_output = request.max_tokens or 1000\n            cost = TokenEstimator.estimate_cost(\n                input_tokens, estimated_output,\n                model.cost_per_1k_input, model.cost_per_1k_output\n            )\n            \n            if self._check_budget(request.session_id, cost)[0]:\n                return provider\n        \n        # Si aucun ne respecte le budget, prendre le moins cher\n        return sorted_candidates[0]\n```\n\n---\n\n## 6. Provider Configuration\n\n### 6.1 Provider Setup\n\n```json\n{\n  \"llm\": {\n    \"default_strategy\": \"balanced\",\n    \"default_budget_usd\": 10.0,\n    \"providers\": {\n      \"openai\": {\n        \"type\": \"openai\",\n        \"api_key\": \"${OPENAI_API_KEY}\",\n        \"base_url\": \"https://[REDACTED:PASSWORD]@dataclass\nclass ModelCriteria:\n    \"\"\"Critères de sélection de modèle.\"\"\"\n    provider: str | None = None\n    requires_vision: bool = False\n    requires_functions: bool = False\n    max_tokens: int | None = None\n    max_cost: float | None = None\n    strategy: RoutingStrategy = RoutingStrategy.BALANCED\n```\n\n---\n\n## 7. ### Livrable

`MVP_SCOPE.md` — Scope MVP minimal pour démontrer le concept.

### In Scope (ONLY these)

| Component | Description |
|-----------|-------------|
| **Core Chat API** | API REST simple (FastAPI) |
| **CLI REPL** | Terminal interactif |

| **Session Memory** | Contexte de session (Redis) |

- Plugin system
- Long-term memory

- NATS / EventBus
- PostgreSQL
- gRPC
- Metrics / Telemetry
- Security sandbox
- Fallback chains
- Cost optimization

```

├── core/
│   ├── main.py

├── Dockerfile

└── README.md
```

### Success Criteria

3. ✅ Session memory works (context maintained)
4. ✅ Works offline (Ollama local)

Phase 3: Plugin Ecosystem (Weeks 10-17)\n\n### 4.1 Goals\n\n- Écosystème de plugins riche\n- Tool execution sécurisé\n- Learning loop fonctionnel\n- Autonomy basique\n\n### 4.2 Deliverables\n\n| # | Deliverable | Description |\n|---|-------------|-------------|\n| 1 | Tool Execution | Shell, web, file tools |\n| 2 | Skills System | Découverte + exécution skills |\n| 3 | Learning Loop | DSPy/GEPA optimization |\n| 4 | Autonomy Module | Goal initiation |\n| 5 | Metacognition | Self-assessment |\n| 6 | Plugin Store | Marketplace plugins |\n| 7 | SDK Python + TS | Documentation + examples |\n\n### 4.3 Technical Specs\n\n```python\n# Nouveaux composants\n- Tool executor (sandboxed)\n- Skill manager (discovery + pipeline)\n- Learning orchestrator (DSPy/GEPA)\n- Autonomy module (goal generation)\n- Metacognition module (self-evaluation)\n```\n\n### 4.4 Success Criteria\n\n- ✅ 20+ plugins disponibles\n- ✅ Tool execution < 5s (P95)\n- ✅ Learning loop améliore performance\n- ✅ Autonomy initie goals\n- ✅ SDK documenté\n- ✅ Plugin store fonctionnel\n\n### 4.5 Risks\n\n| Risk | Probability | Impact | Mitigation |\n|------|-------------|--------|------------|\n| Plugin sécurité | High | Critical | Audit régulier + sandbox |\n| Performance tools | Medium | High | Timeout + resource limits |\n| Learning instable | Medium | Medium | A/B testing + rollback |\n| Écosystème faible | Medium | Low | Incentives + documentation |\n| Complexité croissante | High | High | Refactoring régulier |\n\n### 4.6 Technical Debt\n\n- ⚠️ Plugin API peut évoluer (breaking changes)\n- ⚠️ Learning loop expérimental\n- ⚠️ Autonomy non testé en production\n- ⚠️ Skills system immature\n- ⚠️ SDK pas encore stable\n\n---\n\n## 5. Layer Responsibilities\n\n### 3.1 ETHAN Core (ethan-core/)\n\n**Rôle** : Cerveau AI. Logique d'intelligence uniquement.\n\n| Responsibility | Description |\n|----------------|-------------|\n| LLM reasoning | Appels aux modèles, génération de réponses |\n| Memory management | Stockage et récupération mémoire |\n| Learning loop | Amélioration continue |\n| Metacognition | Auto-évaluation |\n| Autonomy | Initiation de goals |\n| Planning | Décomposition de tâches |\n| Execution | Exécution de tâches |\n| Capability registry | Enregistrement des capacités |\n\n**What Core CAN do:**\n- ✅ Recevoir des événements (via gRPC/NATS)\n- ✅ Appeler des providers LLM\n- ✅ Lire/écrire dans Redis/PostgreSQL\n- ✅ Publier des événements\n- ✅ Exécuter de la logique AI\n\n**What Core CANNOT do:**\n- ❌ Connaître Docker, systemd, Kubernetes\n- ❌ Afficher du output utilisateur\n- ❌ Exécuter des commandes shell\n- ❌ Importer CLI, Runtime, Infra\n- ❌ Démarrer/arrêter des services\n\n### 3.2 ETHAN Runtime (ethan-runtime/)\n\n**Rôle** : Couche d'orchestration. Gestion des services UNIQUEMENT.\n\n| Responsibility | Description |\n|----------------|-------------|\n| Service orchestration | Démarrer/arrêter/redémarrer services |\n| EventBus management | NATS broker, topics, subscriptions |\n| Scheduling | Planification de tâches |\n| Health checks | Monitoring des services |\n| Lifecycle management | Démarrage/arrêt propre |\n| Metrics collection | Télémetrie |\n\n**What Runtime CAN do:**\n- ✅ Démarrer/arrêter Core\n- ✅ Gérer NATS\n- ✅ Orchestrer les services\n- ✅ Collecter des métriques\n- ✅ Gérer le lifecycle\n\n**What Runtime CANNOT do:**\n- ❌ Exécuter de la logique AI\n- ❌ Importer Core directement\n- ❌ Contenir de la logique métier\n- ❌ Afficher du output utilisateur\n\n### 3.3 ETHAN CLI (ethan-cli/)\n\n**Rôle** : Interface terminal. Zéro logique AI.\n\n| Responsibility | Description |\n|----------------|-------------|\n| User input | Parse, validate |\n| Display | Render output |\n| HTTP client | Appels à Core (UNIQUE interface) |\n| REPL loop | Interactive session |\n| Commands | Dispatch commands |\n\n**What CLI CAN do:**\n- ✅ Appeler Core via HTTP/gRPC\n- ✅ Afficher du output\n- ✅ Gérer l'input utilisateur\n- ✅ Importer Runtime (pour `ethan start/stop`)\n\n**What CLI CANNOT do:**\n- ❌ Exécuter de la logique AI\n- ❌ Importer Core directement\n- ❌ Appeler des providers LLM\n- ❌ Contenir de la logique métier\n- ❌ Accéder à la mémoire directement\n\n### 3.4 ETHAN Plugins (ethan-plugins/)\n\n**Rôle** : Extensions. Capacités dynamiques.\n\n| Responsibility | Description |\n|----------------|-------------|\n| Tool execution | Shell, web, file tools |\n| Skills | Découverte et exécution |\n| Capabilities | Fonctionnalités étendues |\n| Integration | Connecteurs externes |\n\n**What Plugins CAN do:**\n- ✅ S'abonner à NATS\n- ✅ Publier des événements\n- ✅ Appeler Core via gRPC (read-only)\n- ✅ Exécuter des outils (sandboxed)\n\n**What Plugins CANNOT do:**\n- ❌ Importer Core directement\n- ❌ Modifier l'état Core directement\n- ❌ Importer CLI\n- ❌ Sortir du sandbox\n\n### 3.5 ETHAN Infra (ethan-infra/)\n\n**Rôle** : Ressources de déploiement. Zéro code exécutable.\n\n| Responsibility | Description |\n|----------------|-------------|\n| Docker configs | Dockerfiles, compose |\n| K8s manifests | Deployments, services |\n| Systemd services | Service files |\n| Scripts | Shell scripts utilitaires |\n| Monitoring | Prometheus, Grafana configs |\n\n**What Infra CAN do:**\n- ✅ Contenir des fichiers de config\n- ✅ Contenir des scripts shell\n- ✅ Contenir des manifests\n\n**What Infra CANNOT do:**\n- ❌ Contenir du code Python/Go exécutable\n- ❌ Être importé par Core/CLI/Runtime\n- ❌ Contenir de la logique métier\n\n---\n\n## 4. Dependency Matrix\n\n### 4.1 Allowed Dependencies\n\n| From ↓ / To → | Core | Runtime | CLI | Plugins | Infra | SDK |\n|---------------|------|---------|-----|---------|-------|-----|\n| **Core** | ✅ | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ |\n| **Runtime** | ✅ gRPC | ✅ | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ |\n| **CLI** | ✅ HTTP | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ |\n| **Plugins** | ✅ gRPC read | ❌ | ❌ | ✅ | ❌ | ✅ |\n| **Infra** | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ | ✅ | ❌ |\n| **SDK** | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ | ✅ | ❌ | ✅ |\n\n### 4.2 Communication Protocols\n\n| Layer | Protocol | Port | Usage |\n|-------|----------|------|-------|\n| CLI → Core | HTTP/REST | 8000 | Simple requests |\n| CLI → Runtime | HTTP/REST | 8001 | Service management |\n| Core ↔ Runtime | gRPC | 50051 | High-performance |\n| Core ↔ Plugins | NATS | 4222 | Event pub/sub |\n| Core → Plugins | gRPC | 50052 | Read-only state |\n\n### 4.3 Forbidden Dependencies\n\n```python\n# ❌ CORE NE PEUT JAMAIS:\nfrom ethan_cli import ...          # Pas d'import CLI\nfrom ethan_runtime import ...      # Pas d'import Runtime\nfrom ethan_infra import ...        # Pas d'import Infra\nimport docker                      # Pas de Docker\nimport systemd                     # Pas de systemd\nimport os; os.getenv(...)          # Pas de dépendance OS\n\n# ❌ RUNTIME NE PEUT JAMAIS:\nfrom ethan_core import ...         # Pas d'import Core (sauf types)\nfrom ethan_cli import ...          # Pas d'import CLI\nimport asyncio; ...                # Pas de logique métier\n\n# ❌ CLI NE PEUT JAMAIS:\nfrom ethan_core import ...         # Pas d'import Core direct\nfrom ethan_runtime import ...      # Pas d'import Runtime direct (sauf client)\nimport openai                      # Pas de provider LLM\nimport anthropic                   # Pas de provider LLM\n\n# ❌ PLUGINS NE PEUVENT JAMAIS:\nfrom ethan_core import ...         # Pas d'import Core direct\nfrom ethan_cli import ...          # Pas d'import CLI\nimport subprocess                  # Pas de shell direct (sandbox only)\n```\n\n---\n\n## 5. ## ETHAN Ecosystem Architecture — Redesign complet

### Livrable

`ECOSYSTEM_ARCHITECTURE.md` — Architecture écosystème en couches indépendantes.

### Structure repository (finale)

```
ethan/
├── ethan-core/       # 🧠 AI Brain (Go)
├── ethan-runtime/    # ⚙️ Orchestration (Go)
├── ethan-cli/        # 💻 Terminal Interface (Python)
├── ethan-plugins/    # 🔌 Plugin Ecosystem
├── ethan-infra/      # 🏗️ Infrastructure (YAML/Shell)
├── ethan-sdk/        # 📦 Public SDK
├── proto/            # 📄 Protobuf Schemas
├── docs/
├── tests/
└── examples/
```

### Responsabilités par couche

| Couche | Rôle | Peut | Ne peut pas |
|--------|------|------|-------------|
| **Core** | Cerveau AI | Recevoir events, appeler LLM, lire/écrire state | Connaître Docker/systemd/terminal |
| **Runtime** | Orchestration | Démarrer/arrêter services, gérer NATS | Exécuter logique AI |
| **CLI** | Interface | Appeler Core via HTTP, afficher output | Contenir logique AI |
| **Plugins** | Extensions | S'abonner NATS, exécuter outils sandboxed | Importer Core directement |
| **Infra** | Déploiement | Contenir configs/scripts | Contenir code exécutable |

### Communication

| De | Vers | Protocole | Port |
|-----|------|-----------|------|
| CLI → Core | HTTP/REST | 8000 |
| CLI → Runtime | HTTP/REST | 8001 |
| Core ↔ Runtime | gRPC | 50051 |
| Core ↔ Plugins | NATS | 4222 |

### Migration

- 4 étapes, 8 semaines
- Backward compatibility maintenue
- Zero downtime

37 passed, 1 warning in 0.03s

ETHAN Runtime is a background service responsible for orchestrating the entire ETHAN ecosystem.

- stop services
- restart services

- manage Docker Compose

                                      │\n└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘\n```\n\n### 3.2 Service MaxRetries      int\n    BackoffDuration time.Duration\n    BackoffFactor   float64\n    MaxBackoff      time.Duration\n}\n\nfunc (p *RestartPolicy) NextDelay(attempt int) time.Duration {\n    if attempt >= p.MaxRetries {\n        return 0 // Stop retrying\n    }\n    delay := p.BackoffDuration * time.Duration(math.Pow(p.BackoffFactor, float64(attempt)))\n    if delay > p.MaxBackoff {\n        delay = p.MaxBackoff\n    }\n    return delay\n}\n```\n\n---\n\n## 4. \"stopped\"\n}\n```\n\n#### Restart Service\n\n```json\n{\n  \"command\": \"restart\",\n  \"service\": \"ethan-core\",\n  \"timeout\": 60\n}\n```\n\n```json\n{\n  \"status\": \"ok\",\n  \"service\": }\n}\n```\n\n#### List All Services\n\n```json\n{\n  \"command\": \"list\"\n}\n```\n\n```json\n{\n  \"status\": \"ok\",\n  \"services\": [\n    {\n      \"name\": \"ethan-core\",\n      \"state\": on :50051\"\n  ]\n}\n```\n\n#### Error Response\n\n```json\n{\n  \"status\": \"error\",\n  \"error\": \"service not found\",\n  \"code\": \"SERVICE_NOT_FOUND\"\n}\n```\n\n### 4.3 Error Codes\n\n| Code | Description |\n|------|-------------|\n| `SERVICE_NOT_FOUND` | Service does not exist |\n| `SERVICE_ALREADY_RUNNING` | Service already running |\n| `SERVICE_ALREADY_STOPPED` | Service already stopped |\n| `START_TIMEOUT` | Service failed to start within timeout |\n| `STOP_TIMEOUT` | Service failed to stop within timeout |\n| `DOCKER_ERROR` | Docker Compose error |\n| `CONFIG_ERROR` | Configuration error |\n| `INTERNAL_ERROR` | Runtime internal error |\n\n---\n\n## 5. Communication Model\n\n### 5.1 CLI ↔ Runtime\n\n```\nCLI (Python)\n    │\n    │ Unix socket (/var/run/ethan/runtime.sock)\n    │ Newline-delimited JSON\n    │\n    ▼\nRuntime (Go)\n```\n\n**CLI Client Example**:\n\n```python\n# ethan-cli/ethan/client.py\nimport socket\nimport json\n\nclass RuntimeClient:\n    def __init__(self, socket_path=\"/var/run/ethan/runtime.sock\"):\n        self.socket_path = socket_path\n    \n    def send(self, command: dict) -> dict:\n        with socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX, socket.SOCK_STREAM) as sock:\n            sock.connect(self.socket_path)\n            sock.sendall((json.dumps(command) + \"\\n\").encode())\n            response = sock.recv(4096).decode()\n            return json.loads(response)\n    \n    def start(self, service: str, timeout: int = 30) -> dict:\n        return self.send({\n            \"command\": \"start\",\n            \"service\": service,\n            \"timeout\": timeout\n        })\n    \n    def stop(self, service: str, timeout: int = 30) -> dict:\n        return self.send({\n            \"command\": \"stop\",\n            \"service\": service,\n            \"timeout\": timeout\n        })\n    \n    def status(self, service: str = None) -> dict:\n        cmd = {\"command\": \"status\"}\n        if service:\n            cmd[\"service\"] = service\n        return self.send(cmd)\n    \n    def list(self) -> dict:\n        return self.send({\"command\": \"list\"})\n```\n\n### 5.2 Runtime ↔ Docker Compose\n\n```\nRuntime (Go)\n    │\n    │ docker compose CLI\n    │ or Docker SDK\n    │\n    ▼\nDocker Compose\n    │\n    ├─ ethan-core\n    ├─ ethan-plugins\n    ├─ redis\n    ├─ postgres\n    └─ nats\n```\n\n**Implementation**:\n\n```go\n// runtime/internal/compose/docker.go\ntype ComposeManager struct {\n    projectPath string\n}\n\nfunc (c *ComposeManager) Up(ctx context.Context, services []string) error {\n    args := []string{\"compose\", \"up\", \"-d\"}\n    if len(services) > 0 {\n        args = append(args, services...)\n    }\n    \n    cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, \"docker\", args...)\n    cmd.Dir = c.projectPath\n    cmd.Env = os.Environ()\n    \n    output, err := cmd.CombinedOutput()\n    if err != nil {\n        return fmt.Errorf(\"docker compose up failed: %w: %s\", err, string(output))\n    }\n    \n    return nil\n}\n```\n\n### 5.3 Runtime ↔ Core (gRPC)\n\n```\nRuntime (Go)\n    │\n    │ gRPC (port 50051)\n    │ Health check, metrics\n    │\n    ▼\nCore (Go)\n```\n\n**gRPC Service**:\n\n```protobuf\n// proto/ethan/runtime/core.proto\nservice CoreService {\n  rpc HealthCheck(HealthCheckRequest) returns (HealthCheckResponse);\n  rpc GetMetrics(MetricsRequest) returns (MetricsResponse);\n  rpc GetStatus(StatusRequest) returns (StatusResponse);\n}\n\nmessage HealthCheckRequest {\n  string service = 1;\n}\n\nmessage HealthCheckResponse {\n  bool healthy = 1;\n  string error = 2;\n  int64 latency_ms = 3;\n}\n```\n\n### 5.4 Runtime ↔ Plugins (NATS)\n\n```\nRuntime (Go)\n    │\n    │ NATS (port 4222)\n    │ Events: runtime.*\n    │\n    ▼\nPlugins (Python/TS)\n```\n\n**NATS Subjects**:\n\n| Subject | Publisher | Subscribers | Description |\n|---------|-----------|-------------|-------------|\n| `ethan.runtime.started` | Runtime | All | Runtime started |\n| `ethan.runtime.stopped` | Runtime | All | Runtime | Service error |\n| `ethan.runtime.heartbeat` | Runtime | All | Periodic heartbeat |\n\n---\n\n## 6. Configuration\n\n### 6.1 Config File\n\n```yaml\n# ethan-runtime/config/runtime.yaml\nproject: ethan\ncompose_file: docker-compose.yml\n\nsocket:\n  path: /var/run/ethan/runtime.sock\n  permissions: 0660\n\nservices:\n  ethan-core:\n    image: ethan/core:latest\n    ports:\n      - \"8000:8000\"\n      - \"50051:50051\"\n    environment:\n      - NATS_URL=nats://nats:4222\n      - REDIS_URL=redis://redis:6379\n      - POSTGRES_URL=postgres://postgres:5432/ethan\n    depends_on:\n      - redis\n      - postgres\n      - nats\n    healthcheck:\n      test: [\"CMD\", \"curl\", \"-f\", \"http://localhost:8000/health\"]\n      interval: 10s\n      timeout: 5s\n      retries: 3\n    restart: unless-stopped\n\n  ethan-plugins:\n    image: ethan/plugins:latest\n    environment:\n      - NATS_URL=nats://nats:4222\n    depends_on:\n      - ethan-core\n      - nats\n    healthcheck:\n      test: [\"CMD\", \"curl\", \"-f\", \"http://localhost:8001/health\"]\n      interval: 10s\n      timeout: 5s\n      retries: 3\n\n  redis:\n    image: redis:7-alpine\n    ports:\n      - \"6379:6379\"\n    volumes:\n      - redis-data:/data\n\n  postgres:\n    image: postgres:16\n    ports:\n      - \"5432:5432\"\n    environment:\n      - POSTGRES_DB=ethan\n      - POSTGRES_[REDACTED:ENV_VAR]    volumes:\n      - postgres-data:/data\n\n  nats:\n    image: nats:2\n    ports:\n      - \"4222:4222\"\n\nvolumes:\n  redis-data:\n  postgres-data:\n\nlogging:\n  level: info\n  format: json\n```\n\n### 6.2 Environment Variables\n\n```bash\n# Runtime configuration\nETHAN_PROJECT=ethan\nETHAN_COMPOSE_FILE=docker-compose.yml\nETHAN_SOCKET_PATH=/var/run/ethan/runtime.sock\nETHAN_CONFIG_PATH=/etc/ethan/runtime.yaml\n\n# Docker\nDOCKER_HOST=unix:///var/run/docker.sock\n\n# Logging\nLOG_LEVEL=info\nLOG_FORMAT=json\n```\n\n---\n\n## 7. Implementation\n\n### 7.1 Main Entry Point\n\n```go\n// runtime/cmd/runtime/main.go\npackage main\n\nimport (\n    \"context\"\n    \"log\"\n    \"os\"\n    \"os/signal\"\n    \"syscall\"\n    \n    \"github.com/ethan/runtime/internal/service\"\n    \"github.com/ethan/runtime/internal/compose\"\n    \"github.com/ethan/runtime/internal/monitor\"\n    \"github.com/ethan/runtime/internal/api\"\n    \"github.com/ethan/runtime/internal/config\"\n)\n\nfunc main() {\n    ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())\n    defer cancel()\n    \n    // 1. Load configuration\n    loader := config.NewLoader()\n    cfg, err := loader.Load(os.Getenv(\"ETHAN_CONFIG_PATH\"))\n    if err != nil {\n        log.Fatalf(\"Failed to load config: %v\", err)\n    }\n    \n    // 2. Initialize Docker Compose manager\n    composeMgr := compose.NewManager(cfg.Project, cfg.ComposeFile)\n    \n    // 3. Initialize service manager\n    svcMgr := service.NewManager(composeMgr, cfg.Services)\n    \n    // 4. Initialize health monitor\n    healthMonitor := monitor.NewHealthMonitor(svcMgr, 10*time.Second)\n    \n    // 5. Start health monitor\n    if err := healthMonitor.Start(ctx); err != nil {\n        log.Fatalf(\"Failed to start health monitor: %v\", err)\n    }\n    \n    // 6. Start Unix socket server\n    socketServer := api.NewSocketServer(svcMgr, healthMonitor)\n    if err := socketServer.Start(cfg.Socket.Path); err != nil {\n        log.Fatalf(\"Failed to start socket server: %v\", err)\n    }\n    defer socketServer.Stop()\n    \n    log.Println(\"ETHAN Runtime started\")\n    \n    // 7. Wait for shutdown signal\n    sigChan := make(chan os.Signal, 1)\n    signal.Notify(sigChan, syscall.SIGINT, syscall.SIGTERM)\n    <-sigChan\n    \n    log.Println(\"ETHAN Runtime shutting down\")\n}\n```\n\n### 7.2 Dockerfile\n\n```dockerfile\n# ethan-runtime/Dockerfile\nFROM golang:1.23-alpine AS builder\n\nWORKDIR /app\nCOPY go.mod go.sum ./\nRUN go mod download\n\nCOPY . .\nRUN CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=linux go build -o runtime ./cmd/runtime\n\nFROM alpine:latest\n\nRUN apk --no-cache add docker-cli\n\nCOPY --from=builder /app/runtime /usr/local/bin/ethan-runtime\n\nENTRYPOINT [\"ethan-runtime\"]\n```\n\n### 7.3 Systemd Service\n\n```ini\n# ethan-infra/systemd/ethan-runtime.service\n[Unit]\nDescription=ETHAN Runtime\nAfter=docker.service\nRequires=docker.service\n\n[Service]\nType=simple\nUser=ethan\nGroup=ethan\nWorkingDirectory=/opt/ethan/runtime\nExecStart=/usr/local/bin/ethan-runtime\nRestart=always\nRestartSec=10\n\n# Socket\nSocketPath=/var/run/ethan/runtime.sock\nSocketMode=0660\nSocketUser=ethan\nSocketGroup=ethan\n\n# Logging\nStandardOutput=journal\nStandardError=journal\nSyslogIdentifier=ethan-runtime\n\n[Install]\nWantedBy=multi-user.target\n```\n\n---\n\n## 8. Security\n\n### 8.1 Unix Socket Permissions\n\n```go\n// runtime/internal/api/socket.go\nfunc (s *SocketServer) Start(path string) error {\n    listener, err := net.Listen(\"unix\", path)\n    if err != nil {\n        return err\n    }\n    \n    // Set permissions (0660)\n    if err := os.Chmod(path, 0660); err != nil {\n        return err\n    }\n    \n    // Set group ownership\n    if err := os.Chown(path, os.Getuid(), 1000); err != nil {\n        return err\n    }\n    \n    s.listener = listener\n    return nil\n}\n```\n\n### 8.2 Command Authorization\n\n```go\n// runtime/internal/api/auth.go\ntype CommandAuth struct {\n    allowedUsers map[string]bool\n}\n\nfunc (a *CommandAuth) Authorize(conn net.Conn) error {\n    // Get UID of connected process\n    ucred, err := getUnixCred(conn)\n    if err != nil {\n        return err\n    }\n    \n    // Check if user is allowed\n    if !a.allowedUsers[ucred.UID] {\n        return fmt.Errorf(\"unauthorized user: %d\", ucred.UID)\n    }\n    \n    return nil\n}\n\nfunc getUnixCred(conn net.Conn) (*ucred, error) {\n    // Implementation using SO_PEERCRED\n}\n```\n\n---\n\n## 9. ## ETHAN Runtime Architecture — Design complet

`RUNTIME_ARCHITECTURE.md` — Architecture du service d'orchestration Runtime.

### Responsabilités

| ✅ PEUT | ❌ NE PEUT PAS |
|---------|----------------|
| START/STOP/RESTART services | AI logic |
| Monitor health (ping, metrics) | LLM calls |
| Manage Docker Compose stacks | Business logic |
| Load configuration | User interaction |
| Expose Unix socket API | Plugin execution |
| Report status | |
| Manage service lifecycle | |

### Modules

| Module | Responsabilité |
|--------|----------------|
| **Service Manager** | start/stop/restart services |
| **Compose Manager** | Docker Compose wrapper |
| **Health Monitor** | Periodic health checks |
| **Config Loader** | YAML configuration |
| **Socket Server** | Unix socket API |
| **Status Reporter** | System status |

- **Unix Socket** : `/var/run/ethan/runtime.sock`
- **Protocol** : Newline-delimited JSON
- **Commands** : start/stop/restart/status/list/logs

| De | Vers | Protocole |
|-----|------|-----------|
| CLI ↔ Runtime | Unix socket | JSON |
| Runtime ↔ Docker | docker compose CLI | CLI |
| Runtime ↔ Core | gRPC | Port 50051 |
| Runtime ↔ Plugins | NATS | Port 4222 |

```
BOOT → RUNNING → SHUTDOWN
  • Auto-restart with exponential backoff
  • Health monitoring
  • Zero AI logic
```

## ETHAN Docker Architecture — Design complet

### Livrable

`DOCKER_ARCHITECTURE.md` — Architecture Docker pour l'écosystème ETHAN.

### Principes

| Principe | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| **Backend Only** | Docker contient UNIQUEMENT les services backend |
| **CLI Native** | Le CLI tourne sur l'hôte, JAMAIS dans Docker |
| **Runtime Orchestrates** | Le Runtime gère Docker Compose |
| **Minimal Containers** | Uniquement les services nécessaires |

### Containers (6)

| Container | Rôle | IP | Ports |
|-----------|------|----|-------|
| nats | Event bus | 172.20.0.2 | 4222 (internal) |
| redis | Session cache | 172.20.0.3 | 6379 |
| postgres | Persistent storage | 172.20.0.4 | 5432 |
| ethan-core | AI brain | 172.20.0.10 | 8000, 50051 |
| ethan-plugins | Extensions | 172.20.0.11 | 8001 (internal) |
| ethan-runtime | Orchestrator | 172.20.0.12 | 8002 (internal) |

### Startup Order

```
Phase 1: nats, redis, postgres (parallel)
Phase 2: ethan-core (after infra healthy)
Phase 3: ethan-plugins (after core healthy)
Phase 4: ethan-runtime (after all healthy)
```

### Fichiers

- `docker-compose.yml` — Production
- `docker-compose.dev.yml` — Development (live reload)
- `docker-compose.minimal.yml` — MVP (core + redis only)

### Health Checks

- Interval: 15s
- Timeout: 10s
- Retries: 3
- Start period: 10s

### Volumes

- nats-data, redis-data, postgres-data
- Backup strategy: daily dumps

### CLI

- **NEVER in Docker**
- Runs natively on host
- Communicates via Unix socket or HTTP

### Tests

```
37 passed, 1 warning in 0.03s
```HAS_CHANGES
