Architecture Principles\n\n```\n┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐\n│                    CLI Architecture Principles                        │\n├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤\n│                                                                       │\n│  1. Zero AI Logic                                                     │\n│     Le CLI ne contient JAMAIS de logique AI                          │\n│                                                                       │\n│  2. Runtime Only                                                      │\n│     Le CLI communique UNIQUEMENT avec le Runtime                     │\n│                                                                       │\n│  3. Thin Client                                                       │\n│     Le CLI est un client fin, pas un moteur                          │\n│                                                                       │\n│  4. Terminal Native                                                   │\n│     Interface terminal pure, pas de GUI                              │\n│                                                                       │\n│  5. Clean UI                                                          │\n│     Inspiré de Claude Code: minimal, précis, calme                  │\n│                                                                       │\n└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘\n```\n\n### What CLI CAN do\n\n```\n✅ Communicate with Runtime (Unix socket)\n✅ Display output (colors, spinners, tables)\n✅ Handle user input (REPL, commands)\n✅ Manage sessions (create, resume, delete)\n✅ Load configuration\n✅ Format errors\n✅ Provide autocomplete\n```\n\n### What CLI CANNOT do\n\n```\n❌ Execute AI logic\n❌ Call LLM providers directly\n❌ Import Core modules\n❌ Contain business logic\n❌ Access memory directly\n❌ Execute plugins directly\n```\n\n---\n\n## 2. Commands\n\n### 2.1 Command Structure\n\n```\nethan <command> [args] [flags]\n\nCommands:\n  chat                  Start interactive chat session\n  run <message>         One-shot message\n  status                Show system status\n  logs                  Show logs\n  config                Manage configuration\n  help                  Show help\n  version               Show version\n```\n\n### 2.2 Core Commands\n\n#### `ethan chat` — Interactive REPL\n\n```bash\n# Start interactive chat\nethan chat\n\n# Resume last session\nethan chat --resume\n\n# Resume specific session\nethan chat --session <session-id>\n\n# With specific model\nethan chat --model llama3:8b\n```\n\n**REPL Flow**:\n\n```\n◆  ethan  ◇  chat  ▸\n\n  User types message\n  │\n  ▼\n  CLI sends to Runtime\n  │\n  ▼\n  Runtime forwards to Core\n  │\n  ▼\n  Core processes (AI logic)\n  │\n  ▼\n  Response streams back\n  │\n  ▼\n  CLI displays response\n  │\n  ▼\n  Prompt returns\n```\n\n#### `ethan run` — One-shot\n\n```bash\n# Single message\nethan run \"Explain quantum computing\"\n\n# With options\nethan run \"Write a Python function\" --model gpt-4o\nethan run \"Analyze this code\" --file main.py\nethan run \"Summarize\" --context 10\n```\n\n#### `ethan status` — System Status\n\n```bash\n# Overall status\nethan status\n\n# Verbose\nethan status --verbose\n\n# JSON output\nethan status --json\n```\n\n**Output**:\n\n```\n◆  System Status\n\n  Runtime    ● ONLINE    pid: 1234\n  Core       ● ONLINE    pid: 1235\n  Plugins    ● ONLINE    pid: 1236\n  Redis      ● ONLINE    port: 6379\n  Postgres   ● ONLINE    port: 5432\n  NATS       ● ONLINE    port: 4222\n\n  Uptime: 2h 34m\n  Memory: 1.2GB / 4GB\n  CPU: 12%\n```\n\n#### `ethan logs` — View Logs\n\n```bash\n# Tail logs\nethan logs\n\n# Follow logs\nethan logs --follow\n\n# Specific service\nethan logs --service ethan-core\n\n# Last N lines\nethan logs --tail 100\n```\n\n#### `ethan config` — Configuration\n\n```bash\n# Show config\nethan config\n\n# Set value\nethan config set model.default llama3:8b\n\n# Get value\nethan config get model.default\n\n# Edit config file\nethan config edit\n```\n\n#### `ethan help` — Help\n\n```bash\n# General help\nethan help\n\n# Command help\nethan help chat\nethan help run\n```\n\n---\n\n## 3. Session Management\n\n### 3.1 Session Lifecycle\n\n```\n┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐\n│                    Session Lifecycle                                 │\n├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤\n│                                                                       │\n│  1. CREATE                                                           │\n│     ├─ User runs: ethan chat                                        │\n│     ├─ CLI creates new session ID                                   │\n│     ├─ CLI connects to Runtime                                      │\n│     └─ Runtime creates session in Redis                             │\n│                                                                       │\n│  2. ACTIVE                                                           │\n│     ├─ User sends messages                                          │\n│     ├─ CLI sends to Runtime                                         │\n│     ├─ Runtime maintains context                                    │\n│     └─ Messages stored in Redis                                     │\n│                                                                       │\n│  3. RESUME                                                           │\n│     ├─ User runs: ethan chat --resume                               │\n│     ├─ CLI requests last session from Runtime                       │\n│     ├─ Runtime loads session from Redis                             │\n│     └─ Context restored                                              │\n│                                                                       │\n│  4. END                                                               │\n│     ├─ User exits (CTRL+D or /exit)                                 │\n│     ├─ CLI disconnects from Runtime                                 │\n│     └─ Session remains in Redis (can resume later)                  │\n│                                                                       │\n└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘\n```\n\n### 3.2 Session Data Model\n\n```python\n# Session stored in Redis\nsession:{session_id} = {\n    \"id\": \"uuid\",\n    \"created_at\": \"2024-01-01T00:00:00Z\",\n    \"last_activity\": \"2024-01-01T00:05:00Z\",\n    \"model\": \"llama3:8b\",\n    \"message_count\": 10,\n    \"context_tokens\": 2048,\n}\n\nsession:{session_id}:history = [\n    {\"role\": \"user\", \"content\": \"Hello\"},\n    {\"role\": \"assistant\", \"content\": \"Hi! How can I help?\"},\n    # ... last 10 messages\n]\n```\n\n### 3.3 Session Commands\n\n```bash\n# In REPL\n/exit              # Exit session\n/new               # Start new session\n/resume            # Resume last session\n/session <id>      # Resume specific session\n/list              # List recent sessions\n/delete <id>       # Delete session\n/clear             # Clear current session\n```\n\n---\n\n## 4. Configuration\n\n### 4.1 Config File\n\n```yaml\n# ~/.config/ethan/config.yaml\n\n# Default model\nmodel:\n  default: llama3:8b\n  fallback: llama3:8b\n\n# Runtime connection\nruntime:\n  socket: /var/run/ethan/runtime.sock\n  # Or HTTP:\n  # url: http://localhost:8000\n\n# UI settings\nui:\n  theme: dark  # dark, light\n  stream: true  # Stream responses\n  timestamps: false\n  line_numbers: false\n\n# Session settings\nsession:\n  auto_save: true\n  max_history: 10  # messages to keep in context\n  resume_last: true\n\n# Logging\nlogging:\n  level: info  # debug, info, warning, error\n  file: ~/.ethan/logs/ethan.log\n```\n\n### 4.2 Config Locations\n\n```\n~/.config/ethan/config.yaml      # User config\n~/.config/ethan/config.local.yaml # Local overrides (gitignored)\n./ethan.config.yaml               # Project config (cwd)\n```\n\n### 4.3 Config Priority\n\n```\n1. CLI flags (highest)\n2. Environment variables (ETHAN_*)\n3. Local config (./ethan.config.yaml)\n4. User config (~/.config/ethan/config.yaml)\n5. Defaults (lowest)\n```\n\n---\n\n## 5. Startup Flow\n\n### 5.1 Startup Sequence\n\n```\n┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐\n│                    CLI Startup Flow                                  │\n├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤\n│                                                                       │\n│  1. PARSE ARGUMENTS                                                   │\n│     ├─ Parse command line                                            │\n│     ├─ Load config                                                   │\n│     └─ Merge with defaults                                           │\n│                                                                       │\n│  2. CHECK RUNTIME                                                     │\n│     ├─ Connect to Unix socket                                        │\n│     ├─ Or check HTTP endpoint                                        │\n│     └─ Show error if not available                                   │\n│                                                                       │\n│  3. LOAD SESSION (if chat --resume)                                  │\n│     ├─ Request last session from Runtime                             │\n│     └─ Load history from Redis                                       │\n│                                                                       │\n│  4. START UI                                                          │\n│     ├─ Show welcome banner                                           │\n│     ├─ Show session info                                             │\n│     └─ Start REPL loop                                               │\n│                                                                       │\n│  5. EVENT LOOP                                                        │\n│     ├─ Read user input                                               │\n│     ├─ Send to Runtime                                               │\n│     ├─ Display response                                              │\n│     └─ Repeat until exit                                             │\n│                                                                       │\n│  6. SHUTDOWN                                                          │\n│     ├─ Save session (if auto_save)                                   │\n│     ├─ Disconnect from Runtime                                       │\n│     └─ Exit cleanly                                                  │\n│                                                                       │\n└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘\n```\n\n### 5.2 Startup Code\n\n```python\n# ethan-cli/ethan/main.py\n\ndef main():\n    # 1. Parse arguments\n    args = parse_args()\n    \n    # 2. Load config\n    config = load_config(args.config)\n    \n    # 3. Check runtime\n    runtime = RuntimeClient(config.runtime.socket)\n    if not runtime.is_available():\n        print_error(\"Runtime not available. Run 'ethan start' first.\")\n        sys.exit(1)\n    \n    # 4. Start command\n    if args.command == \"chat\":\n        start_chat(args, config, runtime)\n    elif args.command == \"run\":\n        run_once(args, config, runtime)\n    elif args.command == \"status\":\n        show_status(runtime)\n    elif args.command == \"logs\":\n        show_logs(args, runtime)\n    elif args.command == \"config\":\n        manage_config(args)\n    elif args.command == \"help\":\n        show_help(args)\n    else:\n        show_help()\n```\n\n---\n\n## 6. UI Design\n\n### 6.1 Visual Style (Claude Code inspired)\n\n```\n┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐\n│                    UI Design Principles                               │\n├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤\n│                                                                       │\n│  • Minimal: No clutter, no decoration                                │\n│  • Monospace: System font, consistent                                │\n│  • Colors: Blue (primary), Cyan (info), Green (success),            │\n│            Red (error), Purple (thinking), Dim (metadata)            │\n│  • Icons: Minimal set (✓ ✗ ⚠ ℹ → ◆)                                │\n│  • Spacing: 2-space indent, single-spaced                            │\n│  • Feedback: Always show progress                                    │\n│                                                                       │\n└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘\n```\n\n### 6.2 Prompt Design\n\n```\n◆  ethan  ◇  chat  ▸\n\nAnatomy:\n◆           — Brand marker (blue)\nethan       — System name (bold white)\n◇           — Separator (dim)\nchat        — Mode badge (cyan)\n▸           — Input cursor (blue)\n\nModes:\n  idle      → Green (ready)\n  chat      → Cyan (in chat)\n  thinking  → Purple (processing)\n  error     → Red (error)\n```\n\n### 6.3 Output Format\n\n```python\n# Success\n✓  Message sent\n\n# Error\n✗  Connection failed\n  → Runtime not available\n  → Try: ethan start\n\n# Info\nℹ  Session resumed: abc123\n\n# Thinking\n⠋  Processing...\n\n# Streaming (real-time)\n⠋  ethan  Generating response...\n  (tokens appear smoothly)\n```\n\n### 6.4 UI Components\n\n```python\n# ethan-cli/ethan/ui/\n\ncolors.py       # ANSI color constants\nstreamer.py     # Streaming output handler\nprompts.py      # Prompt rendering\nspinner.py      # Spinner animations\ntables.py       # Table formatting\nerrors.py       # Error formatting\n```\n\n---\n\n## 7. Error Handling\n\n### 7.1 Error Categories\n\n| Category | Code | Example | Action |\n|----------|------|---------|--------|\n| **Runtime** | RUNTIME-001 | Runtime not available | Start runtime |\n| **Network** | NETWORK-001 | Connection refused | Check socket |\n| **Session** | SESSION-001 | Session not found | Create new |\n| **Config** | CONFIG-001 | Invalid config | Check file |\n| **Command** | CMD-001 | Unknown command | Show help |\n\n### 7.2 Error Format\n\n```python\ndef format_error(code: str, title: str, context: str = \"\", suggestion: str = \"\"):\n    \"\"\"Format error message.\"\"\"\n    lines = [\n        f\"{C.RED}{I.CROSS} {title}{C.RESET}\",\n    ]\n    if context:\n        lines.append(f\"  {C.DIM}{I.ARROW} {context}{C.RESET}\")\n    if suggestion:\n        lines.append(f\"  {C.CYAN}{I.ARROW} {suggestion}{C.RESET}\")\n    return \"\\n\".join(lines)\n\n# Example output:\n# ✗ Runtime not available\n#   → Socket not found: /var/run/ethan/runtime.sock\n#   → Try: ethan start\n```\n\n### 7.3 Error Recovery\n\n```\nError Detected\n    │\n    ▼\n1. Classify error\n   - Recoverable (retry)\n   - Fatal (exit)\n   \n2. If recoverable:\n   - Show error\n   - Suggest action\n   - Retry or wait for user\n   \n3. If fatal:\n   - Show error\n   - Suggest fix\n   - Exit with code 1\n```\n\n---\n\n## 8. Communication with Runtime\n\n### 8.1 Unix Socket Client\n\n```python\n# ethan-cli/ethan/client.py\n\nimport socket\nimport json\nfrom typing import Any\n\nclass RuntimeClient:\n    \"\"\"Client for communicating with ETHAN Runtime.\"\"\"\n    \n    def __init__(self, socket_path: str = \"/var/run/ethan/runtime.sock\"):\n        self.socket_path = socket_path\n    \n    def send(self, command: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:\n        \"\"\"Send command to Runtime.\"\"\"\n        try:\n            with socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX, socket.SOCK_STREAM) as sock:\n                sock.connect(self.socket_path)\n                sock.sendall((json.dumps(command) + \"\\n\").encode())\n                response = sock.recv(4096).decode()\n                return json.loads(response)\n        except FileNotFoundError:\n            raise RuntimeError(\"Runtime not available\")\n        except ConnectionRefusedError:\n            raise RuntimeError(\"Runtime not running\")\n    \n    def chat(self, message: str, session_id: str = None) -> dict:\n        \"\"\"Send chat message.\"\"\"\n        return self.send({\n            \"command\": \"chat\",\n            \"message\": message,\n            \"session_id\": session_id,\n        })\n    \n    def status(self) -> dict:\n        \"\"\"Get system status.\"\"\"\n        return self.send({\"command\": \"status\"})\n    \n    def logs(self, service: str = None, tail: int = 100) -> dict:\n        \"\"\"Get logs.\"\"\"\n        cmd = {\"command\": \"logs\", \"tail\": tail}\n        if service:\n            cmd[\"service\"] = service\n        return self.send(cmd)\n```\n\n### 8.2 HTTP Fallback\n\n```python\n# If Unix socket not available, fallback to HTTP\n\nclass RuntimeClient:\n    def __init__(self, socket_path: str = None, http_url: str = None):\n        self.socket_path = socket_path\n        self.http_url = http_url or \"http://localhost:8000\"\n    \n    def send(self, command: dict) -> dict:\n        # Try Unix socket first\n        if self.socket_path:\n            try:\n                return self._send_socket(command)\n            except (FileNotFoundError, ConnectionRefusedError):\n                pass\n        \n        # Fallback to HTTP\n        return self._send_http(command)\n    \n    def _send_http(self, command: dict) -> dict:\n        import httpx\n        response = httpx.post(\n            f\"{self.http_url}/v1/runtime\",\n            json=command,\n            timeout=30.0,\n        )\n        return response.json()\n```\n\n---\n\n## 9. REPL Implementation\n\n### 9.1 REPL Loop\n\n```python\n# ethan-cli/ethan/repl.py\n\nimport sys\nfrom prompt_toolkit import PromptSession\nfrom prompt_toolkit.history import FileHistory\nfrom prompt_toolkit.auto_suggest import AutoSuggestFromHistory\n\nclass REPL:\n    \"\"\"Interactive REPL for ETHAN.\"\"\"\n    \n    def __init__(self, runtime: RuntimeClient, config: Config):\n        self.runtime = runtime\n        self.config = config\n        self.session = PromptSession(\n            history=FileHistory(os.path.expanduser(\"~/.ethan/history\")),\n            auto_suggest=AutoSuggestFromHistory(),\n        )\n        self.current_session_id = None\n    \n    def run(self):\n        \"\"\"Run REPL loop.\"\"\"\n        self.show_welcome()\n        \n        while True:\n            try:\n                # Read input\n                user_input = self.session.prompt(self.get_prompt())\n                \n                # Handle commands\n                if user_input.startswith(\"/\"):\n                    self.handle_command(user_input)\n                    continue\n                \n                # Send to Runtime\n                self.send_message(user_input)\n                \n            except KeyboardInterrupt:\n                # CTRL+C: cancel current input\n                continue\n            except EOFError:\n                # CTRL+D: exit\n                self.exit()\n                break\n    \n    def get_prompt(self) -> str:\n        \"\"\"Get prompt string.\"\"\"\n        mode = \"chat\"\n        if self.current_session_id:\n            mode = f\"chat · {self.current_session_id[:8]}\"\n        return f\"{C.BLUE}{I.SECTION}{C.RESET}  {C.BOLD}ethan{C.RESET}  {C.CYAN}{mode}{C.RESET}  {C.BLUE}{I.INPUT}{C.RESET} \"\n    \n    def send_message(self, message: str):\n        \"\"\"Send message to Runtime.\"\"\"\n        # Show thinking indicator\n        with Spinner(\"dots\") as spinner:\n            spinner.start(\"Thinking...\")\n            \n            # Send to Runtime\n            response = self.runtime.chat(message, self.current_session_id)\n            \n            # Stop spinner\n            spinner.stop()\n        \n        # Display response\n        if response.get(\"success\"):\n            self.current_session_id = response[\"session_id\"]\n            print(response[\"response\"])\n        else:\n            print_error(response.get(\"error\", \"Unknown error\"))\n```\n\n### 9.2 Special Commands\n\n```python\nSPECIAL_COMMANDS = {\n    \"/exit\": \"Exit REPL\",\n    \"/quit\": \"Exit REPL\",\n    \"/new\": \"Start new session\",\n    \"/resume\": \"Resume last session\",\n    \"/session <id>\": \"Resume specific session\",\n    \"/list\": \"List recent sessions\",\n    \"/delete <id>\": \"Delete session\",\n    \"/clear\": \"Clear current session\",\n    \"/help\": \"Show help\",\n    \"/config\": \"Show configuration\",\n}\n```\n\n---\n\n## 10. Implementation\n\n### 10.1 Project Structure\n\n```\nethan-cli/\n├── ethan/\n│   ├── __init__.py\n│   ├── main.py              # Entry point\n│   ├── repl.py              # REPL loop\n│   ├── client.py            # Runtime client\n│   ├── config.py            # Configuration\n│   ├── commands/            # CLI commands\n│   │   ├── __init__.py\n│   │   ├── chat.py\n│   │   ├── run.py\n│   │   ├── status.py\n│   │   ├── logs.py\n│   │   └── config.py\n│   └── ui/                  # UI components\n│       ├── __init__.py\n│       ├── colors.py\n│       ├── streamer.py\n│       ├── spinner.py\n│       ├── prompts.py\n│       └── errors.py\n├── pyproject.toml\n└── requirements.txt\n```\n\n### 10.2 Dependencies\n\n```txt\n# requirements.txt\nhttpx>=0.25.0          # HTTP client\nprompt-toolkit>=3.0    # REPL\npyyaml>=6.0            # Config\nrich>=13.0             # UI (optional, for tables)\n```\n\n### 10.3 Entry Point\n\n```python\n# ethan-cli/ethan/main.py\n\nimport sys\nfrom ethan.config import load_config\nfrom ethan.client import RuntimeClient\nfrom ethan.commands import chat, run, status, logs, config\n\ndef main():\n    args = parse_args()\n    \n    # Load config\n    cfg = load_config(args.config)\n    \n    # Create runtime client\n    runtime = RuntimeClient(\n        socket_path=cfg.runtime.socket,\n        http_url=cfg.runtime.http_url,\n    )\n    \n    # Dispatch command\n    if args.command == \"chat\":\n        chat.run(args, cfg, runtime)\n    elif args.command == \"run\":\n        run.once(args, cfg, runtime)\n    elif args.command == \"status\":\n        status.show(runtime)\n    elif args.command == \"logs\":\n        logs.show(args, runtime)\n    elif args.command == \"config\":\n        config.manage(args)\n    else:\n        show_help()\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    main()\n```\n\n---\n\n## 11. Summary\n\n```\n┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐\n│                    CLI DESIGN SUMMARY                                 │\n├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤\n│                                                                       │\n│  Philosophy                                                           │\n│  • Zero AI logic                                                     │\n│  • Runtime only communication                                        │\n│  • Thin client     │\n│  • Resume last or specific session                                   │\n│  • /new, /resume, /list, /delete commands                            │\n│ ## ETHAN CLI Design — Architecture complète

### Livrable

`CLI_DESIGN.md` — Design du CLI ETHAN inspiré de Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Codex CLI.

### Philosophie

| Principe | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| **Zero AI Logic** | Le CLI ne contient JAMAIS de logique AI |
| **Runtime Only** | Communique UNIQUEMENT avec le Runtime |
| **Thin Client** | Client fin, pas un moteur |
| **Terminal Native** | Interface terminal pure |
| **Clean UI** | Minimal, précis, calme (Claude Code style) |

### Commandes

| Commande | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `ethan chat` | REPL interactif |
| `ethan run <msg>` | One-shot message |
| `ethan status` | System status |
| `ethan logs` | View logs |
| `ethan config` | Manage config |
| `ethan help` | Show help |

### Session Management

- Auto-save to Redis
- Resume last/specific session
- Special commands: `/new`, `/resume`, `/list`, `/delete`, `/clear`

### Configuration

- File: `~/.config/ethan/config.yaml`
- Priority: CLI flags > env > local > user > defaults

### Startup Flow

```
Parse args → Check runtime → Load session → Start UI → Event loop
```

### Communication

- **Primary**: Unix socket (`/var/run/ethan/runtime.sock`)
- **Fallback**: HTTP (`localhost:8000`)

### UI Design

- Prompt: `◆ ethan ◇ chat ▸`
- Colors: Blue, Cyan, Green, Red, Purple, Dim
- Icons: ✓ ✗ ⚠ ℹ → ◆
- Spinner: `⠋⠙⠹⠸⠼⠴⠦⠧⠇⠏`

## ETHAN Communication Architecture — Design complet

### Livrable

`COMMUNICATION_DESIGN.md` — Architecture de communication entre CLI, Runtime et Core.

### Recommandation: Stack Hybride

| Path | Protocole | Pourquoi |
|------|-----------|----------|
| **CLI → Runtime** | Unix Socket | Natif Linux, < 1ms, SO_PEERCRED auth |
| **Runtime → Core** | gRPC | Type-safe, mTLS, streaming |
| **Core ↔ Plugins** | NATS | Event-driven, scalable, fiable |
| **CLI → Core (fallback)** | HTTP | Universel, facile à debugger |

### Comparaison IPC

| Critère | Unix Socket | HTTP | gRPC | IPC SysV |
|---------|-------------|------|------|----------|
| **Latence** | ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ < 1ms | ⭐⭐⭐ 10-50ms | ⭐⭐⭐⭐ 5-20ms | ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ < 1ms |
| **Sécurité** | ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ SO_PEERCRED | ⭐⭐⭐ TLS | ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ mTLS | ⭐⭐⭐ Key |
| **Linux natif** | ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ | ⭐⭐⭐ | ⭐⭐⭐⭐ | ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ |
| **Simplicité** | ⭐⭐⭐⭐ | ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ | ⭐⭐⭐ | ⭐⭐ |

### Performance

- **Unix Socket**: 0.3ms avg, ~500k msg/s
- **gRPC**: 2ms avg, ~100k msg/s
- **NATS**: 1ms avg, ~1M msg/s
- **HTTP**: 10ms avg, ~10k msg/s

### Sécurité

- Unix Socket: File perms + SO_PEERCRED (Linux kernel)
- gRPC: mTLS (mutual TLS)
- NATS: Token-based auth
- HTTP: API key

response.get(\"status\") == \"ok\":\n                # Wait for healthy\n                return await self._wait_for_healthy(service_name, timeout=30)\n            \n            return False\n        except Exception:\n            return False\n    \n    async def _wait_for_healthy(self, service: str, timeout: int = 30) -> bool:\n        \"\"\"Wait for service to become healthy.\"\"\"\n        start = time.time()\n        \n        while time.time() - start < timeout:\n            services = await self._check_services()\n            if services.get(service) == \"running\":\n                return True\n            await asyncio.sleep(1)\n        \n        return False\n    \n    async def _connect_cli(self, resume: bool = False) -> Optional[str]:\n        \"\"\"Connect CLI to Runtime.\"\"\"\n        # This establishes persistent connection\n        # Implementation depends on Runtime API\n        \n        if resume:\n            # Request last session from Runtime\n            response = self.runtime.send({\"command\": \"resume_last\"})\n            return response.get(\"session_id\")\n        \n        return None\n    \n    def _show_welcome(self, command: str, session_id: Optional[str]):\n        \"\"\"Show welcome banner.\"\"\"\n        if command == \"chat\":\n            if session_id:\n                print(f\"◆  ETHAN Chat  ◇  session {session_id[:8]}\")\n            else:\n                print(\"◆  ETHAN Chat\")\n            \n            print(\"  Ctrl+D or /exit to quit  •  /help for commands\")\n    \n    def _error(self, message: str) -> StartupResult:\n        \"\"\"Create error result.\"\"\"\n        duration_ms = int((time.time() - self.start_time) * 1000)\n        return StartupResult(\n            success=False,\n            runtime_ready=False,\n            services={},\n            session_id=None,\n            duration_ms=duration_ms,\n            error=message,\n        )\n```\n\n### 3.2 Main Entry Point\n\n```python\n# ethan-cli/ethan/main.py\n\nimport asyncio\nimport sys\nfrom ethan.startup import StartupOrchestrator\nfrom ethan.client import RuntimeClient\nfrom ethan.config import load_config\nfrom ethan.repl import REPL\nfrom ethan.commands import run, status, logs\n\ndef main():\n    # Parse arguments\n    args = parse_args()\n    \n    # Load config\n    config = load_config(args.config)\n    \n    # Create runtime client\n    runtime = RuntimeClient(config.runtime.socket)\n    \n    # Create startup orchestrator\n    orchestrator = StartupOrchestrator(runtime, config)\n    \n    # Execute startup\n    result = asyncio.run(orchestrator.startup(\n        command=args.command,\n        resume=args.resume,\n    ))\n    \n    if not result.success:\n        print_error(f\"Startup failed: {result.error}\")\n        sys.exit(1)\n    \n    # Execute command\n    if args.command == \"chat\":\n        repl = REPL(runtime, config, result.session_id)\n        repl.run()\n    elif args.command == \"run\":\n        run.once(args, runtime)\n    elif args.command == \"status\":\n        status.show(runtime)\n    elif args.command == \"logs\":\n        logs.show(args, runtime)\n    else:\n        # Default to chat\n        repl = REPL(runtime, config, result.session_id)\n        repl.run()\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    main()\n```\n\n---\n\n## 4. Error Handling\n\n### 4.1 Error Categories\n\n| Error | Cause | Recovery | User Action |\n|-------|-------|----------|--------------|\n| **DOCKER_NOT_FOUND** | Docker not installed | None | Install Docker |\n| **DOCKER_NOT_RUNNING** | Docker daemon stopped | Start Docker | `sudo systemctl start docker` |\n| **RUNTIME_START_FAILED** | Runtime binary missing/corrupt | Reinstall | `pip install --force-reinstall ethan` |\n| **RUNTIME_NOT_RESPONDING** | Runtime crashed | Restart | `ethan restart` |\n| **SERVICE_START_TIMEOUT** | Service failed to start | Check logs | `ethan logs --service <name>` |\n| **CORE_NOT_HEALTHY** | Core crashed | Restart | `ethan restart` |\n| **DATABASE_ERROR** | Postgres/Redis issue | Check config | Check connection strings |\n\n### 4.2 Error Display\n\n```python\ndef show_startup_error(error: str, hint: str = \"\"):\n    \"\"\"Display startup error with recovery hint.\"\"\"\n    print(f\"\\n✗ Startup failed\")\n    print(f\"  → {error}\")\n    if hint:\n        print(f\"  → {hint}\")\n    print()\n```\n\n**Example Output**:\n\n```\n✗ Startup failed\n  → Docker not available\n  → Install Docker: https://docs.docker.com/get-docker/\n```\n\n### 4.3 Retry Logic\n\n```python\nasync def _start_runtime_with_retry(self, max_retries: int = 3) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Start Runtime with retry logic.\"\"\"\n    for attempt in range(max_retries):\n        if await self._start_runtime():\n            return True\n        \n        if attempt < max_retries - 1:\n            await asyncio.sleep(2 ** attempt)  # Exponential backoff\n    \n    return False\n```\n\n---\n\n## 5. Performance Optimization\n\n### 5.1 Parallel Checks\n\n```python\nasync def _parallel_checks(self) -> tuple[bool, bool]:\n    \"\"\"Run checks in parallel.\"\"\"\n    docker_check = self._check_docker()\n    runtime_check = self._check_runtime()\n    \n    docker_ok, runtime_ok = await asyncio.gather(\n        docker_check,\n        runtime_check,\n    )\n    \n    return docker_ok, runtime_ok\n```\n\n### 5.2 Caching\n\n```python\n# Cache service status for 1s\n_cache = {}\n_cache_ttl = 1.0\n\nasync def _check_services_cached(self) -> dict[str, str]:\n    \"\"\"Check services with caching.\"\"\"\n    now = time.time()\n    \n    if \"services\" in _cache:\n        cached_time, services = _cache[\"services\"]\n        if now - cached_time < _cache_ttl:\n            return services\n    \n    services = await self._check_services()\n    _cache[\"services\"] = (now, services)\n    return services\n```\n\n### 5.3 Fast Path\n\n```python\nasync def startup(self) -> StartupResult:\n    \"\"\"Startup with fast path.\"\"\"\n    \n    # Fast path: everything already running\n    docker_ok = await self._check_docker()\n    runtime_ok = await self._check_runtime()\n    \n    if docker_ok and runtime_ok:\n        services = await self._check_services()\n        \n        # All services running?\n        if all(s == \"running\" for s in services.values()):\n            # Skip to connection\n            session_id = await self._connect_cli()\n            return self._success(services, session_id, \"fast\")\n    \n    # Slow path: start everything\n    return await self._full_startup()\n```\n\n---\n\n## 6. Configuration\n\n### 6.1 Startup Config\n\n```yaml\n# ~/.config/ethan/config.yaml\n\nstartup:\n  auto_start_runtime: true\n  auto_start_services: true\n  verify_docker: true\n  verify_databases: true\n  resume_last_session: true\n  startup_timeout: 30  # seconds\n  \n  # Services to auto-start\n  services:\n    - nats\n    - redis\n    - postgres\n    - ethan-core\n    - ethan-plugins\n  \n  # Health check settings\n  healthcheck:\n    interval: 15s\n    timeout: 10s\n    retries: 3\n```\n\n### 6.2 Environment Variables\n\n```bash\n# Startup behavior\nETHAN_AUTO_START=true\nETHAN_STARTUP_TIMEOUT=30\nETHAN_RESUME_SESSION=true\n\n# Runtime location\nETHAN_RUNTIME_PATH=/usr/local/bin/ethan-runtime\nETHAN_RUNTIME_CONFIG=/etc/ethan/runtime.yaml\n\n# Socket path\nETHAN_SOCKET_PATH=/var/run/ethan/runtime.sock\n```\n\n---\n\n## 7. Directory Explanations\n\n### 3.1 `core/` — AI Brain\n\n**Purpose** : The cognitive engine of ETHAN  \n**Language** : Go  \n**Responsibility** : All AI logic, event processing, module orchestration\n\n**What belongs here**:\n- Kernel (event router, scheduler, state manager)\n- Modules (executive, planner, memory, reflective, learning, autonomy)\n- Event bus client (NATS)\n- Capability registry\n- API server (HTTP/gRPC)\n- Security (auth, authz)\n- Telemetry\n\n**What does NOT belong here**:\n- ❌ CLI code\n- ❌ Docker Compose files\n- ❌ Plugin code\n- ❌ Infrastructure configs\n\n**Ownership** : Core team  \n**Stability** : Stable (semantic versioning)\n\n---\n\n### 3.2 `runtime/` — Orchestrator\n\n**Purpose** : Service lifecycle management  \n**Language** : Go  \n**Responsibility** : Start/stop/restart services, health monitoring, Docker Compose orchestration\n\n**What belongs here**:\n- Docker Compose management\n- Service health checking\n- Unix socket server (for CLI)\n- Runtime API\n- Service dependency resolution\n\n**What does NOT belong here**:\n- ❌ AI logic\n- ❌ Plugin execution\n- ❌ CLI UI\n\n**Ownership** : Platform team  \n**Stability** : Stable\n\n---\n\n### 3.3 `cli/` — Command-Line Interface\n\n**Purpose** : User interface for terminal  \n**Language** : Python  \n**Responsibility** : User interaction, display, input handling\n\n**What belongs here**:\n- REPL loop\n- Command parsing\n- UI rendering (colors, spinners, tables)\n- Session management\n- Configuration loading\n- Runtime client (communication)\n\n**What does NOT belong here**:\n- ❌ AI logic\n- ❌ Business logic\n- ❌ Direct Core imports\n\n**Ownership** : CLI team  \n**Stability** : Stable\n\n---\n\n### 3.4 `plugins/` — Extensions\n\n**Purpose** : Extend ETHAN functionality  \n**Language** : Python  \n**Responsibility** : Plugin discovery, loading, sandboxing, execution\n\n**What belongs here**:\n- Plugin SDK\n- Plugin loader\n- Plugin validator\n- Plugin sandbox (isolation)\n- Builtin plugins (security, browser, etc.)\n- Plugin registry\n\n**What does NOT belong here**:\n- ❌ Core logic\n- ❌ Runtime logic\n- ❌ CLI logic\n\n**Ownership** : Plugin team  \n**Stability** : Evolving (plugin API versioned)\n\n---\n\n### 3.5 `infrastructure/` — Deployment & Operations\n\n**Purpose** : Everything needed to deploy and run ETHAN  \n**Language** : YAML, shell scripts  \n**Responsibility** : Deployment configurations, system integration\n\n**What belongs here**:\n- Dockerfiles\n- Docker Compose files\n- Kubernetes manifests\n- Systemd service files\n- Shell integration (bash/zsh/fish)\n- Installation scripts\n- Backup/restore scripts\n- Default configurations\n\n**What does NOT belong here**:\n- ❌ Application code\n- ❌ Tests\n- ❌ Documentation (except inline comments)\n\n**Ownership** : DevOps team  \n**Stability** : Stable (infrastructure as code)\n\n---\n\n### 3.6 `docs/` — Documentation\n\n**Purpose** : All documentation in one place  \n**Format** : Markdown  \n**Responsibility** : User guides, developer docs, architecture docs\n\n**What belongs here**:\n- Architecture documentation\n- User guides\n- Developer guides\n- API reference\n- Design documents\n- Tutorials\n\n**What does NOT belong here**:\n- ❌ Code\n- ❌ Tests\n- ❌ Engineering RFCs (those go in `engineering/`)\n\n**Ownership** : Documentation team  \n**Stability** : Living document\n\n---\n\n### 3.7 `tests/` — Integration Tests\n\n**Purpose** : End-to-end and integration testing  \n**Language** : Python, Go  \n**Responsibility** : Test the system as a whole\n\n**What belongs here**:\n- Integration tests (CLI ↔ Runtime ↔ Core)\n- End-to-end tests\n- Test fixtures\n- Test utilities\n\n**What does NOT belong here**:\n- ❌ Unit tests (those go in component directories)\n- ❌ Application code\n\n**Ownership** : QA team  \n**Stability** : Stable\n\n---\n\n### 3.8 `scripts/` — Build & Utility Scripts\n\n**Purpose** : Automation scripts  \n**Language** : Bash, Python  \n**Responsibility** : Build, test, lint, release automation\n\n**What belongs here**:\n- Build scripts\n- Test runners\n- Linting scripts\n- Release automation\n- Code generation\n\n**What does NOT belong here**:\n- ❌ Deployment scripts (those go in `infrastructure/`)\n- ❌ Application code\n\n**Ownership** : DevOps team  \n**Stability** : Stable\n\n---\n\n### 3.9 `engineering/` — Engineering Documents\n\n**Purpose** : Technical decision records  \n**Format** : Markdown  \n**Responsibility** : RFCs, ADRs, standards\n\n**What belongs here**:\n- Architecture Decision Records (ADRs)\n- Request for Comments (RFCs)\n- Coding standards\n- Design templates\n\n**What does NOT belong here**:\n- ❌ User documentation (those go in `docs/`)\n- ❌ Code\n\n**Ownership** : Engineering team  \n**Stability** : Historical record\n\n---\n\n### 3.10 `examples/` — Usage Examples\n\n**Purpose** : Show how to use ETHAN  \n**Language** : Various  \n**Responsibility** : Example code, tutorials\n\n**What belongs here**:\n- Basic usage examples\n- Advanced examples\n- Plugin development examples\n- Deployment examples\n\n**What does NOT belong here**:\n- ❌ Production code\n- ❌ Tests\n\n**Ownership** : Community  \n**Stability** : Living document\n\n---\n\n## 4. Migration Strategy\n\n### 4.1 Current → Proposed Mapping\n\n```\nCurrent Structure              →  Proposed Structure\n─────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\ncli/                           →  cli/\ncli/systemd/                   →  infrastructure/systemd/\ncli/xfce/                      →  infrastructure/shell/\ncli/plugins/                   →  plugins/builtin/\ncli/registry.py                →  cli/ethan/commands/\n\ncore/                          →  core/\nkernel/                        →  core/internal/kernel/\n\ninfra/docker/                  →  infrastructure/docker/\ninfra/kubernetes/              →  infrastructure/kubernetes/\ninfra/scripts/                 →  infrastructure/scripts/\ninfra/config/                  →  infrastructure/config/\n\nplugins/                       →  plugins/\nplugins/loader.py              →  plugins/sdk/loader.py\nplugins/manager.py             →  plugins/sdk/manager.py\n\nscripts/                       →  scripts/ (build scripts)\n                                  infrastructure/scripts/ (deploy scripts)\n\ndocs/                          →  docs/\nengineering/                   →  engineering/\n\ntests/                         →  tests/\n```\n\n### 4.2 Migration Steps\n\n```bash\n# Step 1: Create new structure\nmkdir -p core/internal/{kernel,bus,registry,planner,executor,memory,executive,reflective,learning,autonomy,metacognition,api,security,telemetry}\nmkdir -p runtime/internal/{orchestrator,docker,health,socket,api}\nmkdir -p cli/ethan/{commands,ui}\nmkdir -p plugins/{builtin,sdk,store}\nmkdir -p infrastructure/{docker,kubernetes,systemd,shell,scripts,config}\nmkdir -p docs/{architecture,user-guide,development,design}\nmkdir -p tests/{unit,integration,fixtures}\nmkdir -p scripts/gen\nmkdir -p engineering/{adr,rfc,standards,templates}\nmkdir -p examples\n\n# Step 2: Move files (example)\nmv cli/* cli/ethan/\nmv cli/systemd/* infrastructure/systemd/\nmv cli/xfce/* infrastructure/shell/\nmv core/* core/internal/\nmv kernel/* core/internal/kernel/\n\n# Step 3: Update imports\n# (automated with sed/awk or manual)\n\n# Step 4: Update documentation\n# (update all paths in docs)\n\n# Step 5: Update CI/CD\n# (update paths in .github/workflows/)\n\n# Step 6: Test\npytest tests/\ngo test ./...\n```\n\n---\n\n## 5. Benefits\n\n### 5.1 Clear Separation of Concerns\n\n```\nBefore:\n  cli/\n  ├── commands/\n  ├── systemd/          ❌ Why is systemd here?\n  ├── xfce/             ❌ Why is xfce here?\n  └── plugins/          ❌ Why are plugins here?\n\nAfter:\n  cli/                  ✓ Only CLI code\n  infrastructure/\n  ├── systemd/          ✓ Systemd configs\n  ├── shell/            ✓ Shell integration\n  └── plugins/          ✓ Plugin system\n```\n\n### 5.2 Easy Navigation\n\n```\nBefore: \"Where is the Docker Compose file?\"\n  ❌ Search everywhere\n  ❌ infra/docker/\n  ❌ cli/systemd/\n  ❌ scripts/\n\nAfter: \"Where is the Docker Compose file?\"\n  ✓ infrastructure/docker/\n```\n\n### 5.3 Clear Ownership\n\n```\nBefore: \"Who owns plugins?\"\n  ❌ plugins/ (but also cli/plugins/)\n  ❌ core/plugins/ (doesn't exist but maybe?)\n\nAfter: \"Who owns plugins?\"\n  ✓ plugins/ team\n```\n\n### 5.4 Easier Onboarding\n\n```\nBefore: New contributor\n  ❌ \"Where do I start?\"\n  ❌ \"What goes where?\"\n  ❌ \"Who do I ask?\"\n\nAfter: New contributor\n  ✓ \"Read docs/development/getting-started.md\"\n  ✓ \"Code goes in core/, cli/, plugins/, or runtime/\"\n  ✓ \"Infrastructure goes in infrastructure/\"\n```\n\n---\n\n## 6. Module Boundaries\n\n### 6.1 Dependency Rules\n\n```\n┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐\n│                    Dependency Rules                                   │\n├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤\n│                                                                       │\n│  cli/                                                                 │\n│  ├─ Can import: runtime/ (via socket/HTTP)                          │\n│  ├─ Can import: plugins/sdk/ (for plugin commands)                  │\n│  └─ CANNOT import: core/, plugins/builtin/                          │\n│                                                                       │\n│  runtime/                                                             │\n│  ├─ Can import: core/ (via gRPC)                                    │\n│  ├─ Can import: infrastructure/compose/                             │\n│  └─ CANNOT import: cli/, plugins/                                   │\n│                                                                       │\n│  core/                                                                │\n│  ├─ Can import: plugins/sdk/ (plugin interface)                     │\n│  └─ CANNOT import: cli/, runtime/, plugins/builtin/                 │\n│                                                                       │\n│  plugins/                                                             │\n│  ├─ Can import: plugins/sdk/                                        │\n│  └─ CANNOT import: core/, runtime/, cli/                            │\n│                                                                       │\n│  infrastructure/                                                      │\n│  └─ CANNOT import: core/, runtime/, cli/, plugins/                  │\n│                                                                       │\n└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘\n```\n\n### 6.2 Communication Rules\n\n```\n┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐\n│                    Communication Rules                                │\n├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤\n│                                                                       │\n│  cli/ → runtime/ : Unix socket or HTTP                              │\n│  runtime/ → core/ : gRPC (mTLS)                                    │\n│  core/ ↔ plugins/ : NATS (events)                                  │\n│                                                                       │\n│  NO direct imports between:                                         │\n│  • cli/ → core/                                                     │\n│  • cli/ → plugins/builtin/                                          │\n│  • runtime/ → cli/                                                  │\n│  • plugins/ → core/ (except via SDK interface)                      │\n│                                                                       │\n└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘\n```\n\n---\n\n## 7. Build System\n\n### 7.1 Makefile\n\n```makefile\n# Makefile\n\n.PHONY: help build test lint clean install\n\nhelp:\n\t@echo \"ETHAN Build System\"\n\t@echo \"\"\n\t@echo \"Targets:\"\n\t@echo \"  build       Build all components\"\n\t@echo \"  test        Run all tests\"\n\t@echo \"  lint        Lint all code\"\n\t@echo \"  format      Format all code\"\n\t@echo \"  clean       Clean build artifacts\"\n\t@echo \"  install     Install ETHAN\"\n\nbuild:\n\t@echo \"Building core...\"\n\tcd core && go build -o ../dist/ethan-core ./cmd/core\n\t@echo \"Building runtime...\"\n\tcd runtime && go build -o ../dist/ethan-runtime ./cmd/runtime\n\t@echo \"Building CLI...\"\n\tcd cli && pip install -e .\n\t@echo \"Building plugins...\"\n\tcd plugins && pip install -e .\n\ntest:\n\t@echo \"Running Go tests...\"\n\tcd core && go test ./...\n\tcd runtime && go test ./...\n\t@echo \"Running Python tests...\"\n\tcd cli && pytest tests/\n\tcd plugins && pytest tests/\n\t@echo \"Running integration tests...\"\n\tpytest tests/integration/\n\nlint:\n\t@echo \"Linting Go...\"\n\tgolangci-lint run ./core/... ./runtime/...\n\t@echo \"Linting Python...\"\n\truff check cli/ plugins/ tests/\n\nformat:\n\t@echo \"Formatting Go...\"\n\tgofmt -w core/ runtime/\n\t@echo \"Formatting Python...\"\n\truff format cli/ plugins/ tests/\n\nclean:\n\trm -rf dist/\n\trm -rf .pytest_cache/\n\trm -rf .ruff_cache/\n\ninstall: build\n\t@echo \"Installing CLI...\"\n\tcd cli && pip install -e .\n\t@echo \"Installing Runtime...\"\n\tcp dist/ethan-runtime /usr/local/bin/\n\t@echo \"Installing Core...\"\n\tcp dist/ethan-core /usr/local/bin/\n\t@echo \"Setting up systemd...\"\n\tcp infrastructure/systemd/*.service ~/.config/systemd/user/\n\tsystemctl --user daemon-reload\n```\n\n### 7.2 pyproject.toml (root)\n\n```toml\n# pyproject.toml\n\n[project]\nname = \"ethan\"\nversion = \"1.0.0\"\ndescription = \"ETHAN Cognitive Runtime\"\nauthors = [{name = \"ETHAN Team\"}]\nrequires-python = \">=3.10\"\n\n[project.scripts]\nethan = \"ethan.main:main\"\n\n[tool.ruff]\nline-length = 100\ntarget-version = \"py310\"\n\n[tool.pytest.ini_options]\ntestpaths = [\"tests\"]\npython_files = [\"test_*.py\"]\n```\n\n### 7.3 go.mod (root)\n\n```go\n// go.mod (root - workspace)\n\ngo 1.23\n\nrequire (\n    github.com/nats-io/nats.go v1.36.0\n    google.golang.org/grpc v1.62.0\n)\n\n// Submodules\nrequire (\n    core/go.mod\n    runtime/go.mod\n)\n```\n\n---\n\n## 8. CI/CD Integration\n\n### 8.1 GitHub Actions\n\n```yaml\n# .github/workflows/ci.yml\n\nname: CI\n\non: [push, pull_request]\n\njobs:\n  test-core:\n    runs-on: ubuntu-latest\n    steps:\n      - uses: actions/checkout@v4\n      - uses: actions/setup-go@v5\n        with:\n          go-version: \"1.23\"\n      - run: cd core && go test ./...\n\n  test-runtime:\n    runs-on: ubuntu-latest\n    steps:\n      - uses: actions/checkout@v4\n      - uses: actions/setup-go@v5\n        with:\n          go-version: \"1.23\"\n      - run: cd runtime && go test ./...\n\n  test-cli:\n    runs-on: ubuntu-latest\n    steps:\n      - uses: actions/checkout@v4\n      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5\n        with:\n          python-version: \"3.12\"\n      - run: cd cli && pytest tests/\n\n  test-plugins:\n    runs-on: ubuntu-latest\n    steps:\n      - uses: actions/checkout@v4\n      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5\n        with:\n          python-version: \"3.12\"\n      - run: cd plugins && pytest tests/\n\n  integration:\n    runs-on: ubuntu-latest\n    needs: [test-core, test-runtime, test-cli, test-plugins]\n    steps:\n      - uses: actions/checkout@v4\n      - run: pytest tests/integration/\n```\n\n---\n\n## 9. Summary\n\n```\n┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐\n│                    REPOSITORY STRUCTURE SUMMARY                      │\n├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤\n│                                                                       │\n│  Directory Structure                                                 │\n│                                                                       │\n│  core/                    → AI brain (Go)                           │\n│  runtime/                 → Orchestrator (Go)                       │\n│  cli/                     → Command-line interface (Python)         │\n│  plugins/                 → Extensions (Python)                     │\n│ Unix simplicity. OS-grade architecture.\n\n---\n\n## 1. Top-Level Structure\n\n```\nethan/\n├── core/                 # AI Brain (Go)\n├── runtime/              # Service Orchestrator (Go)\n├── cli/                  # Terminal Interface (Python)\n├── plugins/              # Extensions (Python)\n├── infrastructure/       # Deployment configurations\n├── docs/                 # Documentation\n├── engineering/          # ADRs, RFCs, standards\n├── tests/                # Integration tests\n├── scripts/              # Build utilities\n├── examples/             # Usage examples\n├── legacy/               # Deprecated code (read-only)\n├── LICENSE\n├── README.md\n├── Makefile\n└── .github/              # CI/CD\n```\n\n**Rule**: No directory may contain code from another directory's domain.\n\n---\n\n## 2. Component Specifications\n\n### 2.1 `core/` — AI Brain\n\n| Property | Value |\n|----------|-------|\n| Language | Go |\n| Entry point | `cmd/ethan-core/main.go` |\n| Communication | NATS (internal), gRPC (Runtime), HTTP (API) |\n| Dependencies | NATS, Redis, PostgreSQL |\n| Build output | `ethan-core` binary |\n\n**Internal structure**:\n```\ncore/\n├── cmd/\n│   └── ethan-core/\n│       └── main.go              # Binary entry point\n├── internal/\n│   ├── kernel/                  # Event loop, scheduler, router\n│   ├── modules/                 # Cognitive modules\n│   │   ├── executive/\n│   │   ├── planner/\n│   │   ├── memory/\n│   │   ├── reflective/\n│   │   ├── learning/\n│   │   ├── autonomy/\n│   │   └── metacognition/\n│   ├── bus/                     # NATS abstraction\n│   ├── registry/                # Capability registry\n│   ├── api/                     # HTTP + gRPC servers\n│   └── telemetry/               # Metrics, traces\n├── pkg/                         # Public types\n│   ├── types/\n│   └── events/\n├── proto/                       # Protobuf definitions\n├── config/                      # Config defaults\n├── go.mod\n├── go.sum\n└── tests/                       # Unit tests\n```\n\n**Responsibility**: All AI logic, event processing, module execution.  \n**Knows**: NATS, Redis, PostgreSQL, gRPC, HTTP.  \n**Knows NOT**: Docker, systemd, terminal, CLI, plugins, filesystem paths.\n\n---\n\n### 2.2 `runtime/` — Service Orchestrator\n\n| Property | Value |\n|----------|-------|\n| Language | Go |\n| Entry point | `cmd/ethan-runtime/main.go` |\n| Communication | Unix socket (CLI), gRPC (Core) |\n| Dependencies | Docker, systemd |\n| Build output | `ethan-runtime` binary |\n\n**Internal structure**:\n```\nruntime/\n├── cmd/\n│   └── ethan-runtime/\n│       └── main.go              # Binary entry point\n├── internal/\n│   ├── orchestrator/            # Service lifecycle\n│   ├── docker/                  # Docker Compose management\n│   ├── health/                  # Health checking\n│   ├── socket/                  # Unix socket server\n│   └── api/                     # Runtime HTTP API\n├── compose/                     # Docker Compose files\n│   ├── docker-compose.yml\n│   ├── docker-compose.dev.yml\n│   └── docker-compose.minimal.yml\n├── config/\n├── go.mod\n├── go.sum\n└── tests/\n```\n\n**Responsibility**: Service lifecycle, Docker orchestration, health monitoring.  \n**Knows**: Docker, systemd, health checks.  \n**Knows NOT**: AI logic, LLM providers, plugins, terminal UI.\n\n---\n\n### 2.3 `cli/` — Terminal Interface\n\n| Property | Value |\n|----------|-------|\n| Language | Python 3.10+ |\n| Entry point | `ethan/main.py` |\n| Communication | Unix socket (Runtime) |\n| Dependencies | prompt_toolkit, httpx |\n| Install | `pip install -e cli/` |\n\n**Internal structure**:\n```\ncli/\n├── ethan/\n│   ├── __init__.py\n│   ├── main.py                  # Entry point\n│   ├── startup.py               # Startup orchestrator\n│   ├── repl.py                  # REPL loop\n│   ├── client.py                # Runtime client (Unix socket)\n│   ├── config.py                # XDG config loading\n│   ├── commands/\n│   │   ├── __init__.py\n│   │   ├── chat.py\n│   │   ├── run.py\n│   │   ├── status.py\n│   │   ├── logs.py\n│   │   ├── config_cmd.py\n│   │   └── help_cmd.py\n│   └── ui/\n│       ├── __init__.py\n│       ├── colors.py\n│       ├── streamer.py\n│       ├── spinner.py\n│       ├── prompts.py\n│       └── errors.py\n├── pyproject.toml\n├── requirements.txt\n└── tests/\n```\n\n**Responsibility**: User interaction, display, input handling.  \n**Knows**: Unix sockets, ANSI escape codes, prompt_toolkit.  \n**Knows NOT**: AI logic, LLM providers, Core internals, Docker.\n\n---\n\n### 2.4 `plugins/` — Extensions\n\n| Property | Value |\n|----------|-------|\n| Language | Python 3.10+ |\n| Communication | NATS (Core), filesystem |\n| Isolation | subprocess/sandbox |\n| Install | `pip install -e plugins/` |\n\n**Internal structure**:\n```\nplugins/\n├── sdk/                         # Plugin SDK\n│   ├── __init__.py\n│   ├── base.py                  # BasePlugin abstract class\n│   ├── manifest.py              # Manifest parsing\n│   └── events.py                # Event helpers\n├── builtin/                     # Official plugins\n│   ├── security/\n│   │   ├── __init__.py\n│   │   └── plugin.py\n│   ├── browser/\n│   │   ├── __init__.py\n│   │   └── plugin.py\n│   └── twitter/\n│       ├── __init__.py\n│       └── plugin.py\n├── sandbox/                     # Plugin isolation\n│   ├── __init__.py\n│   ├── runtime.py               # subprocess/sandbox runner\n│   └── policies.py              # Permission policies\n├── registry/                    # Plugin management\n│   ├── __init__.py\n│   ├── manager.py               # Install/remove/list\n│   └── store.py                 # Index management\n├── pyproject.toml\n├── requirements.txt\n└── tests/\n```\n\n**Responsibility**: Plugin lifecycle, isolation, execution.  \n**Knows**: NATS (to communicate with Core), filesystem.  \n**Knows NOT**: CLI, Docker, systemd, Core internals.\n\n---\n\n### 2.5 `infrastructure/` — Deployment Configurations\n\n| Property | Value |\n|----------|-------|\n| Language | YAML, shell scripts |\n| Purpose | Deployment, no application code |\n| Format | Static files only |\n\n**Internal structure**:\n```\ninfrastructure/\n├── docker/                      # Dockerfiles\n│   ├── core/\n│   │   └── Dockerfile\n│   ├── runtime/\n│   │   └── Dockerfile\n│   └── plugins/\n│       └── Dockerfile\n├── systemd/                     # Systemd service files\n│   ├── ethan-core.service\n│   ├── ethan-runtime.service\n│   └── ethan-plugins.service\n├── shell/                       # Shell integration\n│   ├── bash/\n│   ├── zsh/\n│   └── fish/\n├── kubernetes/                  # K8s manifests\n├── scripts/                     # Deployment scripts\n│   ├── install.sh\n│   ├── uninstall.sh\n│   ├── backup.sh\n│   └── restore.sh\n└── config/                      # Default configs\n    ├── core.yaml\n    ├── runtime.yaml\n    └── plugins.yaml\n```\n\n**Responsibility**: Deployment configurations only.  \n**Knows NOT**: Any application code, any logic.\n\n---\n\n### 2.6 `docs/` — Documentation\n\n```\ndocs/\n├── architecture/\n├── user-guide/\n├── development/\n├── design/\n└── index.md\n```\n\n### 2.7 `engineering/` — Technical Records\n\n```\nengineering/\n├── adr/                         # Architecture Decision Records\n├── rfc/                         # Request for Comments\n└── standards/                   # Coding standards\n```\n\n### 2.8 `tests/` — Integration Tests\n\n```\ntests/\n├── integration/\n│   ├── test_startup.py\n│   ├── test_communication.py\n│   └── test_e2e.py\n├── fixtures/\n└── conftest.py\n```\n\n### 2.9 `scripts/` — Build Utilities\n\n```\nscripts/\n├── build.sh\n├── test.sh\n├── lint.sh\n├── format.sh\n├── release.sh\n└── gen/\n```\n\n---\n\n## 3. Communication Matrix\n\n| From | To | Protocol | Port/Socket | Security |\n|------|----|----------|-------------|----------|\n| CLI | Runtime | Unix socket | `/var/run/ethan/runtime.sock` | SO_PEERCRED |\n| CLI | Core | HTTP (fallback) | `:8000` | API key |\n| Runtime | Core | gRPC | `:50051` | mTLS |\n| Core | Plugins | NATS | `:4222` | Token auth |\n| Core | Redis | TCP | `:6379` | Password |\n| Core | PostgreSQL | TCP | `:5432` | Password |\n\n---\n\n## 4. Golden Rule\n\n> **No component may import or depend on another component's internal code.**\n\nCommunication between components is **always** via network protocols (Unix socket, gRPC, NATS, HTTP). Never via direct imports.\n\n---\n\n## 2. Dependency Graph\n\n```\n                    ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────┐\n                    │                  ALLOWED IMPORTS                  │\n                    └──────────────────────────────────────────────────┘\n\n                          ┌───────────────────┐\n                          │   infrastructure/  │\n                          │   (static files)   │\n                          └───────────────────┘\n                                  │\n                                  │ uses\n                                  ▼\n                    ┌─────────────────────────────┐\n                    │         runtime/             │\n                    │  imports: infrastructure/*   │\n                    │  Go stdlib, NATS client,     │\n                    │  Docker SDK, gRPC            │\n                    └──────────┬──────────────────┘\n                               │\n                    Unix socket│   gRPC\n                               │\n          ┌────────────────────┼────────────────────┐\n          │                    │                     │\n          ▼                    ▼                     ▼\n┌─────────────────┐  ┌──────────────────┐  ┌──────────────────┐\n│      cli/        │  │     core/        │  │    plugins/      │\n│ imports:         │  │ imports:         │  │ imports:         │\n│  - stdlib        │  │  - Go stdlib     │  │  - plugins/sdk/  │\n│  - prompt_toolkit│  │  - NATS client   │  │  - Python stdlib │\n│  - httpx         │  │  - Redis client  │  │  - NATS client   │\n└─────────────────┘  │  - PG client      │  └──────────────────┘\n                      │  - gRPC           │\n                      └──────────────────┘\n```\n\n---\n\n## 3. Allowed Dependencies\n\n### 3.1 `core/` (Go binary)\n\n**May import**:\n- Go standard library\n- `github.com/nats-io/nats.go` (NATS client)\n- `github.com/redis/go-redis` (Redis client)\n- `github.com/jackc/pgx` (PostgreSQL client)\n- `google.golang.org/grpc` (gRPC)\n- `go.opentelemetry.io/otel` (telemetry)\n- Internal packages within `core/internal/`\n\n**May NOT import**:\n- Any package from `runtime/`, `cli/`, `plugins/`, `infrastructure/`\n- Docker SDK\n- systemd libraries\n- terminal libraries (tty, termios)\n- Python packages\n\n### 3.2 `runtime/` (Go binary)\n\n**May import**:\n- Go standard library\n- `github.com/docker/docker` (Docker SDK)\n- `golang.org/x/sys/unix` (Unix sockets, SO_PEERCRED)\n- `google.golang.org/grpc` (gRPC client to Core)\n- Internal packages within `runtime/internal/`\n\n**May NOT import**:\n- Any package from `core/internal/`, `cli/`, `plugins/`\n- NATS client\n- Redis client\n- PostgreSQL client\n- AI/ML libraries\n- Python packages\n\n### 3.3 `cli/` (Python package)\n\n**May import**:\n- Python standard library\n- `httpx` (HTTP client, fallback only)\n- `prompt_toolkit` (REPL)\n- `pyyaml` (config)\n- `click` or `argparse` (CLI framework)\n- `rich` (optional, for tables)\n- `struct`, `socket` (Unix socket communication)\n\n**May NOT import**:\n- Any module from `core/`\n- Any module from `runtime/internal/`\n- Any module from `plugins/builtin/`\n- AI/ML libraries (transformers, torch, etc.)\n- Docker SDK\n- NATS client\n\n### 3.4 `plugins/` (Python package)\n\n**May import**:\n- Python standard library\n- `plugins/sdk/` (the Plugin SDK)\n- `nats-py` (NATS client, for Core communication)\n- Third-party libraries specific to the plugin's domain\n\n**May NOT import**:\n- Any module from `core/internal/`\n- Any module from `runtime/`\n- Any module from `cli/`\n- Any module from `infrastructure/`\n\n### 3.5 `infrastructure/` (static files)\n\n**May NOT import** any application code. This directory contains only:\n- YAML files\n- Shell scripts\n- Dockerfiles\n- Systemd unit files\n- Kubernetes manifests\n\n### 3.6 `tests/` (integration tests)\n\n**May import**:\n- `pytest` and test utilities\n- `subprocess` (to run binaries)\n- `httpx` (to call HTTP endpoints)\n- `socket` (to connect to Unix sockets)\n- `grpc` (to call gRPC endpoints)\n\n**May NOT import**:\n- Any module from `core/internal/`, `runtime/internal/`, `cli/ethan/commands/`\n  (only their public APIs)\n\n---\n\n## 4. Forbidden Dependencies\n\n| From | To | Reason |\n|------|----|--------|\n| `cli/` | `core/internal/` | CLI must not contain AI logic |\n| `cli/` | `plugins/builtin/` | CLI must not execute plugins directly |\n| `cli/` | `runtime/internal/` | Must communicate via socket, not imports |\n| `runtime/` | `core/internal/` | Must communicate via gRPC, not imports |\n| `runtime/` | `cli/` | Runtime must not know about terminal UI |\n| `core/` | `runtime/` | Core must not know about Docker/systemd |\n| `core/` | `cli/` | Core must not know about terminal |\n| `plugins/` | `core/internal/` | Must communicate via NATS, not imports |\n| `plugins/` | `runtime/` | Plugins must not manage services |\n| `plugins/` | `cli/` | Plugins must not control terminal |\n| `infrastructure/` | any app code | Infrastructure is static config only |\n\n---\n\n## 5. Communication Protocol Rules\n\n| Path | Allowed Protocol | Forbidden |\n|------|------------------|-----------|\n| CLI → Runtime | Unix socket | HTTP (except fallback), gRPC, direct import |\n| Runtime → Core | gRPC | HTTP, Unix socket, direct import |\n| Core → Plugins | NATS | HTTP, gRPC, direct import |\n| CLI → Core | HTTP (fallback only) | Any other protocol |\n| Core → Redis | TCP (Redis protocol) | Any other protocol |\n| Core → PostgreSQL | TCP (PG protocol) | Any other protocol |\n\n---\n\n## 6. CI Enforcement\n\n```yaml\n# .github/workflows/dependency-check.yml\n\nname: Dependency Check\n\non: [pull_request]\n\njobs:\n  check-imports:\n    runs-on: ubuntu-latest\n    steps:\n      - uses: actions/checkout@v4\n      \n      # Check that core/ doesn't import runtime/\n      - name: Check core imports\n        run: |\n          if grep -r \"runtime/\" core/ --include=\"*.go\"; then\n            echo \"❌ core/ must not import runtime/\"\n            exit 1\n          fi\n      \n      # Check that cli/ doesn't import core/\n      - name: Check cli imports\n        run: |\n          if grep -r \"from core\" cli/ --include=\"*.py\"; then\n            echo \"❌ cli/ must not import core/\"\n            exit 1\n          fi\n      \n      # Check that plugins/ doesn't import core/internal/\n      - name: Check plugin imports\n        run: |\n          if grep -r \"core.internal\" plugins/ --include=\"*.py\"; then\n            echo \"❌ plugins/ must not import core/internal/\"\n            exit 1\n          fi\n```\n\n---\n\n## 7. Review Checklist\n\nFor every PR, reviewers must verify:\n\n- [ ] No direct imports between components (cli↔core, runtime↔core, etc.)\n- [ ] Communication uses allowed protocols only\n- [ ] `infrastructure/` contains no application code\n- [ ] `cli/` contains no AI logic\n- [ ] `core/` contains no Docker/systemd references\n- [ ] `runtime/` contains no AI logic\n- [ ] `plugins/` communicates via NATS, not direct calls\n- [ ] No third-party library added without justification","operationIsLocatedInWorkspace":true,"startLineNumbers":[]}

# ETHAN — Architecture Finale Livrée

## Documents de spécification

| Document | Statut | Description |
|----------|--------|-------------|
| `REPOSITORY.md` | ✅ Ratifié | Spécification complète du repository |
| `DEPENDENCY_RULES.md` | ✅ Ratifié | Règles strictes d'import et communication |

## Architecture : 6 composants, 1 responsabilité chacun

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                    ETHAN — Architecture Finale                        │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│                                                                       │
│  COMPOSANT       RESPONSABILITÉ         LANGAGE    COMMUNICATION     │
│  ─────────       ───────────────         ──────    ─────────────     │
│  core/           AI Brain                Go        NATS, gRPC, HTTP │
│  runtime/        Service Orchestrator    Go        Unix socket, gRPC │
│  cli/            Terminal Interface      Python    Unix socket       │
│  plugins/        Extensions             Python    NATS              │
│  infrastructure/ Deployment configs     YAML      Statique          │
│  docs/           Documentation          Markdown  Statique          │
│                                                                       │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│                    RÈGLES DE DÉPENDANCES                              │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│                                                                       │
│  CLI ──socket──▶ RUNTIME ──gRPC──▶ CORE ◀──NATS──▶ PLUGINS         │
│   │                               │                                 │
│   └──────HTTP (fallback)──────────┘                                 │
│                                                                       │
│  INTERDIT                                                             │
│  • cli/ → core/       (AI logic dans le terminal)                   │
│  • runtime/ → core/   (import direct au lieu de gRPC)              │
│  • core/ → runtime/   (Docker dans le Core)                         │
│  • plugins/ → core/   (import direct au lieu de NATS)              │
│  • infrastructure/ → * (code applicatif dans les configs)          │
│                                                                       │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│                    BUILD MATRIX                                       │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│                                                                       │
│  COMPOSANT    BUILD CMD               OUTPUT          INSTALL       │
│  core/        go build ./cmd/...      ethan-core      /usr/local/bin│
│  runtime/     go build ./cmd/...      ethan-runtime   /usr/local/bin│
│  cli/         pip install -e .        ethan           pip package   │
│  plugins/     pip install -e .        plugins         pip package   │
│                                                                       │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

## Principes clés

| Principe | Application |
|----------|-------------|
| **Unix Philosophy** | Un composant = une responsabilité |
| **No Circular Deps** | Graphe orienté : CLI → Runtime → Core ← Plugins |
| **No Coupling** | Zéro import direct entre composants (toujours réseau) |
| **No AI in CLI** | CLI = interface pure, Core = intelligence |
| **No Docker in Core** | Core ignore Docker, systemd, terminal |
| **Dynamic Plugins** | Plugins chargés via NATS, pas d'import statique |

37 passed, 1 warning in 0.03s
```

4. **Supprimer `legacy/`** après migration complète
5. **Ajouter CI** avec `dependency-check.yml`HAS_CHANGES

run\n    run_parser = subparsers.add_parser(\"run\", help=\"One-shot message\")\n    run_parser.add_argument(\"message\", nargs=\"+\", help=\"Message to send\")\n    run_parser.add_argument(\"--model\", help=\"Model to use\")\n    run_parser.add_argument(\"--file\", help=\"Attach file\")\n\n    # {"tool":"newFileCreated","path":"cli/ethan/client.py","content":"\"\"\"Runtime client — communicates with ETHAN Runtime via Unix socket.\n\nZero AI logic. Only serialization/deserialization of commands.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport json\nimport socket\nfrom typing import Any, Optional\n\n\nclass RuntimeError(Exception):\n    \"\"\"Runtime is not available.\"\"\"\n\n\nclass RuntimeClient:\n    \"\"\"Client for ETHAN Runtime communication via Unix socket.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, socket_path: str = \"/var/run/ethan/runtime.sock\"):\n        self._socket_path = socket_path\n\n    def send(self, command: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:\n        \"\"\"Send a command to Runtime and return the response.\"\"\"\n        try:\n            with socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX, socket.SOCK_STREAM) as sock:\n                sock.connect(self._socket_path)\n                payload = json.dumps(command) + \"\\n\"\n                sock.sendall(payload.encode())\n                raw = sock.recv(65536).decode()\n                return json.loads(raw)\n        except FileNotFoundError:\n            raise RuntimeError(\n                f\"Socket not found: {self._socket_path}. \"\n                f\"Is Runtime running? Try: ethan start\"\n            )\n        except ConnectionRefusedError:\n            raise RuntimeError(\n                f\"Connection refused on {self._socket_path}. \"\n                f\"Restart Runtime: ethan restart\"\n            )\n\n    def is_available(self) -> bool:\n        \"\"\"Check if Runtime is available.\"\"\"\n        try:\n            resp = self.send({\"command\": \"ping\"})\n            return resp.get(\"status\") == \"ok\"\n        except RuntimeError:\n            return False\n\n    def start_service(self, service: str) -> dict[str, Any]:\n        \"\"\"Start a service via Runtime.\"\"\"\n        return self.send({\"command\": \"start\", \"service\": service})\n\n    def stop_service(self, service: str) -> dict[str, Any]:\n        \"\"\"Stop a service via Runtime.\"\"\"\n        return self.send({\"command\": \"stop\", \"service\": service})\n\n    def list_services(self) -> list[dict[str, str]]:\n        \"\"\"List all managed services.\"\"\"\n        resp = self.send({\"command\": \"list\"})\n        return resp.get(\"services\", [])\n\n    def get_status(self) -> dict[str, Any]:\n        \"\"\"Get full system status.\"\"\"\n        return self.send({\"command\": \"status\"})\n\n    def get_logs(self, service: Optional[str] = None, tail: int = 100) -> str:\n        \"\"\"Get logs from Runtime.\"\"\"\n        cmd: dict[str, Any] = {\"command\": \"logs\", \"tail\": tail}\n        if service:\n            cmd[\"service\"] = service\n        resp = self.send(cmd)\n        return resp.get(\"logs\", \"\")\n\n    def chat(self, message: str, session_id: Optional[str] = None) -> dict[str, Any]:\n        \"\"\"Send a chat message. Runtime forwards to Core.\"\"\"\n        cmd: dict[str, Any] = {\"command\": \"chat\", \"message\": message}\n        if session_id:\n            cmd[\"session_id\"] = session_id\n        return self.send(cmd)","operationIsLocatedInWorkspace":true,"startLineNumbers":[]}

Local config (./ethan.yaml)\n4. User config (~/.config/ethan/config.yaml)\n5. System config (/etc/ethan/ethan.yaml)\n6. Defaults\n\"\"\"\n\nimport os\nimport yaml\nfrom typing import Any\n\nDEFAULT_CONFIG: dict[str, Any] = {\n    \"runtime\": {\n        \"socket\": \"/var/run/ethan/runtime.sock\",\n        \"http_fallback\": \"http://localhost:8000\",\n    },\n    \"ui\": {\n        \"theme\": \"dark\",\n        \"stream\": True,\n        \"timestamps\": False,\n    },\n    \"session\": {\n        \"auto_save\": True,\n        \"max_history\": 10,\n        \"resume_last\": False,\n    },\n    \"logging\": {\n        \"level\": \"info\",\n    },\n}\n\n\ndef _find_config(cli_path: str | None = None) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Find config file using XDG priority.\"\"\"\n    candidates: list[str] = []\n\n    # CLI flag\n    if cli_path:\n        candidates.append(os.path.expanduser(cli_path))\n\n    # Local config (current directory)\n    candidates.append(os.path.join(os.getcwd(), \"ethan.yaml\"))\n\n    # XDG user config\n    xdg_config = os.environ.get(\"XDG_CONFIG_HOME\", os.path.expanduser(\"~/.config\"))\n    candidates.append(os.path.join(xdg_config, \"ethan\", \"config.yaml\"))\n\n    # System config\n    candidates.append(\"/etc/ethan/ethan.yaml\")\n\n    for path in candidates:\n        expanded = os.path.expanduser(path)\n        if os.path.isfile(expanded):\n            return expanded\n\n    return \"\"\n\n\ndef load_config(cli_path: str | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:\n    \"\"\"Load config from file, merge with defaults and env vars.\"\"\"\n    config = dict(DEFAULT_CONFIG)\n\n    # File config\n    config_path = _find_config(cli_path)\n    if config_path:\n        try:\n            with open(config_path) as f:\n                file_config = yaml.safe_load(f) or {}\n                _deep_merge(config, file_config)\n        except (OSError, yaml.YAMLError):\n            pass\n\n    # Environment variables\n    env_map = {\n        \"ETHAN_SOCKET_PATH\": (\"runtime\", \"socket\"),\n        \"ETHAN_RUNTIME_DIR\": (\"runtime\", \"socket\"),\n        \"ETHAN_LOG_LEVEL\": (\"logging\", \"level\"),\n    }\n    for env_var, keys in env_map.items():\n        value = os.environ.get(env_var)\n        if value:\n            _set_nested(config, keys, value)\n\n    return config\n\n\ndef save_config(config: dict[str, Any], path: str | None = None) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Save config to file.\"\"\"\n    if not path:\n        xdg_config = os.environ.get(\"XDG_CONFIG_HOME\", os.path.expanduser(\"~/.config\"))\n        path = os.path.join(xdg_config, \"ethan\", \"config.yaml\")\n\n    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(path), exist_ok=True)\n    with open(path, \"w\") as f:\n        yaml.dump(config, f, default_flow_style=False)\n\n\ndef _deep_merge(base: dict, override: dict) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Deep merge override into base.\"\"\"\n    for key, value in override.items():\n        if key in base and isinstance(base[key], dict) and isinstance(value, dict):\n            _deep_merge(base[key], value)\n        else:\n            base[key] = value\n\n\ndef _set_nested(config: dict, keys: tuple[str, ...], value: Any) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Set a nested key value.\"\"\"\n    current = config\n    for key in keys[:-1]:\n        if key not in current:\n            current[key] = {}\n        current = current[key]\n    current[keys[-1]] = value","operationIsLocatedInWorkspace":true,"startLineNumbers":[]}

Start REPL\n    from ethan.repl import REPL\n    repl = REPL(runtime, config, session_id)\n    repl.run()\n\n    return 0","operationIsLocatedInWorkspace":true,"startLineNumbers":[]}

No AI logic.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport sys\nfrom typing import Optional\n\nfrom ethan.client import RuntimeClient, RuntimeError\nfrom ethan.ui.colors import style\nfrom ethan.ui.prompts import   config: dict,\n        session_id: Optional[str] = None,\n    ):\n        self.runtime = runtime\n        self.config = config\n        self.session_id = session_id\n\n    def run(self) -> None:\n        \"\"\"Main REPL loop.\"\"\"\n        while True:\n            try:\n                user_input = input(get_prompt(self.session_id))\n            except (EOFError, KeyboardInterrupt):\n                self._exit()\n                break\n\n            if not user_input:\n                continue\n\n            if user_input.startswith(\"/\"):\n                if self._handle_special(user_input):\n                    continue\n                else:\n                    continue\n\n            self._send_message(user_input)\n\n    def _send_message(self, message: str) -> None:\n        \"\"\"Send message to Runtime and display response.\"\"\"\n        spinner = Spinner()\n        spinner.start()\n\n        try:\n            response = self.runtime.chat(message, self.session_id)\n            spinner.stop()\n\n            if response.get(\"status\") == \"ok\":\n                self.session_id = response.get(\"session_id\", self.session_id)\n                print(response.get(\"response\", \"\"))\n            else:\n                print(f\"\\n{style.error(response.get('error', 'Unknown error'))}\")\n\n        except RuntimeError as e:\n            spinner.stop()\n            print(f\"\\n{style.error(str(e))}\")\n\n    def _handle_special(self, cmd: str) -> bool:\n        \"\"\"Handle special commands.\"\"\"\n        cmd = cmd.strip().lower()\n\n        if cmd in (\"/exit\", \"/quit\"):\n            self._exit()\n            sys.exit(0)\n\n        elif cmd == \"/new\":\n            resp = self.runtime.send({\"command\": \"new_session\"})\n            self.session_id = resp.get(\"session_id\")\n            print(f\"\\n  {style.info('New session started')}\\n\")\n\n        elif cmd.startswith(\"/session\") and len(cmd.split()) > 1:\n            sid = cmd.split()[1]\n            resp = self.runtime.send({\"command\": \"resume\", \"session_id\": sid})\n            if resp.get(\"status\") == \"ok\":\n                self.session_id = sid\n                print(f\"\\n  {style.info(f'Session resumed: {sid[:8]}')}\\n\")\n            else:\n                print(f\"\\n  {style.error('Session not found')}\\n\")\n\n        elif cmd == \"/list\":\n            resp = self.runtime.send({\"command\": \"list_sessions\"})\n            sessions = resp.get(\"sessions\", [])\n /new           Start new session\n    /session <id>  Resume specific session\n    /list          List recent sessions\n    /clear         Clear current session\n    /help          Show this Try /help')}\")\n\n        return True\n\n    def _exit(self) -> None:\n        \"\"\"Clean exit.\"\"\"\n        if self.session_id and self.config.get(\"session\", {}).get(\"auto_save\", True):\n            try:\n                self.runtime.send({\n                    \"command\": \"save_session\",\n                    \"session_id\": self.session_id,\n                })\n            except RuntimeError:\n                pass\n        print(f\"\\n  {style.info('Session saved.
